Project Manager - Transform Global Logistics Solutions!

Are you ready to lead impactful customer implementations and drive digital transformation in global supply chain management? Transporeon, a Trimble company, is looking for a proactive Project Manager to lead customer projects from kick-off to go-live, delivering tailored software solutions that maximize business value, optimize operational efficiency, and drive long-term customer satisfaction across enterprise clients worldwide.


About Us: Trimble is an industrial technology company transforming how the world works by connecting the digital and physical worlds to boost productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.


About Transporeon At Transporeon, a Trimble Company, our mission is to bring transportation in sync with the world. We power the largest global freight network connecting over 1,500 shippers and 210,000 carriers. Our platform automates manual processes, facilitates collaboration, and provides real-time insights across all modes of transportation worldwide. Headquartered in Ulm, Germany, Transporeon operates globally with over 1,400 employees across 25 countries.


What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will take ownership of managing high-value projects that directly optimize supply chain operations for global enterprise clients while driving real-world impact and shaping long-term client success.


Key Exciting Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end customer implementations from kick-off to go-live, ensuring flawless delivery across scope, schedule, budget, and customer satisfaction.
  • Facilitate interactive solution design workshops to translate complex logistical requirements into modular, high-impact Transporeon software solutions.
  • Guide enterprise clients through smooth change management, including user training and user support, ensuring a seamless transition to Customer Care.
  • Partner closely with internal teams across Sales, Business Consulting, Product Management, and System Delivery to ensure project alignment and operational excellence.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying process efficiencies, sharing best practices, and standardizing regional project delivery frameworks.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing customer-facing software or IT implementation projects from inception to completion.
  • Solid understanding of SaaS delivery, scope management, schedule coordination, and project budget tracking.
  • Proven professional experience in the transportation and logistics area, with solid business domain knowledge of transport operations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with an agile mindset and comfort navigating rapid learning curves.
  • Professional working fluency in English and German or Polish.
  • Availability to onboard rapidly and independently take on customer projects within the first few months.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience working with formal project management frameworks such as PRINCE2.
  • Additional European language skills, such as Italian.

Logistics: Location: Cracow, Poland or Remote (Poland)


Why You'll Love Working With Us At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact.We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). jobs.description:
Description

We’re growing and looking to hire Customer Success Manager who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the role

﻿You will be the primary point of contact for our top-tier customers, building relationships across all levels, including senior executives, and ensuring successful adoption of our platform.

In this role, you will guide customers through complex challenges by leveraging strong product fluency and a deep understanding of their business needs. You will act as the central coordinator across internal teams, ensuring customer issues are clearly defined, properly routed, and driven to timely resolution with clear ownership and accountability. As the quarterback of the customer experience, you will orchestrate cross-functional teams to deliver outcomes that drive customer value, retention, and long-term success, and ensure accountability across all stakeholders, especially during critical situations

Responsibilities

As a Customer Success Manager, Your impact will be:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for executive stakeholders, aligning their business goals with product value.
  • Guide customers through onboarding and adoption, leading proactive product enablement to drive long-term value realization with a strong focus on time-to-value and measurable business outcomes
  • Monitor usage data and health indicators to preemptively address risks and capitalize on expansion opportunities.
  • Act as the "Quarterback" of the customer experience, synthesizing customer needs into actionable insights for Product and Sales to influence the roadmap.
  • Lead complex escalation workflows, aligning internal stakeholders to maintain momentum and resolve high-stakes challenges.
  • Take ownership beyond defined responsibilities when required to ensure customer success.
  • Leverage AI platforms (e.g., Staircase AI, Gemini) to monitor customer health metrics/playbooks, generate executive summaries, and automate back-office workflows - freeing up your time to focus on high-impact strategic account growth.

Requirements

What do you need to succeed in this role?

  • 4+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a fast-growing B2B SaaS organization
  • Experience managing large, complex customer accounts
  • Ability to quickly ramp on complex products and operate at a “power-user” level.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.
  • Excellent discovery and problem-framing skills (ability to ask the right questions and identify core issues).
  • Strong capability to influence and build trust with all levels of stakeholders with communication, social, and presentation skills.
  • Strong understanding of networking standards and protocols, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and segmentation principles.
  • Experience with Operational Technology (OT) environments and industrial networks – a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure network architecture.
  • Familiarity/Experience in Cyber Security i.e Endpoint, SOAR, SIEM
  • Leverage AI platforms (e.g., Staircase AI, Gemini) to monitor customer health metrics/playbooks, generate executive summaries, and automate back-office workflows - freeing up your time to focus on high-impact strategic account growth.

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite in The Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 multiple consecutive years.

Expected compensation for the role is between $130,000 - $145,000. This is a good faith estimate but does not include equity, bonus, or other forms of payment. Pay will be determined by experience level, but those outside the salary band are welcome to apply.

Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL diverse backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.


We are looking for a passionate Field Application Engineer (FAE) to drive technical engagements with key customers across EMEA, enabling them to build world‑class solutions on NVIDIA platforms. You will act as the primary technical interface between our customers, NVIDIA sales, and NVIDIA engineering teams, ensuring successful design‑in, deployment, and optimization of our GPU, AI, networking, and embedded products. You combine deep technical expertise with strong customer‑facing skills and enjoy solving complex system‑level problems in real customer environments.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Hardware design-in & bring-up: Support integration of NVIDIA silicon (GPUs, ConnectX NICs, BlueField DPUs, Grace & Vera CPUs) into partner system architectures. Participate in schematic reviews, PCB stack-up reviews, EVT/DVT bring-up.
  • Issue triage & escalation: Track, reproduce, and drive resolution of customer bugs across ticketing systems. Coordinate with internal Application Engineers and Product teams, and communicate workarounds, fixes, and release timelines back to the customer.
  • Firmware & software stack support: Guide customers through NVIDIA platform firmware (NIC FW, GPU FW, BMC/BIOS, FPGA, ERoT), GPU Operator, Network Operator, DOCA/OFED, DCGM, MFT tools, and NVQual qualification workflows.
  • Cross-company coordination: Bridge the customer, NVIDIA engineering (GPU, networking, platform SW), third-party vendors, and internal account/program management teams. Lead NDA processes and NVOnline access for partner engineers.
  • Telco / AI-RAN expertise: Work closely with the Aerial SDK Product SA and HQ Telco strategy to support partner Aerial integration, GPU-accelerated L1/L2 RAN, and platform deployment.
  • OEM portfolio support: Support additional OEM partners on HGX, IGX, and MGX reference designs, answering technical questions on power architecture, thermal management, PCIe topology, partner enablement docs, and design proposal reviews.
  • Customer on-site engagement: Oc casional travels to partner sites

What We Need to See:

  • 15+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (FAE, Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer) in the datacenter, HPC, networking, or telecom hardware ecosystem.
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge: comfortable with kernel modules, driver stacks, Kubernetes/OpenShift operators, container runtimes, and firmware update workflows.
  • Networking fundamentals: Ethernet, InfiniBand, SR-IOV, RDMA, NIC configuration. Experience with Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX or BlueField is a strong plus.
  • GPU / accelerated computing awareness: understanding of NVIDIA GPU platforms (HGX, MGX, DGX), CUDA, GPU Operator, DCGM. Deep GPU expertise is a plus but can be developed on the job.
  • Hardware-level comfort: ability to read schematics, understand PCIe topology, engage in thermal/mechanical design reviews, and participate in board-level bring-up and debug.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Experience in the telecom / RAN / 5G ecosystem (O-RAN, Aerial, AI-RAN concepts).
  • Familiarity with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP
  • Previous experience with partner/customer support
  • Background in BMC/Redfish, IPMI, or platform management firmware.

Description

Do you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and making a positive difference through exceptional customer service?

We are seeking compassionate, detail-oriented Patient Services Representatives to support a US-based healthcare organization. In this remote role, you will serve as an important first point of contact for patients, helping them schedule appointments, obtain general administrative information, and navigate routine inquiries with professionalism and care.

Every interaction matters. The ideal candidate understands the importance of listening carefully, communicating clearly, protecting confidential information, and ensuring that patients feel heard and supported.

This opportunity is well suited to candidates with customer service or call center experience who want to apply their communication and organizational skills in a healthcare environment.

Previous healthcare experience is an advantage, but it is not required. Paid training will help you learn the relevant systems, procedures, and expectations for the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming patient calls promptly and professionally, providing courteous and helpful assistance.
  • Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and cancel medical appointments accurately.
  • Assist patients with general appointment-related questions and administrative inquiries.
  • Verify and record patient information according to established procedures.
  • Document calls, patient requests, messages, and follow-up actions accurately in the appropriate systems.
  • Route messages and inquiries to the appropriate healthcare providers or administrative teams.
  • Follow scheduling protocols and coordinate appointments according to availability and service requirements.
  • Navigate scheduling software, patient management systems, and other computer applications while assisting patients.
  • Maintain a calm, empathetic, and professional approach when assisting frustrated, concerned, or anxious callers.
  • Protect confidential patient information and follow applicable privacy, security, and HIPAA-related procedures.
  • Follow established workflows, quality standards, and documentation requirements.
  • Escalate clinical questions or sensitive issues to the appropriate personnel rather than providing information outside your responsibilities.

Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Applicants must have their own equipment and a suitable home workspace that meets all of the following requirements:

  • Windows 11 PC (Mac not supported)
  • Minimum 16 GB RAM
  • Intel i5 processor or higher
  • Dual monitors
  • Webcam and wired USB headset
  • Fiber internet with a wired Ethernet connection
  • Backup power solution
  • Microsoft Teams and Office 365

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements may not move forward in the hiring process.

Working Hours

  • Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.
  • Applicants must be able to work the full schedule consistently.

Compensation and Contract Details

  • Rate: $5.50 USD per hour
  • Payment: Paid weekly in arrears
  • Contract type: Independent Contractor
  • Work arrangement: Fully remote in Mexico only
  • Training: Paid training

﻿

﻿Hiring Process

To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process.

Our process includes:

  1. Resume Review
  2. Pre-Screen Questionnaire
  3. One-Way Video Interview
  4. Pre-Screen interview
  5. Live Interviews
  6. Background Check

Important Application Requirements

  • This position is fully remote and open exclusively to candidates currently based in Mexico.
  • Resumes must be submitted in English. Spanish resumes will not be considered.
  • Applicants must meet the technical requirements or be able to meet them before starting work.
  • Candidates must be comfortable communicating professionally in English throughout their shift.
  • Applicants must be willing to complete the required background check.

Requirements

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Previous customer service, call center, or customer support experience is preferred.
  • Experience handling inbound calls and documenting customer interactions is an advantage.
  • Medical scheduling, patient services, healthcare administration, or medical call center experience is a plus, but not mandatory.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), appointment scheduling platforms, or customer management systems is beneficial.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to communicate with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
  • Excellent attention to detail when verifying information and recording interactions.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and remain organized in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confidence using computers and learning new software applications.
  • Good judgment when handling confidential information and sensitive conversations.
  • A dependable, service-oriented attitude and willingness to follow established procedures.

This role combines campaign operations, marketing automation, CRM and database support, website content management, reporting, and quality assurance to keep marketing programs running accurately, efficiently, and measurably. The Specialist contributes to performance analysis and recommends improvements based on campaign, channel, and database insights.

The incumbent must be detail-oriented, comfortable managing high-volume work across multiple systems and stakeholders, and able to balance speed, accuracy, and process discipline in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication, organization, documentation, and problem-solving skills are required to support consistent execution and continuous improvement.

Location: This vacancy is open to US citizens who hold the right to live and work within the United States.

Work Set up: Remote - US based - (Working either Eastern or Central Time-zone).

Essential skillset: Ideal candidates will demonstrate experience in content management systems (CMS), Have working knowledge of SEO and B2B/B2C marketing, with a strong background in email campaign operations. Success in this role requires expertise in audience segmentation, marketing automation, workflow management, A/B testing, campaign analytics, and continuous optimization to improve engagement and business outcomes.

Duties and Responsibilities

Leads campaign operations execution for email marketing programs, including project management, audience segmentation, program build, workflow setup, personalization support, QA, deployment readiness, performance tracking, and post-launch optimization to drive engagement with content and establish Cielo as the leading resource and thought leader for talent acquisition.

  • Proven experience liaising with external partners and vendors to design, build and refine email marketing templates, applying mobile-first design principles to ensure optimal performance across devices.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field preferred

Experience

  • Experience in data analysis and interpretation, with a focus on deriving actionable insights from campaign, channel, funnel, web, and database performance to inform strategy, execution, optimization, and decision-making.

Exposure

  • Understanding of lead management processes and best practices for data management within a marketing context.
  • Knowledge of email marketing best practices, industry trends, regulatory compliance standards, and GDPR is required.
  • Exposure to collaborative cross-functional work environments, with the ability to effectively communicate, document requirements, manage timelines, coordinate reviews, and collaborate with diverse teams across marketing, business development, sales, IT, analytics, and external partners.

TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Responsibilities: 

  • Our team and what we’ll accomplish togetherThe Integrated ADM Specialist serves as the primary subject matter expert and facilitator for the  Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) interactive process as well as the Pregnancy Workers Fairness Act (PWFA) in addition to overseeing, managing, processing, and adjudicating FMLA, State, and company specific leaves, as well as straightforward and complex STD claims; to determine benefits due pursuant to an STD plan: and to ensure the ongoing processing of claims.
    Must analyze reported Family Medical Leave (FMLA) requests; to make determinations based on Federal and State regulations; to communicate clearly with clients and claimants on all aspects of the claims process; and to ensure that claim management processes are followed per our best practices and client specific steps.
    With respect to the ADA and PWFA, this role is responsible for guiding employees and clients  through the reasonable accommodation process, mitigating legal risk, and ensuring  a seamless integration between short-term disability (STD), FMLA/leaves, and  ADA requirements

  • What you’ll do
    • Manage and process FMLA (and other Federal leaves as applicable) Military leaves, State leaves, company specific and STD claims. With regard to FMLA, will manage all DOL category claims; including re-certifications and the 2nd and 3rd opinion processes.
    • Manage all ADA and PWFA claims by advising clients on options for reasonable accommodation and making recommendations regarding the best approach for managing such claims as it relates to the ADA and PWFA.
    • Conduct case assessments, contacting the employee and their manager / HR by telephone or email, to explain the leave management process, employee accountabilities, and gather information for assessment purposes. 
    • Develop and document an understanding of the situation and the factors supporting, as well as inhibiting, a successful return to work for the employee against the essential job functions and undue hardships for the client organization.
    • Review all relevant information and consult with appropriate medical resources as required (nurse consultants, health professionals, supervisory team) to confirm decision and recommendations on FMLA, State, Company specific leaves, STD and ADA cases.
    • Analyzes FMLA medical certifications and other medical documentation and ensures claim determination adheres to the required regulatory compliance timeframes.
    • Informs STD claimants of any documentation needed to process a claim, timeframe requirements, claim’s status (e.g. STD approvals, denials, and consults), or any other information necessary to manage a claim.
    • Determine an appropriate RTW goal with the employee and the employer; as well as, provide active support for the return-to work planning process between the employee and their supervisor and intervene when necessary. 
    • Act as the primary case contact and will communicate proactively and continuously with the employer’s representative(s) regarding any case management matters that may be required through the life of claim.  
    • Will follow all processes as laid out in the operating procedures and/or as detailed in trainings/meetings.
    • Attend Case Management and Disability Management department team meetings and trainings as required. 
    • Other projects and tasks as assigned.

  • What you bring
    • Minimum 5+ years of direct experience managing Leaves, STD and ADA / PWFA claims or high-level disability case management.
    • Computer skills and the ability to work primarily online in a paperless environment. 
    • Strong interpersonal and helping skills along with assessment and problem-solving skills.
    • Regulatory Expertise: Deep understanding of the Americans with Disabilities Act  (ADA), Pregnancy Workers Fairness Act (PWFA), FMLA, and state-specific leave laws.
    • Company policies and plans: experiencing in managing self insured Short Term Disability (STD) Plans as well as company specific paid and unpaid leave policies.
    • Medical Literacy: Ability to review and interpret medical documentation and  translate clinical restrictions against essential job functions and make recommendations related to workplace accommodations.
    • Communication: Exceptional conflict resolution and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle sensitive medical information with extreme confidentiality and empathy.
    • Key Collaborative Relationships with
      • US Disability Case Managers: To ensure a seamless transition from leave / STD to accommodation.
      • Medical Providers: Regular interaction with nurses and physicians to validate functional  capacities.
      • Client contacts: Collaborating with client-side leadership on a continual basis via telephone, email and meetings, as needed.
      • Service Delivery Managers: Maintaining constant communication to ensure client satisfaction  and operational efficiency.

Working Conditions

  • Environment: Primarily a professional remote environment.
  • Physical Demand: Sedentary. High volume of telephonic and computer-based work
  • Mental Demand: Requires a high degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to manage stressful situations involving employee health and legal compliance.

Executive Assistant & Strategy Partner


Location: Fully Remote: Must live and work within the US.


Job Overview:


The Executive Strategy Partner serves as a trusted partner to the President and Senior Leadership Team (SLT), combining executive support, operational coordination, and strategic execution support to help executives operate effectively and advance organizational priorities.
This role goes beyond traditional executive support by managing executive-level communications, coordinating strategic planning processes, supporting organizational initiatives, and driving follow-through on key priorities. The ideal candidate brings exceptional business acumen, exceptional organizational skills, and a high level of comfort with technology, AI tools, and executive interaction.
The Executive Strategy Partner is responsible for ensuring business priorities are translated into coordinated action while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and operational excellence. This role will report directly to the President, providing executive assistant support 60% of the time and 40% of time is expected to be supporting the remaining duties reflected below.


Job Responsibilities:


Executive Partnership & Leadership Support


  • Serve as a primary partner to the President and SLT to support organizational priorities and executive effectiveness.
  • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Manage complex calendars, scheduling priorities, travel arrangements, and meeting logistics.
  • Prepare leaders for meetings by developing agendas, preparing briefing materials, and coordinating follow-up.
  • Coordinate leadership team operating rhythms, including meetings, planning sessions, and leadership off-sites.
  • Capture, track, and monitor executive action items and commitments, supporting shared drives and documentation.

Strategic Planning & Operational Coordination


  • Support quarterly and annual planning processes by coordinating timelines, materials, and leadership input.
  • Facilitate executive visibility into strategic priorities and help ensure initiatives remain on track.
  • Track and coordinate action items, milestones, risks, and dependencies across executive-level initiatives.
  • Prepare status updates, dashboards, and stakeholder communications related to key priorities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams and facilitate communication among stakeholders.
  • Support special projects sponsored by the President or SLT.

Executive Communications & Deliverables


  • Develop, format, and refine executive presentations, reports, and communications.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and professionalism across executive-facing materials.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications (internal and external) to ensure messaging and materials are high-quality and consistent.
  • Draft executive communications, meeting summaries, talking points, and leadership updates.

Technology & Process Improvement


  • Leverage AI tools and technology available across the enterprise to increase the effectiveness of the position.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows for the executive and leadership teams.
  • Maintain shared systems, documentation repositories, and collaboration spaces that support SLT work.

Administrative Operations


  • Manage expense reporting and related administrative processes.
  • Coordinate executive events, leadership meetings, and planning sessions.
  • Manage Executive Calendars
  • Handle confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
  • Support additional operational and administrative needs of the President and SLT as assigned.

Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5-8 years of experience in executive support, operations, business administration, project coordination, program management or related roles.
  • Experience supporting senior executives, business leaders, or leadership teams.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and project management capabilities.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Suite, including folder management, Google Slides, Google Docs, and Google Sheets, and/or Microsoft Office, Microsoft Co-Pilot (or equivalent AI system), including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new software and drive automation and process improvements leveraging technology.
  • Experience creating and refining executive presentations and communications.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • High degree of professionalism, judgment, and discretion.

Preferred Job Requirements:


  • Experience supporting a President, executive leadership team, or senior business unit leader.
  • Experience coordinating strategic planning, business operations, or cross-functional initiatives in a remote, matrixed organization.
  • Familiarity with project management tools and reporting processes.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools to improve productivity.
  • Experience within education, technology, SaaS, or related industries.

Success Measures:


The Executive Strategy Partner will be successful when:


  • Leadership meetings are highly organized, productive, and action-oriented.
  • Strategic priorities and action items are tracked and consistently advanced.
  • Executive communications and presentations are polished, consistent, and high-quality.
  • Executives spend less time on coordination or managing shared drives and documents and more time on strategic decisions.
  • Cross-functional initiatives move forward with improved visibility and accountability.
  • Technology and process improvements increase productivity across the leadership team.
  • Executive leadership is supported in a way that meetings are planned and organized.

As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150+ countries with innovative, research-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. Our flagship products—Gizmos™, Raz-Plus®, and Reflex™—are beloved by educators and students alike for being as practical and effective as they are fun.

Position summary

The Operations Manager, Member Experience supports the overall operations of VIVIO's Member Experience organization and issue resolution and quality. In this client-facing role, the manager works directly with clients, consultants and vendors on member-facing issues, owning each from first notice to final resolution:

We are looking for a strong root cause analyst who looks past individual complaints to find and fix the underlying process, system, policy or training gap. Member issue resolution, quality and AI tool oversight are the core focus, but the role supports Member Experience operations wherever the business needs it as VIVIO grows.

Key responsibilities

Client, Consultant and Vendor Partnership

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, consultants and vendors on member-facing issues, owning communication from intake to resolution with clear, proactive updates.
  • Lead issue review calls and deliver written resolution summaries covering timeline, member impact, root cause, corrective actions and follow-up commitments.

Member Issue Resolution and Escalations

  • Prioritize member-facing issues by urgency and impact to minimize medication delays, and serve as the final internal escalation point for complex member, pharmacy, prescriber and payer issues.

Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead structured root cause analysis on issues, escalations, complaints, quality failures and incidents using methods such as 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, Pareto analysis and process mapping.
  • Separate symptoms from underlying causes (process, system, data, policy, vendor or training) and validate findings with data.
  • Own corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans with clear owners, deadlines and success measures, and confirm fixes are sustained.
  • Analyze trends to catch recurring failure points and emerging risks early, and partner with cross-functional teams to fix problems at the source.

Quality and Compliance

  • Lead the quality program, including call and case audits, scorecards, evaluator calibration and timely, constructive feedback.
  • Ensure adherence to policies, client and payer contracts, HIPAA and healthcare regulations; support internal, external and client audits.

  • Review AI-assisted interactions for accuracy and compliance, partner with technology to improve the tool, and identify automation opportunities that reduce repeat issues and strengthen quality.

  • Operational judgment: prioritizes well and makes sound decisions under pressure.

Working conditions

Data Architecture & Data Engineering Leader

Location: Remote, MUST be located in the United States.

Prefer candidates who reside in the EST time zone or are willing to work EST hours.

Position summary

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader to design, build and run the data platform that powers our media, analytics, client reporting and new data products. This role owns the enterprise data architecture and data roadmap, leads data engineering, and builds the data foundation the business needs to launch scalable, marketable products, while making sure our data is secure, compliant, reliable and ready to scale.

You will partner with business leaders across Media, Strategy, Client Services and Product to turn business needs into trusted, well-governed data solutions. You will also build and mentor a growing data team, including team members in Kraków, Poland.

What you will do

Data architecture and roadmap

  • Define and own the roadmap for the enterprise data architecture, in line with company priorities and governance.
  • Design the target data architecture, including ingestion, storage, data layers, data models, integrations and the serving layer for reporting and products.
  • Document the architecture, data flows and source mappings so knowledge is shared and doesn't sit with one person.
  • Set standards for data modeling, pipeline design, naming conventions, code quality, testing and deployment.
  • Evaluate data technologies and vendors, make build-vs-buy recommendations, and manage platform cost and performance.

Data engineering and platform

  • Own the data platform on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, snowflake, redshift etc, data layers, data models and system integrations.
  • Lead the consolidation of multiple reporting and analytics platforms into a single source of truth.
  • Design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines from client, vendor, media and first-party sources, using APIs, SFTP and ETL and integration tools.
  • Lead platform migrations, including moving legacy data sources to BigQuery, snowflake, redshift etc
  • Standardize and template recurring data preparation and client data delivery to reduce custom, manual work.
  • Build a well-modeled, well-documented data foundation that supports reporting today and advanced analytics in the future.

Data foundation for new products

  • Design and build a reusable, product-ready data foundation (curated datasets, shared data models and governed views) that new products can be built on without starting from scratch.
  • Partner with Product Owners and business leaders to turn new product concepts, such as healthcare, audience and market intelligence offerings, into clear data requirements, data models and delivery plans.
  • Evaluate the data feasibility of new product ideas, including source availability, quality, licensing, compliance and cost to build and maintain.
  • Build data services and APIs that deliver product data reliably to client-facing applications, portals and dashboards.
  • Design for scale and multi-client use, with tenant separation, entitlements and configurable data delivery, so one product can serve many clients.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to align on data contracts, versioning and service levels for product datasets, so products stay stable as the platform evolves.
  • Help identify proprietary and differentiating data assets, and plan how to combine, enrich and package them into new offerings.

Automation, data quality and operations

  • Automate data pipelines end to end, including ingestion, transformation, validation, refreshes and client data feeds, to reduce manual effort and errors.
  • Use AI tools and agents to speed up data engineering work, such as generating and testing pipeline code, mapping and onboarding new sources, detecting anomalies and data quality issues, and triaging pipeline failures.
  • Establish data quality, validation and reconciliation frameworks so data is accurate, timely and trusted.
  • Implement modern data monitoring and observability tools (for example Monte Carlo, Datadog, Great Expectations or Google Cloud's native monitoring), with automated alerting on freshness, volume, schema changes and data quality.
  • Set clear service levels for critical data, and define incident management and root-cause processes for data issues.

Data governance, security and compliance

  • Build security, privacy and compliance into the data architecture by design, working closely with Infrastructure, Security and Compliance.
  • Ensure correct handling of sensitive and regulated data, including healthcare professional (HCP/NPI) data, under applicable regulations and frameworks such as HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA and SOC 2.
  • Define and enforce data governance, including ownership, access controls, data classification, lineage, cataloging, retention and audit trails.
  • Manage third-party and vendor data risk, including data-sharing agreements and secure transfer standards.
  • Identify, assess and reduce data risk, including key-person dependencies, single points of failure and undocumented systems.

Leadership and delivery

  • Build, lead and mentor a team of data engineers and analysts, raising technical standards and growing internal talent.
  • Introduce modern engineering practices: version control, CI/CD, code review, documentation, ticketing, sprints and regular release cycles.
  • Provide technical direction to internal contributors and external partners.
  • Translate complex data topics into clear recommendations for executives and non-technical stakeholders.

What you bring

Required

  • 16+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including 5+ years leading technical teams.
  • Proven track record designing and running enterprise data platforms in the cloud, preferably Google Cloud and BigQuery.
  • Experience building data foundations that support commercial data products or client-facing platforms, not only internal reporting.
  • Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python, data modeling (dimensional, layered or medallion), and pipeline orchestration and transformation (for example Airflow, Cloud Composer or dbt).
  • Experience with data quality, observability and governance tooling and practices.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy and compliance, with experience handling regulated or sensitive data.

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

As a Principal Delivery Manager at Kainos, you’ll lead the successful delivery of complex digital transformation programmes across in one of our Sector client portfolio: Public/Healthcare/Defence/Commercial. You’ll create the conditions for multiple multidisciplinary teams and suppliers to deliver measurable outcomes, while maintaining clear governance, strong commercial performance and trusted senior client relationships.


You’ll work with Director and C-level stakeholders to understand their priorities, shape delivery strategy and identify opportunities to deepen our relationships and grow our accounts. You’ll also take ownership of capacity and resourcing across your engagements, working closely with account teams and BU Operations to ensure we have the right people in place.


At Kainos, we put people first. You’ll lead, coach and empower delivery teams, helping individuals thrive while contributing to the continued development of our Sector business and wider Delivery capability.


You will be responsible for:


Delivery

  • Lead complex, high-value digital programmes across multiple teams, workstreams and suppliers, ensuring delivery is aligned to strategic goals and achieves measurable outcomes for customers and end users.
  • Define the critical success factors for each programme, going beyond time, budget and scope to include long-term impact, client satisfaction and continuous improvement.
  • Provide senior delivery leadership in fast-moving and challenging environments, making reasoned decisions that balance client priorities, Kainos commercial interests and the impact on our people.
  • Create clarity across programmes by setting direction, aligning plans and ensuring dependencies, risks and delivery challenges are actively managed.

Commercial and account growth

  • Take ownership of programme financial performance, meeting or exceeding agreed profitability targets and ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting of cost, revenue and margin.
  • Understand the contracts and commercial terms that apply to your programmes, ensuring Kainos is protected, and delivery remains compliant.
  • Build trusted relationships with Director and C-level stakeholders, proactively managing expectations, and strengthening confidence in Kainos as a delivery partner.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to grow the Sector accounts you support, contributing to account strategy, customer conversations, proposals, bids and pitches.
  • Work closely with Sales, Account Leads and Account Management teams to shape compelling responses that reflect client needs, procurement requirements, and evolving priorities.

Team and capability leadership

  • Create an inclusive, high-performing environment where multidisciplinary teams can do their best work, learn, and continuously improve.
  • Lead, coach and develop delivery leaders and programme teams, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback and supporting meaningful development objectives.
  • Take ownership of capacity and staffing across your engagements, working with BU Operations to anticipate demand, make effective resourcing decisions, and support the onboarding of new team members.
  • Contribute to recruitment, succession planning and the continued growth of the Delivery capability.
  • Take on wider management and leadership responsibilities across the Sector business and broader Delivery capability when required.

Governance, assurance and risk

  • Establish and maintain proportionate programme governance, with clear accountability, effective decision-making and robust technical quality standards.
  • Actively manage programme risks, issues and dependencies, escalating appropriately to protect delivery outcomes and maintain client confidence.
  • Provide appropriate assurance across multiple workstreams and suppliers, ensuring progress, quality and commercial performance are visible and understood.
  • Ensure teams comply with confidentiality, non-disclosure and information security requirements at all times.
  • Innovation and continuous improvement
  • Encourage innovation in technology, process and ways of working, helping teams use new tools and approaches to improve delivery effectiveness, team experience and customer outcomes.
  • Lead and implement improvements that increase efficiency and create value for clients and Kainos.
  • Share learning and celebrate success across Kainos, with customers and through relevant external industry channels.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement within the Management capability and maintain awareness of current thinking across Technology, Experience Design and Consulting.

Minimum requirements:

  • Significant experience delivering complex digital programmes within a consultancy, professional services or comparable environment.
  • Digital delivery experience and stakeholder management in a complex environment.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale digital transformation programmes across multiple teams and suppliers.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • A strong track record of delivering successful outcomes while balancing customer needs, commercial objectives, and delivery performance.
  • Experience establishing programme governance and managing risks, issues and assurance within complex delivery environments.
  • Experience building trusted relationships and influencing senior stakeholders, including Director and/or C-level decision makers.
  • Experience leading, developing and coaching high-performing teams, including line management responsibility.
  • Excellent communication, influencing and decision-making skills, with the ability to operate effectively in complex stakeholder environments.
  • Flexibility to work on customer sites and travel when required.
  • Eligible to achieve SC clearance (lived in the UK continuously for 5 years, background checks) – applies to Public & Defence sector.

Desirable:

  • Experience delivering programmes within central government, healthcare, defence or another highly regulated environment.
  • Broad technology experience and awareness of emerging trends, including AI, with curiosity about how they can improve delivery effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Strong business development and account growth experience, including account planning, bids, proposals, and procurement activities.
  • Evidence of securing follow-on work or expanding existing client relationships.
  • Experience leading improvements to management, delivery or leadership practices across a team, account or organisation.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

jobs.description:
Description

Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

Sentra is hiring its first US Classification Data Analyst to be the go-to expert on data classification for our US customers. You will join the Solutions Architecture team, reporting to the Director of Solutions Architecture, and work closely with our R&D Data Analysts team in Israel.

Classification is what customers judge us on during proofs of value (PoVs) and renewals: do our results match their data? You will make sure the answer is yes. You will own classification requests for US PoVs, validate results before customer calls, tune classifiers using proven procedures, and bring the hard problems to R&D with everything they need to solve them.

This is a high-impact role at a fast-growing startup. You will help build the US classification function from the ground up, and your scope will grow as you take on more of the work.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first point of contact for classification requests from US customers and PoVs, working with Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, TAMs, Support and Customer Success.
  • Own classification on PoV engagements: validate results before customer calls and join those calls as the classification expert in the room.
  • Tune classification using approved procedures: add and remove keywords, build customer-specific regex and dictionary classes, run re-analysis, review customer-built classes and manage allowlists.
  • Find false positives and false negatives before customers do, and explain clearly why something was classified the way it was and what will change.
  • Escalate complex issues to the R&D Data Analysts team with a complete, well-written handoff they can act on without a follow-up call.
  • Track every request and its outcome, and turn that data into insight on volume, trends, and where we can improve.
  • Proactively look across PoVs to spot what is working, what is not, and what needs to change in our classification, our process, or our runbooks.
  • Keep our runbooks current: report gaps, propose fixes, and update instructions as the product evolves.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (support engineering, solutions engineering, TAM, data analyst, or similar) at a SaaS or security company.
  • Startup experience. You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • A proactive mindset. You look for problems and improvements before they become customer issues.
  • Working SQL. You can write and adapt queries in Athena or a similar engine.
  • Regular expressions. You can read, write, and test patterns and explain their false positive behavior.
  • Git and code literacy. You understand how Git and pull requests work and can read and follow code, such as a Python script. You do not need to be a developer, and using AI tools like Claude to help write code is welcome, as long as you understand what the code does.
  • Clear, structured communication. You can explain technical results to a customer and write a handoff that a teammate can act on without a call.
  • Location reside on the East Coast USA

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with data classification, DLP or DSPM concepts (PII, PCI, PHI, data classes, false positive rates).
  • Exposure to cloud data stores such as S3, Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft 365, and how sensitive data shows up in them.
  • Experience with dashboards (Metabase or similar) and ticketing tools (Shortcut, Pylon or similar).

  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.

  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

jobs.excerpt: Mitek (NASDAQ: MITK) is a global leader in digital & biometric identity authentication, fraud prevention, and mobile deposit solutions.
jobs.description:
Mitek (NASDAQ: MITK) is a global leader in digital & biometric identity authentication, fraud prevention, and mobile deposit solutions. Our verified identity platform and advanced image capture solutions are built on the latest advancements in biometric recognition, artificial intelligence, computer vision and machine learning, and trusted by over 7,500 organizations worldwide. We are headquartered in San Diego, California, with operations in the United Kingdom, Spain, France, Mexico, and the Netherlands. Visit us at www.miteksystems.com.

We are Virtual 1st! Whether you choose to work remotely from your home office or in-person from one of Mitek’s offices, our practices, processes and tools are designed to enable your success. At Mitek, the Future of Work is about flexibility and preference wherever and whenever we are working. Because we care about our candidates, employees and customers, we include an in-person meeting as part of our hiring process. It’s one of the ways we live our mission to “Protect What’s Real.”

At Mitek, we believe that teams are more resilient, effective, and innovative when they benefit from a wide range of ideas, lived experiences, and perspectives. The strength of our organization is deeply rooted in the people who power it.​ We know that a workforce reflecting the richness of our communities and customers helps us better serve their needs.

As a member of Mitek’s team, you will build machine learning solutions that improve fraud detection and explainability across our digital identity products.

You will combine different sources of evidence, explore complex patterns and relationships in large-scale data, and develop reliable models that support better fraud decisions.

You will work closely with Product and Fraud Domain Experts to understand emerging fraud challenges and collaborate with Data Engineering to turn promising ideas into scalable production capabilities.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist with strong machine learning fundamentals, curiosity to explore new approaches, and a practical mindset focused on delivering measurable business value.

What You Will Do

    • Design, develop, and evaluate machine learning models for fraud detection, including fraud scoring and ensemble models that combine multiple sources of evidence.

    • Analyze large-scale datasets to identify complex patterns, relationships, behaviors, and anomalies, developing new signals to improve fraud detection.

    • Define robust experimentation and evaluation methodologies, including model calibration, operating thresholds, and performance metrics under realistic production conditions.

    • Develop interpretable and explainable ML approaches that help internal stakeholders and customers understand fraud scores and decisions.

    • Explore innovative approaches to fraud decisioning, including human-in-the-loop techniques and causal methods.

    • Collaborate with Product and Fraud Domain Experts to translate real-world fraud challenges and production feedback into effective machine learning capabilities.

    • Partner with Data Engineering to transform ML prototypes into scalable, maintainable, production-ready solutions.

    • Contribute to model monitoring, governance, technical documentation, ML tooling, and shared best practices across the team.

What You Need

    • A Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

    • Skills and expertise typically gained through approximately 5 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Applied ML Scientist, or in a comparable role.

    • Strong knowledge of statistical methods, supervised machine learning, and model evaluation, particularly for highly imbalanced classification problems.

    • Hands-on experience in feature engineering and machine learning model development using complex behavioral, relational, or contextual data.

    • Strong programming and analytical skills using Python, PySpark, and SQL.

    • Experience working with cloud-based machine learning and data infrastructure.

What Would Be Nice

  • Experience in fraud detection, financial crime, payments, digital identity, risk, or Trust & Safety.
  • Knowledge of advanced machine learning approaches such as graph-based methods, representation learning, or causal AI.
  • Experience with modern data lakehouse or real-time data technologies such as Apache Iceberg or Apache Pinot.
  • Experience taking machine learning solutions from experimentation into scalable production environments.
  • Confidence working in Linux environment.

Who You Are

    • A pragmatic and hands-on machine learning practitioner who focuses on solving meaningful business problems rather than adding unnecessary model complexity.

    • Naturally curious, with a passion for discovering patterns and relationships in data and experimenting with new approaches.

    • Comfortable using data and evidence to challenge assumptions and influence technical and product decisions.

    • Collaborative and willing to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and contribute to continuous improvement.

    • A confident communicator with strong spoken and written English skills.

    • Comfortable collaborating with distributed teams across different offices and time zones.

    • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to work autonomously while contributing positively to a team.

What Success Looks Like

    • Deliver measurable impact: Develop and improve machine learning models that strengthen fraud detection, support more accurate decisions, and deliver tangible business value.

    • Turn insights into innovation: Identify meaningful patterns, behaviors, and relationships in complex datasets and translate them into effective fraud detection signals.

    • Build reliable, explainable ML solutions: Create models that are robust, interpretable, and evaluated against realistic production conditions.

    • Take ideas into production: Work closely with Data Engineering to transform promising ML experiments into scalable, maintainable solutions.

    • Drive continuous improvement: Use experimentation, production feedback, and emerging ML techniques to improve model performance and fraud decisioning.

    • Make an impact through collaboration: Partner with Product, Fraud Domain Experts, and technical teams to solve complex challenges, share knowledge, and advance ML best practices.

We take pride in enabling career growth in an environment of innovation and teamwork. Our commitment to all Mitekians is to do meaningful work that matters. Our culture is defined by delivering our best to our customers by providing high value solutions and impactful outcomes, by continuously challenging convention, and by caring for each other through collaboration and celebrating our successes. 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands and launching very soon in Luxembourg and Austria. Backed by 16 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system.

🔎 What's in it for you

  • Working in a large payment company but looking for a more agile environment where your contributions have visible impact? At EPI, you'll help shape the rules and governance of a brand-new European payment scheme.

At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country they are based in, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.

🐝 About the team

You’ll report to our Chief Scheme Officer, one of EPI’s executive leaders with more than 20 years of international experience in payments. The team brings together experienced specialists across Scheme Rules, Certification & Approval and Fraud Management, located throughout Europe.

You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders, member banks and prospective members to ensure the robustness, compliance and evolution of EPI’s scheme framework.

💥 Your impact

  • Create, review and maintain EPI’s operating rules and regulations by translating market, product and regulatory requirements into clear and effective scheme documentation.

  • Collaborate with EPI teams, member banks and stakeholders to ensure the scheme framework evolves alongside business and regulatory needs.

  • Act as a key point of contact for applicant institutions throughout the membership assessment process.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory and business concepts into clear documentation.

  • Knowledge of risk management, financial stability assessments and AML-related controls within payments environments.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  • A first call with one of our recruiters.

  • An interview with Carmen, focused on the mission and your expertise, including a short home assignment.

  • An interview with your future closest colleagues, focused on day-to-day collaboration at EPI.

  • A final interview with our Chief Risk Officer, focused on risk awareness and regulatory sensibilities.

  • Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse.

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You’re looking for an already highly structured environment with no ambiguity or evolving processes.

  • You expect rapid promotion without first building deep expertise and impact in the role.

  • You prefer operational execution only and have little interest in governance, rules and regulatory frameworks.

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year.

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus, and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits program.

  • The opportunity to be part of a multicultural European company.

Otherwise apply!

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

jobs.excerpt: ArchitectContract Architect | Fabric Platform Engineering Hands-on architecture role across reusable platform products, APIs, datastores, UX, cloud and AI-enabled engineering Role summary We are looking for an experienced, hands-on contract architect to support our Fabric platform engineering team.
jobs.description:
Architect

Contract Architect | Fabric Platform Engineering Hands-on architecture role across reusable platform products, APIs, datastores, UX, cloud and AI-enabled engineering

Role summary

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on contract architect to support our Fabric platform engineering team. The role combines architecture leadership with practical delivery: shaping product direction, creating architecture blueprints, guiding engineering teams, reviewing code and, where useful, writing code or prototypes directly. The architect will work across platform products and reusable services as priorities evolve, with a strong focus on pragmatic delivery, secure design and engineering quality.

What you will do

  • Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts and stakeholders to clarify outcomes, shape product vision and translate requirements into pragmatic architecture options.
  • Produce concise architecture blueprints, high-level and low-level designs, technical decision records and implementation guidance for platform products.
  • Design secure, scalable and reusable services, APIs, datastore patterns, integration approaches, UX-facing capabilities and common components.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to turn architecture into implementation, including hands-on prototyping, code review, pair design, design assurance and technical debt management.
  • Select appropriate technologies, promote reuse, define development standards and help create common frameworks or accelerators across the platform.
  • Participate in planning and estimation, maintain the architecture backlog and make trade-offs across cost, risk, quality, security and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate with other architects, security, platform and engineering teams to align designs with enterprise standards and delivery constraints.
  • Apply AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices responsibly to improve delivery, quality, documentation, testing and developer productivity.

Required skills and experience

  • Strong architecture experience across cloud-native application, integration, data and security domains, with the judgement to balance governance and delivery pace.
  • Hands-on software engineering capability in at least one modern language such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, plus confidence reading and reviewing production code.
  • Practical experience using agentic AI coding tools and AI-assisted delivery workflows, for example GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex-style agents or similar tools.
  • Practical Azure experience, including compute, storage, networking, security, Azure Policy, Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault and tenant-aware identity patterns.
  • Experience with APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, preferably AKS, plus CI/CD and DevSecOps practices using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.
  • Ability to design access management, authentication and authorisation patterns for users, services and platform-to-platform integrations.
  • Good understanding of compliance, in-application security, secure-by-design patterns and operating within enterprise technology standards.
  • Experience designing for reusability, maintainability, observability, cost optimisation and technical debt control.
  • Clear communication style, able to work with senior stakeholders, product teams, engineers and architects across distributed teams.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with internal developer platforms, reusable engineering assets or platform marketplace models.
  • Experience with generative AI solution patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, automated testing and AI governance guardrails.
  • Familiarity with enterprise UX patterns, workflow automation and low-code/no-code product capabilities.
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF, SAFe or comparable architecture/security certification.

What good looks like

  • Comfortable moving from strategy to code: can explain the architecture in a stakeholder meeting, then work with engineers on implementation details afterwards.
  • Pragmatic rather than theoretical: makes sensible trade-offs, documents decisions clearly and keeps teams unblocked.
  • Reuse-minded: looks for common patterns and components that can help multiple Fabric products, not just the immediate delivery need.
  • Fluent in AI-enabled engineering, but grounded in security, reliability, maintainability and enterprise delivery standards.

Role type: Contract | Level: Architect / Senior Architect | Team: Fabric Platform Engineering

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior Technical Architect
Outside IR35 | SC Clearance Required (or willingness to obtain)
About Scrumconnect Consulting

Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised with UKIT awards including Best Public Sector IT Project, Digital Transformation Project of the Year, and a Special Award for Organisational Excellence during the pandemic. Our work impacts over 40 million UK citizens, with successful projects delivered across key government departments and regulatory bodies.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Technical Architect to provide technical leadership and expertise during Discovery, helping government officials and the wider team understand the existing technical landscape and assessing the impact of proposed changes on back-office IT systems. This role requires a technically strong architect capable of working autonomously in a complex, multi-organisation IT environment and producing robust, evidence-based technical assessments that directly inform decisions on a new digital system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess and document existing technical architecture, identifying root causes of data quality issues, data loss incidents and system failures
  • Engage with IT teams and back-office system providers to understand existing integrations, data flows and technical dependencies
  • Produce clear and structured technical documentation including current-state architecture diagrams, integration maps, data flow diagrams and technical constraints registers
  • Assess the technical effort, implementation timescales and cost implications for adapting back-office systems under different future-state scenarios
  • Provide technical assurance and advisory input across the discovery, ensuring the evidence base is technically sound and sufficiently detailed for decision-making
  • Support the Business Analyst and Service Designer in understanding the technical context of pain points raised by users
  • Identify and flag technical risks, constraints, dependencies and data standards issues that should inform the design of the new system
  • Contribute to the final discovery report, specifically the technical impact assessment and options analysis sections
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and accessibly to non-technical policy and programme stakeholders
  • Ensure technical recommendations align with the GDS Technology Code of Practice and government security standards

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience as a Technical Architect or Solutions Architect in UK public sector or local government digital delivery
  • Strong understanding of digital notification systems, RESTful APIs, data exchange standards and system integration patterns
  • Experience assessing the technical impact of system changes across complex, multi-organisation IT landscapes
  • Ability to produce high-quality technical architecture documentation and system diagrams using tools such as draw.io, Lucidchart, Archi or equivalent
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Knowledge of government technology standards including the GDS Technology Code of Practice, NCSC security principles and data standards
  • Experience working in Agile multidisciplinary teams alongside designers, researchers and delivery managers

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Knowledge of local authority IT back-office systems and common providers
  • Experience with notification systems or related regulatory IT infrastructure
  • Familiarity with data quality frameworks, master data management and data governance in public sector contexts
  • Cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure or GCP) and understanding of government cloud hosting standards

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Scrumconnect Consulting, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone is respected, valued, and supported. We actively encourage applications from women, people with disabilities, individuals from under-represented communities, and those seeking flexible working arrangements.

As a Disability Confident Level 1 employer, we provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and employment to ensure equal opportunity for all.

deine aufgaben

Mit Remazing Nova unterstützen wir unsere Kund:innen wie Purelei, Rosental, Henkel oder Emma dabei, ihre Produkte auf allen internationalen Amazon Marktplätzen ideal zu positionieren, Sales zu steigern sowie die eigenen Produkte an die Voraussetzungen der Plattform anzupassen.

AMAZON ADVERTISING: Du übernimmst die Konzeption, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Amazon-Advertising-Kampagnen für nationale und internationale Brands. Dabei arbeitest du datengetrieben entlang relevanter KPIs wie ACoS, CPC, CTR, Organic Rank oder Sponsored Rank.

PERFORMANCE ANALYSE & REPORTING: Du analysierst Kampagnen- und Performance-Daten, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kund:innen ab. Die Ergebnisse bereitest du strukturiert in Reportings und Präsentationen auf.

STRATEGIEENTWICKLUNG: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickelst du individuelle Advertising-Strategien zur Erreichung ihrer Wachstums- und Umsatzziele auf Amazon.

BUDGET MANAGEMENT: Du verantwortest die Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung von Werbebudgets und sorgst für einen effizienten Einsatz der eingesetzten Media-Budgets.

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT & CONSULTING: Du bist regelmäßige:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kund:innen und berätst sie strategisch zu ihren Amazon Advertising Aktivitäten sowie zu neuen Wachstums- und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.

KNOWLEDGE SHARING & WEITERENTWICKLUNG: Du teilst dein Fachwissen zu Amazon Advertising, aktuellen Trends und Best Practices mit Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen und entwickelst dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter

ÜBER AMAZON HINAUS – NEUE MARKTPLÄTZE: Amazon ist dein Kerngeschäft – gleichzeitig bekommst du bei uns die Chance, in weitere Marktplätze wie Otto, Kaufland oder Shop Apotheke hineinzuwachsen. Das ist ausdrücklich kein Muss, sondern eine echte Entwicklungsperspektive: Wir leiten dich an, du baust Schritt für Schritt Know-how im Bereich Marktplätze auf und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Team Marktplätze zusammen.

dein profil

Uns überzeugt vor allem, dass du Amazon Advertising verstanden und schon selbst gesteuert hast – auf welchem Weg du dahin gekommen bist, ist zweitrangig.

AMAZON-ADVERTISING-ERFAHRUNG: Ob mit einem Jahr oder mehreren Jahren – entscheidend ist, dass du Sponsored Ads hands-on gesteuert hast und ein Gefühl dafür hast, an welchen Hebeln du drehst. Woher die Erfahrung kommt, ist uns egal: aus einer Agentur, inhouse auf Markenseite oder als (ehemaliger) Amazon-Seller, der seine Ads selbst gemacht hat.

ANALYTISCHES DENKEN: Du arbeitest gerne datengetrieben, hast ein gutes Gespür für Performance-KPIs und bist sicher in Google Sheets oder Excel.

TOOL-KENNTNISSE: Idealerweise hast du schon mit Amazon- und Keyword-Tools wie Helium10 gearbeitet.

E-COMMERCE & PERFORMANCE MINDSET: Du brennst für E-Commerce und Performance Marketing und willst messbare Ergebnisse für deine Kund:innen erzielen.

KOMMUNIKATION: Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie sehr gutes Englisch, trittst sicher gegenüber Kund:innen auf und erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich.

PLUSPUNKT: Erste Berührungspunkte mit Amazon DSP oder AMC sind ein nettes Extra – ein Muss sind sie nicht, dafür haben wir eigene Spezialist:innen im Team.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Kein Problem – bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir schauen aufs Gesamtbild, nicht auf die Häkchenliste.
