jobs.title: REMOTE Sales Manager
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USOur client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies. For more than 20 years, the company has worked with business owners to improve growth, profitability, leadership, systems, and ultimately create businesses that can thrive without depending entirely on the owner.

They are seeking an experienced, hands-on Sales Leader to lead, rebuild, and scale our sales organization.

This is not a role for someone who has only managed sales teams from a distance. They are looking for a true player-coach: someone who has personally been a successful high-ticket salesperson, knows how to coach and develop salespeople, has built outbound-generated pipeline, and has successfully improved an underperforming sales organization.

Why Join US

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact, not simply maintain an existing sales organization.

You'll inherit a company with an established brand, proven coaching programs, existing sales infrastructure, a substantial prospect database, and a history of strong sales performance—but you'll also have the autonomy to rebuild and improve the sales engine.

The right person will have significant influence over how the sales organization evolves and meaningful upside as the company grows.

If you're a proven sales leader who still understands what it takes to personally win business—and you enjoy building teams, fixing problems, and creating predictable revenue—we'd like to talk.

Compensation: $60,000–$100,000 base/guaranteed compensation + uncapped performance compensation
Expected Year-One Earnings:Approximately $150,000–$200,000 based on performance

The Opportunity

The sales organization currently includes:

  • A team of outbound setters responsible for proactively generating qualified sales appointments.

  • An Enrollment Director responsible for conducting consultative sales conversations and enrolling business owners into coaching programs.

  • An Account Management function responsible for client relationships, retention, referrals, and expansion opportunities.

The foundation is already in place, including CRM, dialing technology, sales scripts, an existing database, and a functioning outbound process.

The next Sales Leader will own improving, scaling, and managing the system.

Initially, your biggest priorities will be scaling the outbound setter team and improving closing performance. Over time, you will also develop additional revenue opportunities through referrals, past-client reactivation, previous qualified prospects, events, and other proactive sales strategies.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale the Sales Team

Manage, coach, train, and develop the company's sales organization, including outbound setters and Enrollment Directors.

Recruit and onboard additional sales talent as the organization grows.

Establish clear expectations, activity standards, KPIs, accountability, and performance management.

Make difficult personnel decisions when necessary and continuously upgrade the strength of the sales organization.

Build a Predictable Outbound Sales Engine

Scale the existing outbound setter organization to consistently generate qualified sales conversations.

Create a sales organization that can generate its own pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound marketing.

Continuously improve prospecting strategies, scripts, lead management, follow-up, reactivation, and referral generation.

Work closely with leadership and marketing to maximize the company's house database, outbound lists, inbound opportunities, events, referrals, and other lead sources.

Coach High-Ticket Sales

Review sales conversations and identify opportunities to improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, emotional engagement, and closing.

Coach Enrollment Directors through recorded calls, role-playing, scripting, and ongoing feedback.

Initially serve as a backup closer when necessary.

The long-term goal is not for the Sales Leader to compete with the sales team for deals, but this person must be capable of stepping into a sales conversation, successfully closing business, and demonstrating what great selling looks like.

Drive Sales Performance

Analyze activity, appointments, conversion rates, enrollments, pipeline, and revenue.

Use data to identify performance gaps and translate those insights into specific coaching, process, staffing, and sales strategies.

Build a disciplined sales culture focused on accountability and measurable results.

Initial Success Measures

Within approximately the first 2–4 months, we expect the Sales Leader to:

  • Evaluate the existing sales organization.

  • Scale and strengthen the outbound setter team.

  • Build toward approximately 6–8 productive part-time setters.

  • Generate at least 20–30 held qualified sales appointments per month.

  • Evaluate current closing performance and determine the appropriate coaching or personnel strategy.

  • Begin moving qualified close rates toward a minimum 25% target.

After stabilizing the core sales organization, the Sales Leader will expand into referrals, client reactivation, previous qualified opportunities, events, and other self-generated revenue strategies.

What We're Looking For

1. Experience With a Comparable Sales Model

You have meaningful experience with a sales process where appointments are generated and then handed to a closer for a consultative sales conversation.

Ideally, you have sold high-ticket services or programs directly to small and midsized business owners through phone or Zoom conversations.

2. You Have Personally Been a Successful Salesperson

You didn't begin your career managing salespeople—you learned how to sell.

You can discuss your personal sales results, close rates, average deal sizes, quotas, and performance.

You understand how to conduct discovery, uncover business and emotional pain, handle objections, and confidently ask for the business.

3. You Know How to Generate Business Without Depending on Marketing

You have led teams that generated meaningful pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold and warm outreach, database reactivation, referrals, or similar proactive strategies.

You appreciate inbound leads, but don't depend on them to succeed.

4. You've Successfully Rebuilt a Sales Team

You have at least five years of relevant sales leadership experience, ideally 10+.

More importantly, you've inherited an underperforming sales team or sales function and materially improved it.

You can clearly explain:

  • What performance looked like when you arrived.

  • What wasn't working.

  • What you changed.

  • Who you hired, coached, or replaced.

  • How you changed process or accountability.

  • The measurable results that followed.

5. You're a High-Accountability Leader
You're self-directed, organized, and comfortable operating with autonomy.

You communicate clearly, do what you say you're going to do, and take ownership when something isn't working.

You're comfortable making difficult decisions and don't need someone else continually motivating or managing you.

Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Remote role based in Argentina or Mexico.

Who we are

The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is a global environmental nonprofit working to create a world where people and nature thrive. Founded in 1951, TNC advances conservation with the support of more than a million members and the work of over 400 scientists, impacting conservation in +80 countries and territories.

Our impact

Since its founding in 1951, The Nature Conservancy has grown to become one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Some key accomplishments include:

  • 80+ countries and territories where TNC impacts conservation.

  • 125M+ acres of land protected.

  • 400+ scientists on staff.

  • 1M+ members supporting our mission.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Donor Communications Officer translates TNC's conservation priorities, results, and funding needs into compelling, donor-centered communications that support fundraising across Latin America.

As a strategic partner to the Director of Donor Communications, the role leads complex, multi-country initiatives and strengthens the quality, consistency, and persuasive power of communications for major and principal gift audiences. It is a senior individual contributor role, reporting to the Director of Donor Communications.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic planning and advisory

  • Partner with the Director of Donor Communications to develop regional communications strategies, priorities, messaging frameworks, and content plans aligned with fundraising and conservation objectives.

  • Advise Development colleagues, conservation teams, and regional leaders on donor positioning, narrative strategy, audience needs, and communications opportunities.

  • Exercise independent judgment to resolve complex messaging challenges, reconcile competing stakeholder inputs, and maintain donor relevance, accuracy, and strategic alignment.

  • Represent Donor Communications in designated regional, global, and cross-functional initiatives, meetings, and planning processes.

  • Provide continuity and senior-level decision support to the Director within agreed responsibilities.

Donor communications and persuasive storytelling

  • Lead high-priority communications for donor cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, campaigns, and major or principal gift opportunities.

  • Develop or oversee funding proposals, concept notes, regional and country overviews, donor visit materials, stewardship reports, campaign collateral, presentations, impact reports, and leadership messages.

  • Translate complex conservation, financial, and programmatic information into accurate, engaging narratives that inspire philanthropic support.

  • Adapt messaging to donor interests, cultural contexts, audience needs, and stages of the fundraising relationship.

  • Ensure communications do more than report information: they must explain why the work matters and why donors should support it.

Project and stakeholder leadership

  • Lead complex communications initiatives from initial briefing and strategy through stakeholder alignment, execution, review, delivery, and evaluation.

  • Define objectives, audiences, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, risks, and trade-offs.

  • Coordinate contributors across countries, functions, and seniority levels in a matrixed environment.

  • Influence without relying on formal authority, facilitate decisions, and maintain momentum when priorities compete.

  • Take ownership of outcomes end to end rather than limiting responsibility to an individual writing assignment.

Functional leadership and capability building

  • Strengthen editorial standards, regional messaging consistency, multilingual content practices, and donor communications workflows.

  • Provide mentorship, constructive feedback, and subject-matter guidance to communications and Development colleagues.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of content production, tools, systems, and processes.

  • Oversee relevant vendor relationships and support training and knowledge-sharing across the region.

  • Promote effective use of digital collaboration tools and AI-assisted content solutions while maintaining accuracy and institutional standards.

Multilingual and cross-cultural collaboration

  • Develop and review content in English, Spanish, and Portuguese according to audience and business needs.

  • Collaborate directly with colleagues in Brazil and other Latin American markets, including in conversations where English may not be the primary working language.

  • Navigate cultural and organizational differences to build trust, ensure local relevance, and facilitate alignment across regional and global teams.

Requirements and competencies to work with us

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Philanthropy, International Affairs, Conservation, or a related field.

  • An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

Experience

  • At least 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in donor communications, fundraising communications, strategic communications, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience developing audience-focused communications that support fundraising, persuasion, engagement, campaigns, or other organizational objectives.

  • Experience leading complex cross-functional, regional, or multi-country projects from planning through delivery.

  • Experience advising senior stakeholders, influencing without direct authority, and aligning competing priorities.

  • Experience producing a range of communication formats, including proposals, presentations, reports, campaign materials, and strategic narratives.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strategic communications planning and narrative development.

  • Fundraising communications, donor engagement, and persuasive writing.

  • Strong writing, editing, synthesis, and storytelling skills.

  • Ability to interpret scientific, conservation, financial, and programmatic information.

  • Project management, prioritization, and delivery across multiple workstreams.

  • Stakeholder management and facilitation in matrixed organizations.

  • Editorial quality assurance and multilingual content coordination.

  • Desirable: familiarity with content management systems, project management platforms, digital storytelling, and AI-assisted content tools.

Languages

  • English: Professional fluency, with very strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.

  • Spanish: Professional fluency, with very strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.

  • Portuguese: Advanced working proficiency sufficient to understand discussions, participate in meetings, and collaborate directly with Portuguese-speaking colleagues, particularly in Brazil.

Competencies

  • Strategic thinking: Understands the organizational and fundraising context behind each communication.

  • Donor-centered storytelling: Connects the work being done with donor motivations, interests, and potential contributions.

  • Ownership and proactivity: Anticipates needs, identifies opportunities, and drives work forward with autonomy.

  • Influence and collaboration: Builds alignment across cultures, functions, and seniority levels.

  • Adaptability and sound judgment: Manages ambiguity, competing priorities, sensitive information, and complex stakeholder dynamics.

Our team profile

The successful candidate will join an experienced, collaborative, and relatively horizontal team that values initiative, expertise, and constructive partnership over formal hierarchy. They should be comfortable operating as a senior contributor who can influence peers and support the team without relying on direct managerial authority. The team is looking for someone who:

  • Is curious about the work behind the message. Invests time in understanding conservation projects, funding needs, and organizational priorities rather than simply receiving a brief and producing copy.

  • Takes initiative. Anticipates needs, identifies opportunities, and contributes beyond narrowly defined assignments when the broader objective requires it.

  • Combines autonomy with collaboration. Owns deliverables end to end while involving the right stakeholders and respecting colleagues' expertise.

  • Navigates complexity diplomatically. Reconciles different perspectives, works across geographies, and builds trust without relying on authority.

  • Values quality and impact. Understands that communications must be accurate, engaging, and useful to the fundraising process, not simply well written.

Key interests for working with us

The team seeks someone motivated by the opportunity to connect philanthropic resources with meaningful environmental and social outcomes.

Relevant interests include:

  • Biodiversity conservation and ecosystem protection.

  • Climate change mitigation and adaptation.

  • Protection of land, oceans, freshwater, forests, and other critical natural systems.

  • Sustainable food and water systems.

  • The relationship between nature, community wellbeing, and long-term resilience.

  • The role of philanthropy and strategic partnerships in enabling conservation at scale.

Reasons to join our team

  • Mission-driven work: Contribute to a global organization working to conserve nature and address interconnected environmental challenges.

  • Regional reach: Support fundraising and conservation initiatives across diverse Latin American countries and cultural contexts.

  • Strategic influence: Help shape the narratives and communications practices that support major and principal gift fundraising.

  • Professional autonomy: Lead complex initiatives and exercise independent judgment in a senior individual contributor role.

  • Multidisciplinary collaboration: Work closely with Development, conservation, communications, and regional leadership colleagues.

  • Remote work: Work remotely from an approved location in Argentina or Mexico.

Relevant details before applying for this vacancy

  • Role scope: This is a senior strategic communications position with substantial hands-on writing and editing responsibilities. It is not exclusively a strategy or management role.

  • Sector flexibility: Candidates from agencies, corporate communications, campaigns, public relations, marketing, and other persuasive communications environments may be considered, even without prior environmental nonprofit experience.

  • TNC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers accommodations in the application process for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

And one of the best parts? We give you the freedom to work from whatever working location works best for you and your lifestyle - yes, this means you can be 100% remote if you want to be!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

What You'll Do

The Senior Product Manager (AI) is responsible for defining, delivering, and iterating AI-powered products and capabilities throughout the product life cycle — connecting data, machine learning, and large language models to real customer/consumer problems and measurable business outcomes.

  • Own the vision, strategy, and market fit for AI-powered products and experiences within your domain (e.g., recommendations, pricing, search, workflow automation, conversational tools).

  • Build deep consumer and dealer understanding through interviews, discovery sessions, and usage analytics to identify where AI can add real value (and where it should not be used).

  • Serve as internal and external subject matter expert on your AI products, including their capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use guidelines, measurement and monitoring.

  • Own the end-to-end product plan for AI capabilities, from discovery and problem framing through launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.

  • Drive innovative, AI-enabled solutions that align to strategic business goals and are grounded in realistic data, model, and UX constraints.

  • Gather business and data requirements from a variety of sources (consumers, dealers, account owners, sales, support, data science) and translate them into clear product outcomes and increments.

  • Document and elaborate requirements, partnering with business and technology leadership to prioritize AI opportunities within the overall product roadmap.

  • Maintain and prioritize a large product backlog that includes discovery, experimentation, and delivery work for AI features, as well as the data and tech debt required to keep them healthy.

  • Serve as subject matter expert in relevant product domains, assisting with customer UAT, defect triage, and mitigation efforts — with particular attention to AI-specific issues such as output quality, bias, hallucination, and safety.

  • Partner with stakeholders to define minimum viable products for AI features, balancing value, feasibility, risk, and responsible-use considerations.

  • Inspect, accept, or reject completed development work against defined acceptance criteria, UX standards, and key performance metrics for AI behaviors.

  • Communicate work in progress, results from experiments, and upcoming priorities to key internal and external stakeholders in a clear, non-hype way.

  • Collaborate across Data, Sales, Design, other Product teams, QA, and Engineering to produce prototypes and proof-of-concept experiences that validate AI opportunities quickly.

  • Collaborate with software development and data science to build robust, scalable AI solutions for existing and potential customers.

  • Develop a nuanced understanding of the target markets and user bases (including their workflows and risk tolerance) to guide decisions on AI product backlog and prioritization.

  • Contribute to business cases that justify AI investments, clearly articulating expected value, costs (including model and infrastructure costs), and key risks.

  • Conduct customer, market, and competitive analysis to identify industry trends, market gaps, and unmet customer needs, with a specific lens on how AI is changing user expectations.

  • Act as project manager lead in strategic AI initiatives for discovery and delivery, ensuring tight coordination across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in product management, business administration, engineering or a related field.

  • 4-6 years of relevant product management, product ownership, business analytics or beta analytics experience in a software product development environment.

  • 5+ years of relevant product management, product ownership, or closely related experience in a software product development environment, including 2+ years working on AI/ML-powered features or data products.

  • Experience in a role with strong requirements elicitation and stakeholder management across technical and non-technical groups.

  • Experience with customer support and bug tracking.

  • Experience and proficiency with modern product and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, yED, G Suite); familiarity with analytics or experimentation tools is a plus (Optimizely, Fullstory, Adobe, etc.).

  • Previous experience in marketplaces, advertising, e-commerce, SaaS, or other data-rich domains is a plus.

Bonus Points

Not specified in this posting.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Location and Work Mode

Who we are

The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is a global environmental nonprofit dedicated to conserving the lands and waters on which all life depends. Founded in 1951, TNC combines science, collaboration, conservation, and innovative approaches to address some of the world's most complex environmental challenges. Its work brings together communities, governments, businesses, donors, scientists, and other partners to create lasting solutions for people and nature.

Our impact

Since its founding in 1951, The Nature Conservancy has grown to become one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Some key accomplishments include:

  • 86 countries and territories where TNC has conservation impact.

  • 1,000+ scientists contributing to TNC's conservation work.

  • 100+ marine conservation projects around the world.

  • 125M+ acres of land protected through TNC's work.

Purpose of the Position

The Donor Relations Manager II will strengthen the execution of TNC's fundraising strategy in Latin America by supporting the teams and Relationship Managers responsible for donor relationships connected to TNC's work in Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala.

The role enables fundraising opportunities through strong coordination, project management, donor strategy support, and collaboration across TNC's regional and global teams.

Donor Strategy and Fundraising Support

Data, Reporting and Pipeline Management

  • Support consistent, high-quality donor engagement while minimizing organizational risk.

About Flight Centre Travel Group

Flight Centre Travel Group is one of the world’s largest travel companies with over 12,000 employees globally - who we call ‘Flighties’. With over thirty brands under our family tree and headquarters in more than twenty countries, our roles are diverse and our opportunities are endless. When, we say we’re a great place to work, we have the proof to back it up. Over the past 12 years we’ve been voted a ‘Great Place to Work’ including one of the Best Workplaces for Wellbeing and Best Workplaces for Women. Together, we live and breathe our number one philosophy, our people, and turn up each day driven by our purpose to open up the world for those who want to see. Put simply, we’re a bunch of travel lovers looking for more travel lovers to join our family.

About the role

WhereTo is looking for a Product Enablement Specialist to help run the function that becomes the go-to point of contact for product questions across our business. WhereTo is a nimble, startup-minded team within Flight Centre Travel Group focused on building the next-generation business travel platform that serves two of Flight Centre's main business travel brands, Corporate Traveller and FCM.

As Product Enablement Specialist, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the function: triaging incoming questions and stakeholder feedback, consolidating roadmap information, supporting go-to-market communication for new releases, drafting release notes and product-win comms, and documenting what's shipped, working closely with and reporting to the Product Enablement Lead, who sets the standards and handles anything complex or sensitive. You'll be a key point of contact for Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, and Brand stakeholders when they need clear, accurate answers about what we're building.

If you're a sharp, clear communicator who enjoys being the person who always has the answer, or knows exactly who does, we'd love to hear from you.

About you

Experience:

  • 2+ years in a role centered on internal communications, product operations, technical/solutions support, or a similar cross-functional capacity.
  • Experience translating technical or product detail for non-technical audiences.

Skills:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, this is the core of the role.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort maintaining a single source of truth across multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex product information into clear, concise updates for varied audiences.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Account Management.
  • Proficient with roadmap and release management tooling (Product Board and JIRA being our current tools of choice) and internal comms platforms (e.g., Workvivo).

Industry Knowledge:

  • General understanding of the business travel industry and WhereTo's product portfolio across both brands.
  • Comfort learning quickly across a broad product surface, since this role touches the full breadth of what WhereTo builds rather than one specific product line.

Adaptability:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, particularly while helping stand up a brand-new function.

jobs.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Knowledge Management Specialist, Service Delivery to build and run the knowledge layer behind a large-scale federal support program serving a diverse community of users.

In your first 90 days, you will stand up the program’s Tier 0 self-service knowledge base for both external users and internal staff. From there, you will manage the article lifecycle that keeps the knowledge base accurate, useful, and trustworthy, while developing the operating documentation that supports Tier 1 through Tier 3 help desk operations. This role suits someone who sees a knowledge base as a product with users, not simply a repository of documents.

Hundreds of thousands of people rely on the program’s digital services and resources each year. When someone gets stuck, the difference between answering their own question in thirty seconds and waiting for support often comes down to the quality of the knowledge layer behind the help desk.

This project supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $77,000 – $87,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Knowledge Base & Content Governance

  • Build and maintain the Tier 0 self-service knowledge base.

  • Run the full lifecycle of knowledge articles.

  • Implement taxonomy, tagging, metadata, and content governance.

  • Maintain the boundary between public and internal content.

Help Desk & Operational Knowledge

  • Write and maintain Tier 1–3 help desk SOPs, account setup/maintenance SOPs, and outage-notification processes.

  • Partner with Tier 1–3 support staff, engineering, and cybersecurity to capture and document knowledge.

  • Keep support guidance consistent across phone, email, chat, and social media.

Measurement & User Experience

  • Analyze query volume, resolution rates, and support trends to identify knowledge gaps.

  • Contribute to customer journey mapping and target content to common friction points.

Enablement & Knowledge Adoption

  • Produce interactive video tutorials and job aids.

  • Train help desk and program staff to submit, review, and use knowledge content.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance. An interim Secret is acceptable to start.

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 4 years in knowledge management, technical writing, documentation development, or content operations.

  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise knowledge base, documentation platform, or content management system.

  • Experience supporting a service desk or IT operations environment, with a working understanding of tiered support models and familiarity with ITIL practices for knowledge management, incident, problem and change.

  • Direct responsibility for the taxonomy, metadata and content governance of a knowledge base or documentation library — structured authoring and standards, not writing alone.

  • Demonstrated ability to draw knowledge out of subject-matter experts, interviewing technical staff and turning what they know into documentation someone else can follow.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical material into clear, plain-language content that a non-technical reader can act on.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification, or willingness to obtain it within 90 days of start.

  • Experience supporting a federal or DoD program.

  • Familiarity with service portals and workflow automation — ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform.

  • Experience writing for a military, veteran, or military family audience.

  • Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG requirements as they apply to published support content.

  • A habit of measuring knowledge content by whether it actually deflected the ticket, not by page views.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.excerpt: Important Notice for Applicants: At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates.
jobs.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Help Desk Specialist to be the first point of contact for users of a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them.

You will provide both Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, diagnosing and resolving issues directly, from access and account problems to errors inside complex, role-based regulatory workflows, and escalating to engineering only when a fix requires a code or infrastructure change. You will also be the team's early-warning system: spotting patterns in tickets that point to defects, escalating outages immediately, and feeding what users experience back to the engineering team. As new capabilities are released on the modernized platform, you will support users through each change, so we're looking for an experienced support professional who can work independently across both a legacy system and a new one.

This role is technical and service-oriented. You will work closely with our engineers, trainers, and change enablement lead, and with client stakeholders who depend on fast, accurate support.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

User Support & Issue Resolution

  • Serve as the first point of contact for agency and oversight office users by web, phone, and email, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and resolving technical, access, account, and process issues directly whenever possible.

  • Triage, categorize, and log every incident and service request in Zendesk, including requestor, description, time logged, and time to resolve.

  • Meet contractual service levels: an initial tailored response to 95% of tickets within 3 business hours, and resolution or escalation of 98% within 1 business day.

  • Handle user access and authorization requests, login issues, and questions about workflows, roles, and system status.

  • Investigate complex issues using application logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools, and escalate those that need engineering support with clear reproduction steps, root-cause findings, and user impact.

Monitoring, Escalation & Reporting

  • Monitor incoming tickets for patterns that suggest widespread issues or defects, and flag systemic problems to the engineering team.

  • Report outages and serious issues immediately to the technical team by phone and email, especially those affecting public availability, system performance, or data integrity.

  • Produce weekly and ad hoc help desk reports covering ticket volume, response and resolution times by priority, and trends.

  • Feed recurring user pain points into the product backlog as inputs for future fixes and enhancements.

User Enablement & Release Support

  • Create and update targeted help content, including online tips, FAQs, and user guide updates.

  • Support training materials and workshops in partnership with the training and change enablement leads.

  • Support users through each new release on the modernized platform, answering questions and capturing early feedback.

  • Help maintain help desk procedures, ticket categories, and knowledge base content as systems change.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • At least 4 years of experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for enterprise-level web applications, including complex, workflow-driven or role-based systems.

  • Demonstrated experience resolving issues independently through Tier 2 troubleshooting, and knowing when and how to escalate to engineering teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management), including ticket categorization, workflow configuration, and reporting.

  • Experience consistently meeting defined service-level agreements for response and resolution times.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and application log analysis to investigate and diagnose user-reported issues.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across user access and permissions, browser, application, and integration issues, with the ability to document root causes and reproduction steps for engineers.

  • Experience analyzing support data to identify trends and systemic defects, and turning findings into clear reports and recommendations.

  • Experience writing user-facing help content, FAQs, or knowledge base articles.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a patient, professional approach to supporting users of varied technical backgrounds, including senior government stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A+ certification.

  • Experience supporting federal agency users or a federal help desk.

  • Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking, the Unified Agenda, or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections.

  • Experience supporting applications built on Java and Oracle, or similar enterprise technology stacks.

  • Experience supporting users through a system migration or the rollout of a new platform.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for user-facing content.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

SprintRay Europe GmbH is a fast-growing, innovation-driven company operating across the EMEA region (Europe, Middle East, and Africa). We specialize in high-quality 3D printing solutions for the dental industry and are expanding rapidly.

At SprintRay, we foster close collaboration where innovative people develop creative solutions to challenges. Our open company culture and communicative environment help ensure that our work makes a real difference for our customers.

Help us grow our European footprint — we’re hiring a

Digital Workflow Specialist - Sweden / Nordics (f/m/d)

to join our dynamic team.

As a Digital Workflow Specialist for the Nordics (f/m/d), you will be the key link between SprintRay and our customers in the region. You’ll inspire and educate dental professionals, drive digital transformation, and strengthen SprintRay’s presence in the Spanish market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise and support dentists, orthodontists, and dental laboratories on the use of our 3D printing solutions

  • Train and support dental trade partners through workshops, joint customer visits, and events

  • Take responsibility for achieving your sales targets and reporting results


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in working or selling dental products or digital workflow solutions

  • Strong knowledge of dentistry and/or dental technology

  • Experience with CAD/CAM systems or digital workflows is highly desirable

  • Located in the Nordics but a preference in Sweden or Denmark, with willingness to travel extensively within the region

  • Fluent in English and one Nordic language

  • Comfortable using modern IT systems and CRM tools (Salesforce experience a plus)

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on, self-driven, and reliable approach

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

  • Team player with enthusiasm for innovation and technology

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with 3D printing is a plus

What we offer you

  • A varied and challenging role in which you can help shape and implement your own ideas

  • Working in a dedicated team with open communication in a motivating work environment in a growing technology company

  • Independent work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths and thus a wide range of development opportunities

  • Flexible working hours and models

  • 30 days vacation and your birthday off

  • Adequate performance-related remuneration

  • Opportunities for further training and qualification

  • For your well-being: Complimentary snacks and a wide selection of hot and cold beverages – coffee, tea, and more

  • Extensive training and colleagues who are available to answer questions

About SprintRay

SprintRay is rewriting the rules of dentistry with technology that’s smart, fast, and designed to make life easier for dental professionals. Since 2014, we’ve been on a mission to deliver the most advanced 3D printing solutions in the industry—combining hardware, software, and materials into one seamless ecosystem.

But what really makes SprintRay different is our people. We’re a bold, global team of innovators, problem-solvers, and doers who thrive on pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Every product we create is driven by a simple goal: help dentists spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time changing patients’ lives.

Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and fueled by curiosity. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. Whether we’re building next-generation AI tools, designing new materials, or supporting our customers on the front lines, we’re united by the same passion—transforming digital dentistry and having fun while we do it.

At SprintRay, the future of dentistry is being printed today. Want to be part of it?

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process

  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.

  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to guide the design, development, and delivery of an enterprise-scale, accessible digital platform for a federal government client. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with day-to-day client engagement, driving architecture decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, and API implementations that support these and other business functions, while mentoring a cross-functional delivery team.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to mature and modernize the platform, ensuring every release meets rigorous accessibility, security, and performance standards. In close collaboration with the Project Manager, you will lead and engage the client – bringing technical judgement, translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear, confident conversations that build trust and keep delivery on track.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss or demonstrate relevant project experience during the interview process.You will have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

This is a full-time role with a salary range of $135,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture and implementation decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, along with API design and integration work connecting these systems.

  • Guide the team in maturing legacy and evolving platforms into modern, enterprise-grade, scalable systems.

  • Set and enforce coding standards, review architecture and code, and drive continuous improvement of technical practices.

  • Ensure development and design work meets accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) across the platform.

  • Partner with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to maintain secure, reliable, well-documented systems.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Supporting the Project Manager as the technical point of contact, communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with client stakeholders, project sponsors, and cross-functional partners.

  • Lead release planning and prioritization by listening to stakeholder input, bringing a clear vision for the solution, and guiding the team toward scope, sequence, and tradeoffs that move the platform forward.

  • Represent the team in client meetings, technical reviews, and planning sessions with polish and confidence, proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged.

  • Demonstrated ability to build genuine rapport with clients and stakeholders, remaining calm, positive, and collaborative under pressure.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentorship to a cross-functional team of engineers and designers.

  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.

  • Guide the team through iterative delivery.

Delivery & Quality

  • Develop the technical roadmap collaboratively with the Project Manager, and contribute to its presentation in client and planning sessions.

  • Drive quality through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to secure development practices.

  • Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt before they impact delivery.

  • Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least five (5) years leading or performing on contracts/projects of similar size, scope, and complexity.

  • Experience migrating or consolidating content management platforms, including hands-on work with WordPress and Drupal - theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs across multiple systems and platforms.

  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party plugins, extensions, and commercial solutions to extend platform capabilities, with sound judgement about when an existing tool meets the need versus when custom development is warranted

  • Demonstrated experience working within enterprise environments and maturing or modernizing existing platforms.

  • Strong understanding of accessible development and design practices (Section 508, WCAG 2.1).

  • Proven track record leading technical teams, with strong mentorship and team-building skills.

  • Polished, confident communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to and building relationships with clients and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

    This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience developing for federal government clients or in a federal consulting environment.

  • Experience with Salesforce, including configuration, customization, and integration with external systems.

  • Cloud platform (AWS, Azure,) certifications.

  • Experience with DevSecOps practices in compliance-driven environments.

  • Knowledge of FISMA, FedRAMP, or other federal security frameworks.

  • Experience with content management system migrations or platform modernization efforts.

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

jobs.excerpt: About UsFlourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions.
jobs.description:
About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

Junior Salesforce Developer

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH GOVERNMENTAL PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL / TRIBAL / STATE / FEDERAL). IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE IN ADDITION TO SALESFORCE SKILLS, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

What do we mean by governmental public health? We're looking for people who have worked directly for a public health agency: a local health department, tribal health organization, state health department, or federal public health agency like CDC or HRSA. We require this because there's no substitute for the lived experience of navigating government systems, understanding the constraints public health staff face, and developing genuine empathy for the people doing this work. That empathy shapes how we build solutions.

SALESFORCE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE. We are looking for candidates who have hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform, not those looking to learn Salesforce from scratch.

Compensation Note: If a salary range is listed for this position, please note that we will be offering at the starting point of the band. We cover 100% of your health insurance!

Role Overview

We're seeking a Junior Salesforce Developer who brings more than technical skills. We need someone who understands public health and can translate that understanding into solutions that actually work for health department staff.

This role is about building technology that fits how public health actually operates. Your background in public health means you'll understand why a disease investigator needs to access data a certain way, or why a reporting workflow has to account for multiple jurisdictions. You won't just write code to spec. You'll build solutions that make sense because you've lived the work.

You'll be part of a collaborative team working on our PH360 platform and client implementations. You'll learn from senior developers and architects who are invested in your growth, while contributing your own public health expertise to help the team build better solutions. This isn't a role where you'll be coding alone in a corner. You'll be pairing with teammates, participating in design discussions, and helping ensure what we build truly serves our clients.

If you've ever looked at a public health technology system and thought "I could build something better," this is your opportunity.

How You'll Work

You'll be part of an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions, learning how technical roadmaps come together and contributing your public health perspective
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives
  • Pair Programming: You'll work alongside senior developers who will help you grow your technical skills
  • Team Problem-Solving: You'll be part of discussions where your understanding of public health workflows helps the team build better solutions

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow
  • Collaborate with senior developers and architects on solution design
  • Bring your public health perspective to technical discussions and design decisions
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives
  • Write clean, well-documented, testable code that follows team standards
  • Learn and apply Salesforce best practices through code reviews and mentorship
  • Help translate public health requirements into technical implementations
  • Ask questions, seek feedback, and continuously improve your craft

We’re looking for talented experienced estate agents with the drive to build their own business as a Territory Manager under the Yopa franchise.   • The autonomy to run your own business with flexible hours that fit your existing commitments, and the freedom to employ your own team.
  • No earnings cap - the only limit is your potential.
  • An in-house marketing team providing personalised support, with free money every month to spend on marketing materials.
  • Unique schemes that help you build your business’s visibility in the local area, such as Yopa’s successful Tech for Schools sponsorship programme.

  • Ongoing training and support from the Learning and Development team, mentorship from your Divisional Franchise Director, and regular meetings with fellow colleagues and business owners.

In return, we’re looking for estate agents who:

  • Already have strong experience in the world of estate agency, with a proven track record in valuing and listing homes, and who can confidently see the buying and selling journey through to completion.
  • Demonstrate exceptional levels of customer service, with the willingness to help customers outside of ‘office hours’ and go the extra mile for that sale.
  • Self-starters with the drive to build a long-term business that goes beyond the end of the month or the next paycheck.

If you’re a passionate estate agent who wants to own your own business, benefit from first-in-class support, and help build the future of estate agency, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Telehealth Mental Health Therapist – Remote

Please note: This is a state-specific application. If you are not currently licensed in New Mexico, we encourage you to visit www.affect.com to view our active openings by state.

If you do not see a current opportunity in your state, we still welcome you to submit your information through our General Application for Future Openings, also available on our website. We’d love to keep your details on file for future consideration.

About AffectBuilding on our success in substance use disorder care, Affect has expanded its services to include high-quality, accessible mental health treatment. Our model brings together licensed therapists, innovative technology, and a deeply human approach to help people manage anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges—on their terms.

As we grow, we’re seeking skilled, compassionate licensed mental health professionals to join our remote care team. If you're a New Mexico licensed LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LISW looking to make an impact through virtual care, we’d love to connect.

Our ability to provide supervision for non-independent mental health professionals varies by state and license, but we also encourage you to apply. We try to support non-independent licenses when possible.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct diagnostic assessments and collaboratively develop evidence-based treatment plans
  • Provide individual psychotherapy sessions via secure telehealth platforms
  • Support Members with a wide range of mental health needs, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship challenges with flexibility to work with members with substance use disorders at times.
  • Maintain clear and timely clinical documentation in our electronic medical record (EMR) system. Affect provides an AI-powered clinical scribe to assist with documentation, helping reduce administrative burden and allowing clinicians to spend more time focused on member care.
  • Coordinate care as needed and contribute to a supportive, multidisciplinary environment
  • Participate in clinical team meetings and optional case consultations
  • Adhere to HIPAA and all applicable state licensure regulations

Requirements:

  • Active and verifiable license from one of the following New Mexico licenses: LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, or LISW as well as your state of residence if it is not New Mexico. All credentials must be verified through the State Board’s website as part of the application process
  • Experience providing psychotherapy in outpatient, private practice, or telehealth settings
  • Strong communication and clinical skills with a person-centered, trauma-informed approach
  • Comfort with EMRs, Google Suite or Microsoft Office, and telehealth tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting with professionalism and integrity
  • Have a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace and reliable internet

The Benefits of Joining Affect

  • The salary range for this full-time position is $60,000 - $80,000 and will commensurate with experience and professional license.
  • Full-time employees may enroll in offered medical, dental, and vision coverage and employer paid life and disability insurance also provided. Employees may enroll in Affect's company’s 401k plan.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, company observed holidays and parental leave is provided to full-time employees.
  • Remote work options with full-time and part-time schedules
  • AI-powered clinical scribe technology to streamline documentation and reduce administrative workload
  • Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
  • Supportive team culture focused on impact, collaboration, and innovation
  • Be part of building a modern, inclusive, and accessible mental health care system

Join us as we expand our mission—empowering recovery, healing, and hope through digital-first mental health care.

jobs.description:
Statement of the Position:

Coordinates with the Funding Manager, Funding Supervisor, Branch Manager, Rehabilitation Technology Supplier (RTS), and other office support personnel to ensure all operational procedures are completed in accordance with company policy and within expected time frames. Responsible for the complete funding transaction cycle including Coding & Pricing, gathering information and documents pertinent to the funding package, ensuring that all documentation is in place, submission to the funding sources and collecting payer decisions including authorizations, denials, and deferrals.

Company Description:

At all levels, working at National Seating & Mobility provides the opportunity to directly impact our client’s lives by giving them self-reliance and independence. Our teams are comprised of passionate individuals, dedicated to providing the best care to each client. We focus on abilities by leveraging technology and creating mobility solutions that are as unique as our client’s needs.

Working at National Seating & Mobility is an opportunity to build a meaningful career, while leaving a lasting impact on the lives of those we serve. Located in more than 40 states, we strive for diversity and offer an array of benefits including 401k, company paid Long Term Disability, and tuition reimbursement.

Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions:

1. Manages transaction cycle time (TCT) from Ready to Process to Final Funding Approval, making certain that all necessary steps are taken in the appropriate order ensuring timeliness of process and quality of funding approval.

2. Obtains any required missing demographics and ensures that all client information (Minimum Documentation Requirement) is correct and is put into the work order.

3. Verifies client benefits and coverage and communicates benefit information to client.

4. Gathers and reviews documentation for funding package, including but not limited to: proper prescriptions, Letters of Medical Necessity (LMN), RTS evaluation information, price lists, forms (AOB, ABN, rent or purchase letter).

5. Communicates regularly with Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients in an effort to secure documentation as required by payer.

6. Communicates changes and escalations in the process and collects needed information from branch personnel, Referral sources, Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients.

7. Investigates and updates any payer requirements in the UPD.

8. Maintains communication with client throughout the process when applicable, including notifying them of financial responsibility.

9. Follows up with payer sources in order to obtain timely authorization, by properly working the Funding Work Queue.

10. Requests and obtains proper approval for work order credit exceptions.

11. Conducts pre-purchase quality assurance to ensure all approvals and requirements are met prior to purchase of equipment.

12. Conducts pre-delivery verification to ensure all approvals and requirements are met prior to delivery of equipment.

13. Coordinates with other funding areas and responsible for completing all tasks in the Action Required queue.

14. Performs any related job duties assigned by the Funding Manager or Funding Supervisor. Carries out all position expectations in a professional manner and with minimal supervision.

15. Responsible to complete all continuing education requirements to include assigned NSM University courses.

16. Must maintain regular and predictable attendance.

Work Environment:

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands repetitively to operate standard office equipment. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms.

Required Education, Experience, & Competencies:

  • 2 years’ experience in Complex Rehab Technology, Medical Billing, or Funding preferred
  • High school diploma or G.E.D.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee. He/She will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties requested by his/her supervisor.

Required:

  • Experience with Linux navigation, troubleshooting, and basic server operations.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
