Who we are:

CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

    • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
    • You will receive a competitive total rewards package.CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
      • Paid time off and Parental leave
      • Gym Reimbursement Program
      • Employee Assistance Program
      • Short-term & Long-term Disability
      • 6 floating Fridays (based on our eligibility rules)
      • CIEE Study Abroad Program discounts
      • 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
      • Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)
      • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts (medical and dependent)
      • Voluntary Benefits (identity theft protection, pet insurance, accident, and critical illness)
  • You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals. CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study-abroad locations, with facilities and staff in 30 countries.  Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year.  Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

The Sales Operations Coordinator serves as the operational systems and process expert for the Global Navigator High School Study Abroad team. This role owns and coordinates key operational workflows, including application management, enrollment processes, student systems, billing support, learning platforms, reporting, and process documentation. Working closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Information Technology, and cross-functional teams, the Coordinator ensures accurate execution of operational processes, provides timely support on customer and Sales inquiries, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency through systems and process improvements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically proficient, detail-oriented, and enjoys solving problems through process improvement and technology.

What you’ll do:

jobs.title: Sr. Scrum Master/Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!
jobs.description:
“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is the primary guiding authority for Agile ceremonies, structure, and delivery discipline across the engineering organization. This role sets and enforces the standard for how Agile is practiced organization-wide — directly coaching and overseeing a cohort of Scrum Masters across a broad portfolio of teams, while personally serving as the acting Scrum Master for a subset of teams to stay close to day-to-day delivery. The role owns the organization's Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework end-to-end, translating Jira and GitHub activity into trustworthy delivery and quality signals for engineering and business leadership. The Senior Scrum Master / Project Manager is also the primary Agile conduit between Product Management/Product Ownership and the engineering teams, ensuring scaled Agile practices connect roadmap intent to sprint execution cleanly and predictably.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1. Agile Program Leadership & Scrum Master Coaching

  • Set and enforce the standard for Agile ceremonies and structure across 12 teams; directly coach and performance-support 6–7 Scrum Masters.
  • Maintain a consistent Agile operating model (definitions of ready/done, estimation, cadences, escalation paths) across all teams.
  • Resolve cross-team delivery impediments and run a Scrum Master community of practice.

2. Direct Scrum Mastery

  • Act as Scrum Master for 2 assigned teams — ceremonies, backlog hygiene, and impediment removal — to stay grounded in day-to-day delivery.

3. Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework

Own, implement, and evolve a comprehensive Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework spanning sprint execution, code review discipline, and defect accountability — from first commit through production — using Jira and GitHub as the systems of record.

  • Implement and maintain core delivery metrics in Jira — velocity, sprint predictability, cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, scope creep, and carryover rate — at team, sprint, and rolling-quarter cadence.
  • Implement code review rigor metrics from GitHub pull request activity, including change-requested rate, rework commits per PR, review cycles to approval, time in review, and senior reviewer
  • comment density; partner with engineering leadership to maintain branch protection rules and senior-reviewer group definitions that keep this data complete.
  • Own the defect discovery-by-phase taxonomy on the Bug issue type in Jira (Unit/TDD, Code Review, Dev/Integration Testing, QA/Release Testing, Production/Escaped) and the resulting metrics: defect detection distribution, escape rate, production escape rate, phase containment effectiveness, defect density, and mean time to detect.
  • Maintain the escaped-defect attribution chain, linking each bug ticket back to its originating story/task, the merged pull request(s) that implemented it, and the author and reviewers of record, via Jira links and GitHub smart-commit/PR referencing, enabling accountability rollups in either direction.
  • Own the recurring per-release and quarterly Contractor/Team Accountability Rollup reporting cycle, and ensure trend lines (improving, flat, or worsening) are reviewed with the relevant teams and leads, not just presented in aggregate.
  • Own the reporting and BI delivery mechanic for the framework — including administration of eazyBI (or equivalent BI layer) connected to Jira and GitHub — to produce recurring dashboards and reports for engineering and business stakeholders without requiring a separate data pipeline.
  • Continuously refine the framework's guiding principles: metrics must be actionable, paired for balance (speed vs. quality), system-focused rather than individual-focused (with defect attribution as the narrow, explicitly scoped exception), trend-driven, diagnostic rather than target-driven, and passively instrumented from existing Jira/GitHub workflow artifacts.

4. Agile Conduit for Product Management

  • Serve as the primary Agile conduit between Product Managers, Product Owners, and the engineering organization, translating roadmap and portfolio intent into scaled Agile execution across the 12 teams.
  • Apply scaled Agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum@Scale, or the organization's equivalent) to coordinate cross-team dependencies, program increment / release planning, and backlog alignment between Product and Engineering.
  • Facilitate program-level ceremonies (e.g., PI planning, scrum-of-scrums, cross-team dependency reviews) that connect Product Owner intent with the delivery capacity and constraints of the 12 teams.
  • Provide Product Management and Product Ownership with visibility into delivery health and quality signals from the Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework to inform prioritization and roadmap tradeoffs.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Performance at this level is evaluated across four dimensions:

Agile Program Delivery

  • Ceremonies across all 12 teams consistently meet the organization's defined Agile standard, with impediments identified and escalated proactively rather than discovered after the fact.
  • The 2 directly run teams deliver predictably, with healthy sprint predictability and carryover metrics.

Metrics & Quality Accountability

  • The Agile Development Metrics & Quality Accountability Framework remains accurate, current, and trusted — data completeness (linkage, tagging, discovery-phase fields) is maintained across teams.
  • Reporting and BI dashboards are delivered on a reliable cadence and are actively used by engineering and business leadership in decision-making.

Organizational Impact & Coaching

  • Scrum Masters who report into this role demonstrably improve in facilitation quality, impediment resolution, and Agile maturity over time.
  • Escaped-defect and code-review-rigor trends across teams move in a positive direction release over release.

Leadership & Communication

  • Serves as a trusted, low-friction conduit between Product and Engineering, with dependencies and tradeoffs surfaced early rather than at the point of conflict.
  • Communicates delivery risk, quality trends, and program status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager in a professional software development environment, including experience coaching or leading other Scrum Masters.
  • Demonstrated experience running Agile ceremonies and delivery practices across multiple concurrent teams.

jobs.excerpt: Department: Victim Services Position: National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH) Volunteer FLSA Status: Not Specified (Not Applicable) About RAINNSince 1994, RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) has helped millions of people affected by sexual violence and we're just getting started.
jobs.description:
Department: Victim Services

Position: National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH) Volunteer

FLSA Status: Not Specified (Not Applicable)

About RAINN

Since 1994, RAINN (Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network) has helped millions of people affected by sexual violence and we're just getting started. As the nation's largest anti-sexual violence organization and operator of the National Sexual Assault Hotline (1-800-656-HOPE), we lead the fight against sexual violence by expanding prevention, ensuring justice, and providing healing to create safer communities.

Our mission is to stop sexual violence by supporting survivors, holding perpetrators accountable, and creating safer communities and we do it through three pillars:

Prevention — Educating the public and inspiring action through media, entertainment, and direct outreach

Justice — Leading bipartisan policy campaigns and working to hold every offender accountable

Healing — Providing free, confidential, 24/7 support through the National Sexual Assault Hotline, DoD Safe Helpline, and other programs

Volunteers are at the heart of this work. By joining RAINN, you become part of a movement that has answered millions of calls, shaped national policy, and given hope to survivors across the country.

If you or someone you know needs support, free and confidential help is available 24/7: call 800.656.HOPE (4673), chat at rainn.org, or text HOPE to 64673.

Position Summary

The National Sexual Assault Hotline (NSAH), operated by RAINN, provides live, secure, anonymous crisis support to the growing number of people who prefer communicating online through a simple instant message format, giving those affected by sexual assault a safe place to receive support.

NSAH volunteers are responsible for providing high-quality services to users of the National Sexual Assault Hotline, including but not limited to survivors of sexual assault and their loved ones. Volunteers also receive extensive and ongoing crisis-intervention training as well as professional development and coaching opportunities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Utilize crisis intervention best practices including safety planning, brainstorming, and listening skills to provide compassionate support to hotline users.
  • Complete regular training on serving NSAH users.
  • Answer inbound crisis-intervention online chats to NSAH users.
  • Support NSAH users and provide accurate referral services.
  • Maintain knowledge and adhere to RAINN's and NSAH's policies and protocols.
  • Assist with NSAH specific data collection by completing session assessments during each shift.
  • Attend and participate in any additional training for all NSAH volunteers.

Qualification Requirements

  • Tech-savvy with experience using instant messaging and digital communication platforms.
  • Ability to convey empathy over instant messaging.

  • Ability to type at least 35 words per minute.

  • Ability to work well under pressure and maintain composure during stressful situations; ability to handle shifting and multiple priorities.

  • Ability to solve problems and deal with a wide range of situations.

  • Ability to interpret a variety of written instructions.

  • Ability to exercise good judgment when faced with complex decisions.

  • Ability to receive and implement feedback.

  • Resiliently positive and energetic attitude, with the ability to successfully work on a team and independently.

  • Willingness to work a non-traditional schedule, including evenings and weekends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 1-year of professional experience in one or more of the following:
    • Working with vulnerable populations and/or survivors of sexual violence.
    • Working in human resources, social services, or customer service.
    • Crisis hotline/intervention experience (volunteer or paid position).
  • Experience using an online learning platform.
  • Both literate and fluent in Spanish writing and grammar skills.
    • Ability to pass a proficiency test given during the application process.

Evaluation

  • Volunteers receive real-time positive and constructive feedback from NSAH Staffers who supervise their interactions with hotline visitors.
  • Volunteers have the opportunity to schedule check-ins sessions with the volunteer management team as often as needed for chat debriefs or skill development.
  • Volunteers occasionally receive positive feedback from hotline visitors.

Time Commitment

  • All volunteers are asked to commit to a set-shift on the hotline. This shift is chosen from a weekly, bi-weekly or monthly upon review of the candidate’s application.
  • At least one year or 500 hours of volunteer service.

Training Information

Individuals who are approved will start an estimate of 50 hours of online training:

  • Complete and pass a 40-hour-long online training.
  • Attend and participate in 4 online, live-facilitated sessions, totaling 13 hours.
  • Complete a minimum of two shadowing sessions.
  • Complete practice simulations as assigned throughout training.
  • Complete transcripts or supervised sessions as final evaluation step by the clinical team.

Benefits

  • Volunteers who complete all required training are eligible for the National Advocate Credentialing Program (NACP). Application costs not covered.
  • Receive ongoing support and appreciation opportunities from the NSAH volunteer management team, including access to office hours and chat debrief sessions.
  • Provide much-needed support to survivors of sexual assault and their loved ones.
  • Receive extensive, ongoing, and up-to-date crisis intervention training; facilitated by RAINN professionals and completely free of charge.
  • Interact with experts in the field, an array of staff members, and other volunteers nationwide.
  • Work from the comfort of their own home.
  • Develop and continuously practice active listening skills.
  • Access to RAINN’s Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for emotional support and counseling referrals.

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants must be 18 years of age or older at the time of submission, possess a valid U.S. Social Security Number (SSN), and reside within the continental United States (excluding Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and U.S. territories). Upon approval for training, all onboarding volunteers must successfully pass a criminal background check, which is provided free of charge by RAINN.

jobs.title: Thought Leader Liaison, US Oncology, Central
jobs.excerpt: The RoleJoining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine.
jobs.description:
The Role

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.


Join Moderna as we work to transform the treatment landscape for patients with cancer through the development of individualized neoantigen therapies. In this field-based U.S. Oncology marketing role, you will lead regional thought leader engagement and advocacy strategies supporting brand strategy and launch planning for intismeran, an individualized neoantigen therapy being developed in collaboration with Merck.

As a strategic voice of the customer and regional oncology thought leader engagement expert, you will combine deep KOL relationships, specialized oncology market expertise, and evolving clinical, competitive, and customer insights to shape engagement strategies and generate actionable recommendations for U.S. brand strategy and launch planning.

Reporting to the Senior Director, US Commercial Launch Lead, you will lead regional cross-functional initiatives with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Alliance stakeholders, ensuring coordinated, compliant, and customer-centric engagement aligned with U.S. commercial priorities.


Here’s What You’ll Do

Your responsibilities will focus across three interconnected areas: KOL Engagement and Advocacy Development, Market Insights, and Speaker Bureau and Thought Leader Programs. All TLL interactions will be on-label and consistent with commercial compliance, legal, and regulatory guidelines.


KOL Engagement and Advocacy Development

  • Lead the development and execution of regional KOL engagement and advocacy strategies, using market dynamics, influence mapping, and centers of excellence to establish engagement priorities aligned with U.S. brand strategy and launch objectives.
  • Independently evaluate regional oncology market dynamics and KOL influence networks to identify strategic engagement opportunities and continually optimize regional engagement plans.
  • Identify, profile, cultivate, and maintain long-term strategic relationships with influential KOLs across the oncology community, including medical oncology, surgical oncology, and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary regional commercial marketing expert and point of contact for assigned KOLs, providing strategic guidance and coordinating cross-functional engagement initiatives.
  • Engage KOLs through on-label, compliant discussions focused on disease state, approved product information, and company-sponsored initiatives.
  • Develop and execute differentiated, on-label, approved KOL programming aligned with brand strategy and launch priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment of regional KOL engagement activities across Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Alliance stakeholders to enable coordinated and compliant execution.
  • Plan and lead KOL engagement initiatives across regional and local conferences, field visits, and other approved forums to strengthen customer relationships and advance regional advocacy objectives aligned with U.S. brand priorities.

Market Insights

  • Lead the identification, analysis, and synthesis of regional KOL, clinical landscape, and competitive insights, translating complex market information into actionable recommendations that inform U.S. brand strategy, positioning, and launch priorities.
  • Monitor evolving treatment paradigms, competitive dynamics, and customer needs to identify emerging opportunities and recommend adjustments to regional commercial engagement strategies.
  • Lead regional initiatives to obtain structured KOL feedback on approved marketing materials, programs, and messaging to support optimization and future development.
  • Serve as a strategic regional resource to the US Commercial Launch Lead and cross-functional Brand Team, bringing specialized oncology market expertise and actionable insights to brand strategy, launch planning, and regional customer engagement priorities.
  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Alliance stakeholders to support integrated commercial planning and customer engagement priorities.
  • Identify and recommend appropriate HCP consultants, in partnership with internal stakeholders, to address evolving brand and launch needs.
  • Build familiarity with Moderna’s approved Generative AI and digital capabilities where appropriate, exploring how these tools can accelerate compliant insight synthesis, identify patterns across complex market information, and enhance the quality and speed of strategic decision-making while maintaining required human oversight and applicable compliance standards.
  • Speaker Bureau and Thought Leader Programs
  • Lead the planning, execution, and evaluation of speaker bureau and thought leader programs within the assigned region, establishing engagement priorities while ensuring alignment with U.S. brand strategy, launch objectives, and compliance requirements.
  • Identify and recommend promotional speakers based on strategic engagement priorities, regional market dynamics, and brand objectives.
  • Coordinate speaker onboarding, training, and development activities using approved promotional materials, including observing and coaching speakers where appropriate to support compliant program execution.
  • Oversee regional speaker program performance, evaluate effectiveness, and recommend improvements to optimize engagement outcomes and execution.
  • Lead the development and execution of regional advisory board plans, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and translating resulting insights into actionable recommendations for brand strategy and launch planning.
  • Partner with Marketing and other internal stakeholders to support the development and optimization of approved speaker materials and ensure effective planning, execution, and follow-through of marketing-led programs.

The key Moderna Mindsets you’ll need to succeed in the role:

  • “We act with dynamic range, driving strategy and execution at the same time at every step.”
  • “We behave like owners. The solutions we’re building go beyond any job description.”

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including demonstrated experience in a Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) or equivalent field-based commercial thought leader engagement role
  • Oncology experience required
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic KOL engagement plans and build long-term relationships with influential HCPs and KOLs
  • Strong understanding of commercial compliance and regulatory requirements
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders in a complex, matrixed environment
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex market insights into actionable commercial recommendations
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and initiatives
  • Willingness to travel extensively within assigned territory
  • Ability to travel up to 75%


Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent) preferred
  • Solid tumor oncology experience, preferably in melanoma, non-melanoma skin cancers, or non-small cell lung cancer
  • Oncology launch experience, particularly in novel or complex therapeutic modalities
  • Experience contributing to brand strategy and launch planning through KOL insights and regional market expertise
  • Experience with speaker bureau management, advisory boards, and thought leader engagement programs

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $167,000.00 - $300,700.00(for positions that may be performed in California, the expected salary range is $227,850.00 - $262,150.00, which reflects the range permitted under California Labor Code requirements) . This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.

jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Headquartered in San Diego, California, Inseego Corp.
jobs.description:
Headquartered in San Diego, California, Inseego Corp. (Nasdaq: INSG) is an industry pioneer in intelligent device-to-cloud solutions that extend the network edge, enabling wireless coverage, multi-gigabit data speeds, low latency, and security to deliver highly reliable internet access. Our innovative mobile and fixed wireless access (FWA) solutions incorporate the most advanced technologies (including 5G, 4G LTE, Wi-Fi 6, SD-WAN, SASE, and others) into a wide range of products that provide robust connectivity indoors, outdoors, and in the harshest industrial environments. Inseego products and SaaS solutions are designed and developed in the USA.

Position Overview:

The Supplier Quality Engineer ensures that all components, materials, and assemblies sourced from suppliers meet Inseego’s, and the customer’s, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and performance specifications. This role also evaluates and validates the contract manufacturer’s quality management system, production processes, and overall production quality. The Supplier Quality Engineer is a cross‑functional position supporting operations and engineering, focused on safeguarding the quality and reliability of Inseego products. This position works closely with procurement, engineering, and operations teams to drive continuous improvement and maintain high manufacturing standards.

This is a remote position, based out of Taiwan.

Responsibilities:

  • Assess and qualify suppliers based on technical capability, quality systems, and production capacity.
  • Conduct detailed capability evaluations and risk analyses for both new and existing suppliers.
  • Maintain the Approved Vendor List (AVL) through regular audits, KPI monitoring, supplier QBRs, and qualification/disqualification recommendations.
  • Provide ongoing reporting and visibility into the vendor mix used in production.
  • Collect, maintain, and analyze supplier quality data (IQC, QC, OQC, FPY, FYR, FAI, RCCA) to identify improvement opportunities and required corrective actions.
  • Regularly visit key component suppliers to validate quality data and processes in person.
  • Work closely with contract manufacturers to ensure their IQC, QC, OQC, FPY, and FYR results align with supplier‑reported quality data.
  • Partner with CMs to identify and implement process improvements that drive continuous improvement and elevate quality KPIs above Inseego targets.
  • Travel regularly between CMs and key suppliers to provide on‑site support to resolve quality issues based on priorities, KPIs, quality data, and production demand.
  • Spend the majority of time embedded within CMs and key component suppliers to ensure real‑time quality oversight.
  • Collaborate with Quality, RL, and Repair teams to align supplier and CM KPIs with expected field performance.
  • Ensure adequate incoming inspection processes are in place at CM/ODM sites to verify material compliance.
  • Work with CM/ODM teams to ensure their quality engineers, inspectors, auditors, analysts, and technicians are performing duties as required.
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to support production and process improvements.
  • Analyze factory and field failure data, recommend corrective actions, and support or lead initiatives to improve product quality.
  • Conduct failure analysis and corrective actions with suppliers using industry‑standard methodologies such as FMEA and 8D.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of experience as a Supplier Quality Engineer, preferably within the telecom or consumer electronics industry.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with ODMs and CMs across design, supplier management, and manufacturing quality.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem‑solving, and management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Track record of driving continuous improvement and achieving quality targets by working cross‑functionally with Engineering, ODM/CM partners, and Operations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior management, suppliers, and customers.
  • Agile self‑starter capable of working both independently and collaboratively.
  • Ability to travel regularly (up to 75%) throughout Asia, both locally and internationally, with additional travel to the U.S. 2–3+ times per year.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, mechanical or industrial engineering or relevant commensurate experience.
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), and/or ISO Auditor certifications are strongly preferred.

Location: Remote, Taiwan

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

At Devoted, we understand that building trust hinges on our ability to pay claims accurately and on time, and to clearly communicate those outcomes to our members and providers. The Senior Manager, Claims Adjudication Logic will be the subject matter expert on how our claims move through the system: the rules that determine whether a claim auto-adjudicates or pends for manual review, how claims are matched to the correct provider contract, and how outcomes are communicated through Explanations of Benefits (EOBs), Explanations of Payment (EOPs), and remittance advice. This person will own the accuracy, integrity, and strategic direction of our claims back-end logic.


The ideal candidate is a curious, detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys tracing a claim from intake to payment, takes ownership of issues from discovery to resolution, and thinks strategically about how to build a more accurate, automated, scalable, and cost-effective claims operation.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Auto-Adjudication Strategy & Performance: Own our auto-adjudication rate as a core operational metric. Develop a deep understanding of the flags and pend reasons that route claims to manual review. Evaluate each for business value, accuracy, and operational cost. Partner with engineering to retire, refine, or automate flags that no longer serve their purpose, and design new ones where risk warrants human review.
  • Contract Group Matching: Serve as the go-to expert on how claims are matched to provider contracts and contract groups, including provider identifiers, TIN/NPI relationships, network status, effective dates, and contract hierarchy. Identify and resolve mismatches that lead to incorrect payment, and partner with Provider Operations and Network to ensure the intent of contracts is aligned with claims processing.
  • EOB & EOP Logic: Own the logic that generates member EOBs and provider EOPs, ensuring they accurately reflect adjudication outcomes, member cost share, and denial or adjustment reasons. Ensure member-facing communications meet CMS requirements and are clear and understandable, and that provider-facing communications give providers what they need to reconcile payments.
  • Claims Remit Support: Serve as the subject matter expert on remittance outputs, including 835/ERA files and payment reconciliation. Support providers, Provider Services, and Engineering in resolving remit issues caused by claims processing, and drive fixes to root causes rather than one-off workarounds.
  • Issue Identification & Root Cause Analysis: Proactively identify adjudication, matching, and communication errors, lead root cause analysis, and drive sustainable fixes in collaboration with Engineering, Claims Operations, and Network/Provider Operations.
  • Accuracy & Governance: Establish and own the framework for measuring claims logic performance, including auto-adjudication rate, manual adjudication rates by reason, contract match accuracy, EOB/EOP accuracy, and remit-related provider inquiries. Build the audits, validation testing, KPIs, and reporting that give leadership confidence in our payment outcomes.
  • Proactive Optimization: Look ahead to regulatory changes, new contract structures, and emerging technology to recommend improvements that reduce manual touch, payment errors, provider abrasion, and operational risk.

Required skills and experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in business operations or operational leadership
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a willingness to dive deep complex claims system logic to fully understand how things work
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex claims logic to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated success in driving meaningful change and measurable operational results in fast-paced environments, with a bias toward action and a focus on continuous improvement
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience building and developing KPIs, and the ability to work with large claims datasets to diagnose adjudication outcomes and quantify operational and financial impact
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives at once

Desired skills and experience:

  • Curiosity and hands-on experience with AI tools, automation, or LLM-based workflows in operational settings is highly desired
  • Knowledge of health insurance claims processing, particularly Medicare Advantage, including adjudication workflows, provider contracting, and regulatory and compliance requirements
  • Experience partnering with Engineering on rules-based systems, workflow design, or claims platform development


Salary range: $110,500 - $150,000 annually

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

DecisionPoint seeks a Mission Liaison / Requirements Analyst to support Navy and Marine Corps accession-processing requirements for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role works directly with Government mission owners, accession-processing stakeholders, users, business analysts, software teams, testers, trainers, and other technical personnel to translate mission needs and business rules into actionable software requirements.

The Mission Liaison / Requirements Analyst elicits and documents requirements, develops user stories and acceptance criteria, and maintains traceability throughout the software-development lifecycle. The analyst also supports sprint demonstrations, user acceptance testing, feedback triage, training updates, and the development of user guidance.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Mission Liaison / Requirements Analyst will:

  • Engage Navy, Marine Corps, USMEPCOM, and other Government stakeholders to understand accession-processing needs, workflows, constraints, and business rules.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and maintain functional and mission requirements.
  • Translate operational needs and business rules into clear, actionable user stories, use cases, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Work with mission owners, product stakeholders, developers, testers, and trainers to clarify requirements and resolve questions.
  • Maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and ensure traceability among mission needs, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, defects, training materials, and released capabilities.

  • Identify conflicting requirements, workflow gaps, dependencies, risks, and unresolved stakeholder decisions.

  • Verify that delivered capabilities satisfy approved requirements and documented acceptance criteria.
  • Support updates to user guides, job aids, training materials, release notes, and other user-facing documentation.
  • Coordinate with training personnel to ensure that materials accurately reflect approved workflows and released functionality.
  • Assist with release-readiness activities, operational validation, and communications to affected mission stakeholders.
  • Prepare meeting materials, briefings, decision papers, workflow documentation, meeting minutes, and status reports.
  • Maintain organized and accurate requirements artifacts in Government-approved repositories and collaboration platforms.
  • Support continuous improvement of requirements-management, traceability, user-feedback, and acceptance processes.

  • Experience developing and refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience maintaining requirements traceability across the software-development lifecycle.

At FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation, we’re redefining innovation across the industries we touch—from healthcare and photography to semiconductors and data storage. With roots in photosensitive materials and a legacy of groundbreaking technology, we now lead 23 diverse affiliate businesses across the Americas.

We’re looking for mission-driven talents eager to join us to help create, market, and support a vast portfolio of products. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Draft, negotiate, and handle a variety of strategic and complex corporate transaction documents, contracts, and legal memos, and develop standard-form agreements, templates, playbooks, and checklists, including but not limited to: confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent, letters of interest, memoranda of understanding, exclusivity agreements, due diligence request lists, process letters, non-binding offers, issue lists, stock purchase agreements, disclosure schedules, transition services agreements, intellectual property assignment agreements, technology transfer agreements, asset purchase agreements, bills of sale, assignment and assumption agreements, manufacturing supply agreements, merger agreements, term sheets, shareholder agreements, voting agreements, intra-company service agreements, joint venture agreements, joint development agreements, IP license agreements, RSU/option plan assumptions, executive employment contracts, credit agreements, commitment letters, loan agreements, promissory notes, closing checklists, subscription agreements, investors’ rights agreements, equity agreements, financing agreements and security documents, secondment agreements, and employment/retention agreements related to transactions.

  • Oversee or handle new mandated filings, including Individuals with Significant Control (ISC) registers in Canada and Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) reports in the U.S. Draft and manage board resolutions, meeting minutes, and written consents for both parent and subsidiary boards to maintain corporate governance compliance. Develop and implement best practices and templates for transaction documentation and due diligence processes.

Laylo powers drops for some of the world’s biggest creators and brands. Drops have become the predominant marketing strategy for merch, tickets and content and we're building the leading CRM to power them. The platform combines landing pages, messaging, link tracking, and more to empower musicians, artists, celebrities, creators and brands with the tools to drive more sales and streams around their most important moments.

As a full stack engineer, writing code and building beautiful user experiences is just one part of your job. You'll also talk to users, get involved with design, and develop your own opinion on what needs to exist in the world. Then you'll move with urgency to make it happen.

To learn more about how we work, take a look at [Our Values]()

Laylo now powers over 5 million drop messages per month across music, podcasting, sports, fashion, gaming, among other categories. Notable customers include Sam Smith, Dixie D'Amelio, Kodak Black, Miles Teller, The Black Keys, and Zach Bryan.

To learn more about how we work, take a look at [Our Values]()

### What will you do?

  • You'll work with a small engineering team to build mission-critical tools for creators.
  • As one of our first engineers, you'll build entirely new products from scratch and make important architectural decisions.
  • You'll be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing entire projects end to end, from idea to launch. To do so, you'll have to work closely with design, operations, and (of course) creators.
  • You'll help build the foundation for Laylo engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
  • Creators are the most visual people on the planet -- you'll build a user experience that is both visually stunning and easy-to-use.
  • As we grow, we'll build up an engineering team around you.

### We're looking for someone who:

  • Cares about culture and wants to build something meaningful. The tools we create will empower the next generation of entrepreneurs, and we take that responsibility seriously.
  • Enjoys all aspects of building a product from scratch. You love talking to customers just as much as making technical decisions.
  • Understands the importance of both speed and quality, and the trade-offs of choosing one over the other.
  • Has 3+ years experience with frontend development, preferably with hands-on experience with React, Typescript, and Apollo
  • Familiarity with mobile responsive design and component architecture are a plus
  • Wants to join a tight-knit team -- we work on solutions as a whole engineering team. If you love working on the end-to-end product experience, you'll love working here.

### Other Roles:

If this role isn’t a fit for you but you’d like to work with us, find all of our open roles [here](Laylo-2ec9dd8c363e4d36b0dd20c736131606).

### About Us:

Our founders met while building competing consumer startups. We’ve launched multiple products across consumer and SaaS and talked to thousands of fans and creators in the process. In 2020, we realized one of the biggest pain points creators and brands have is building high conversion drop experiences and engaging with their fans.

We went through Y Combinator in summer 2020 while building that new product and after seeing really strong early traction, raised our seed round in mid 2021.

Right now we're a small team that's mostly based in Los Angeles but working from remotely with other team members in various states. We're open to hiring remotely (in North America), but expect to find an office in Los Angeles at some point TBD.

We have a strong written documentation culture, leveraging Notion to share ideas and record processes and learnings. We try to do as much as possible asynchronously to move quickly and efficiently. We have a daily 30 minute standup and operate across Slack, Notion & Figma.

In this pivotal role, you will champion safe, coordinated transitions across care settings—helping patients stay healthy at home, reduce avoidable hospitalizations, and experience truly continuous, high-quality care.

You will serve as a vital connector between post-acute transitions and ongoing, integrated nursing support, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and empowered every step of the way. This is an opportunity to make a tangible difference in patients’ lives while practicing at the top of your license.

You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven multidisciplinary team that includes Physicians, Advanced Practice Clinicians, Health Advocates, Social Workers, Behavioral Health Clinicians, Psychiatrists, Pharmacists, and Patient Experience Navigators. Working closely with both local and centralized teams, you’ll deliver patient-centered care through a blend of virtual and telephonic services tailored to meet each patient’s unique needs.

As our innovative care model continues to grow and evolve, this role offers the opportunity to grow with it, helping shape the future of integrated, home-based care.

      • Identifying clinical, behavioral, and social barriers to recovery or stability and coordinate appropriate follow-up care and referrals
      • Providing patient remote monitoring support when needed to ensure recovery and prevent decompensation
    • Support proactive and longitudinal interactions for high-risk patients with frequent utilization to prevent avoidable inpatient and emergency department visits

    • Collaborate closely with interdisciplinary care team members to ensure continuity of care aligned with patient goals and values
    • Coordinate with external partners, including hospitals and community providers, to support safe discharge planning and reduce readmissions
    • Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation in the electronic medical record
    • Utilize electronic data tools and dashboards to prioritize work, manage patient outreach, and monitor care outcomes

Other Job Functions

    • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and provide feedback on workflows and program design
    • Participate in team meetings, trainings, and occasional in-person team-building activities
    • Performs other duties as assigned

What makes you a fit for the team:

  • Deep commitment to caring for complex, historically underserved populations with compassion and dignity
  • Comfort operating across care settings and adjusting between virtual, in-home, and transitional care workflows
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to work independently while remaining highly collaborative
  • Passion for patient education, empowerment, and behavior change
  • Excitement about contributing to an evolving, innovative, value-based care model
  • Ability to adapt quickly, learn continuously, and contribute to team-based problem solving

Decision making authority:

Desired skills and experience:

  • Required
    • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in state of employment and willingness to obtain additional licensure as requested
    • 2+ years of experience providing care to adult and/or geriatric patients with complex chronic medical conditions
    • Demonstrated experience in transitions of care, including post-discharge follow-up, medication reconciliation, and care coordination
    • Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and care coordination skills

Drive positioning, define joint pursuit approaches, and design comprehensive security and governance offerings for AI/Agent adoption, integrated with Wiz and the broader Google Security portfolio.

  • Architect Team Leadership: Directly lead and mentor the Executive Enterprise Architect team. Leverage deep Google tenure, technical credibility, and key relationships to unblock technical barriers and accelerate execution on critical, complex pursuits.

  • Asset & Offering Development: Drive the creation of robust services offerings and highly marketable GTM assets (including workshops, marketing collateral, industry-specific solutions, and Gemini Enterprise security blueprints) to position Accenture as Google’s undisputed security partner of choice.

Executive Governance & Operating Rhythm

  • Governance Forums: Establish and lead high-level governance and leadership forums between Accenture and Google/Wiz, setting agendas and steering key strategic decisions.
  • Operating Rhythm & Reporting: Formulate and run the overall business operating rhythm, including executive-level pipeline reporting, operational business reviews, and decision-making frameworks for senior Accenture and Google leadership.
  • Accountability & Resolution: Hold cross-functional and regional leaders accountable to their strategic commitments. Act as the primary escalation point to resolve operational blockers and cross-market conflicts.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Marketing & Executive Engagement: Partner with Marketing & Comms to orchestrate strategic campaigns, high-impact executive roundtables, and a strong physical presence at major global industry forums (e.g., RSAC, Google Next, FS-ISAC).
  • Commercial & Legal Structuring: Lead complex commercial structuring and negotiations alongside Commercial and Legal teams, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), custom procurement structures, subcontract frameworks, cloud metering, billing, and global pricing/discounting models.
  • Enablement & Capability Build: Define clear operational priorities for GTM leads, focusing on pipeline-aligned training, professional certifications, and targeted offering development.

Partner Investments

  • Investment Strategy & Negotiation: Formulate and execute the joint investment strategy with Google and key ecosystem partners. Lead high-stakes negotiations to secure co-investments and funding targets (Target: $X).
  • Business Case Formulation: Build highly structured, analytical investment business cases directly linking requested funding to pipeline growth, capability build-out, and credentialing.
  • Deployment & ROI Accountability: Maintain strict accountability for the deployment and return on investment (ROI) of secured funding, providing routine status and performance reports directly to the Global Partner Lead (Kevin) and Google executive leadership.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

  • Minimum of 12 years of general business experience across marketing, sales, security product management, customer relationship or general business budget & investment management (P&L oversight or managing to a hard sales target in cybersecurity at $20M + highly preferred).
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in Cybersecurity spanning cloud security, security operations, threat intelligence, or security governance
  • Minimum of 3 years of direct experience in Partner/Alliance Management, Ecosystem Sales, or Channel Management within a top-tier global systems integrator (GSI) or a leading cloud provider.

Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.

jobs.description:

Come Join ReSource Pro!

Your Role...
ReSource Pro is seeking a Sr. Consultant, Customer Success & Delivery, Propellint to lead high-complexity insurance technology and data initiatives and serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders. All remote positions are based in the United States,
and candidates must reside within the U.S. to be eligible for consideration.

In this role, you will...

  • Lead end-to-end business requirements activities, from stakeholder workshops through validation and approval
  • Own scope, prioritization, dependency mapping, and change control in partnership with delivery leadership
  • Lead implementations from kickoff through go-live across client, internal, and third-party teams
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for delivery risks, issues, and client concerns
  • Advise client leadership as the insurance domain expert across policy, claims, billing, and underwriting
  • Mentor business analysts and consultants and contribute to delivery standards and best practices

What You Need to be Successful...

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 10-15 years of experience in business analysis, consulting, insurance operations, or technology implementation
  • Hands-on insurance operations experience (claims, underwriting, policy, billing) strongly preferred
  • Proven experience leading complex system implementations
  • Demonstrated ability to engage senior stakeholders and executive leadership
  • Expert-level business analysis, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving; able to connect technical solutions to operational impact
  • Ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives independently, with a high level of initiative and accountability
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and providing clear, structured guidance in evolving environments
  • Preferred: CPCU, AIC, CBAP, PMI-PBA, or similar insurance or analysis credentials
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, domestic
  • Technological proficiency – able to learn, utilize, and navigate a variety of external and internal systems
Your Compensation...
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes annual bonus eligibility, benefits, and other opportunities at ReSource Pro. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity relative to other ReSource Pro employees. This is a remote position, and the salary range for most locations for this role is $122,000-$209,000 per year. The salary range may vary based on experience and on the specific geographic location in which the candidate resides.

Your Benefits & Perks...
  • 100% paid employee health insurance available on Day 1
  • Eligible for all medical, dental, and vision benefits on Day 1
  • Remote positions are Internet stipend-eligible
  • 401k with employer match, vested on Day 1
  • HSA/FSA available
  • Long Term and short-term disability employer-provided
  • Generous PTO plan with paid holidays + floating holidays
  • Development and growth opportunities
  • Comprehensive wellness program and prioritization of employee health
Your Interview Process...
To be considered for this position, please submit your application. If you meet the qualifications for the role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to schedule an interview via zoom.
The standard interview process includes:
  1. Behavioral interview with Talent Acquisition
  2. Online talent assessment
  3. Hiring Manager interview
*Additional interview steps may be added depending on the position or if further evaluation is needed.

Disclosure: Candidates are evaluated at each step of the process. As a result, not every candidate will complete all steps in the process.

About ReSource Pro:

Focused exclusively on the insurance industry, ReSource Pro is the trusted partner insurance organizations rely on to optimize performance, streamline operations and process engineering, and drive growth. Serving 2,000+ carriers, brokers, wholesalers, and MGAs, ReSource Pro is a recognized market leader in insurance workflow optimization, data and technology services, and strategic operating model transformation.   • Experience integrating platforms such as Autodesk, Esri ArcGIS, Bentley, Deltek Vantagepoint, or enterprise content management systems.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Collections Analyst II manages an accounts receivable portfolio of Commercial & Industrial natural gas and electricity supply customers. This role works to resolve delinquent customer balances and collaborates with internal and external partners to verify compliance with company policies while reducing bad debt and protecting the company from negative financial exposure. The position supports both pre- and post-payment collections activity across a wide range of businesses, markets, and billing arrangements, and the analyst is expected to recommend appropriate actions based on company policies.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manages an assigned portfolio of C&I accounts, proactively contacting customers by phone and email to secure payment of outstanding balances.
  • Reviews aging receivables to identify delinquency trends, account-specific issues, and potential bad debt, and recommends appropriate disposition of balances.
  • Positively collaborates with internal stakeholders to research and resolve complex billing and payment disputes, payment discrepancies, etc. to resolve customer delinquencies.
  • Negotiates/establishes payment or payment arrangements within the policy framework and escalates exceptions to the Collections Lead and Senior Manager.
  • Actively documents customer contacts, payment commitments, and account actions accurately in CRM and billing systems.
  • Fully verifies credit and collections policy compliance and completes related tasks as requested by internal staff, team and organization leadership, etc.
  • Engages actively to become a collections subject matter expert to engage in addressing process, policy, or compliance questions from any internal teams.
  • Escalates credit decisions, collection agency referrals, bankruptcies, and legal matters as required to the Lead and Senior Manager with supporting analysis and recommended actions.
  • Monitors customer payment behavior and energy market developments that affect C&I risk and reports emerging concerns to the Lead.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

Required Skills:

  • Demonstrates strong analytical and quantitative skills, including interpreting aging reports and account data.
  • Maintains a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail with a bias to urgency in all activities.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally with customers and internal partners
  • Navigates difficult payment conversations with tact, persistence, and professionalism.
  • Consistently manages and prioritizes multiple accounts and deadlines independently in a remote or hybrid setting.
  • Uses CRM and billing systems to research, update, and document customer accounts.
  • Demonstrates proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications, with advanced Excel skills.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Holds a degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; equivalent skills and experience are equally valued.
  • Brings at least two years of collections experience, ideally in a commercial credit & collections environment with additional experience with credit, fraud, and bankruptcy preferred.
  • Understands bad debt accounting and collections fundamentals with experience using collections software preferred.
  • Experience in energy, utilities, or a related industry preferred.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Product департаменту шукаємо Market Research Supervisor.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • управління командою Market Research: планування навантаження, розподіл задач, постановка цілей, контроль виконання та розвиток дослідників;

  • організація повного циклу маркетингових досліджень: від отримання запиту та визначення бізнес-цілей до презентації результатів і рекомендацій;

  • планування та пріоритизація дослідницького backlog з урахуванням бізнес-цілей, ресурсів, термінів і залежностей;

  • контроль якості досліджень на всіх етапах: методологія, вибірка, інструментарій, збір та аналіз даних, висновки й фінальні матеріали;

  • забезпечення своєчасного delivery досліджень: управління дедлайнами, проактивне виявлення ризиків, своєчасна ескалація блокерів;

  • взаємодія зі стейкхолдерами: уточнення запитів, узгодження очікувань, регулярне інформування про прогрес і презентація результатів;

  • розвиток напрямку Market Research: дослідження нових GEO, аналіз ринків, конкурентного середовища, поведінки та потреб цільових аудиторій;

  • перетворення дослідницьких результатів на структуровані висновки та практичні рекомендації для бізнесу;

  • розвиток дослідницьких процесів: стандартизація методологій, документації, звітності та управління базою знань;

  • ініціювання автоматизації рутинних процесів і впровадження інструментів для підвищення ефективності команди;

  • регулярна звітність щодо прогресу, результатів, завантаження команди та виконання погоджених цілей.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • досвід у Market Research / Consumer Insights / UX Research / Service Design від 3 років, зокрема практичний досвід проведення кількісних і якісних досліджень;

  • досвід управління дослідницькою командою або координації роботи декількох дослідників;

  • глибоке розуміння методологій досліджень: опитування, глибинні інтерв'ю, desk research, конкурентний аналіз, сегментація аудиторії, дослідження нових ринків;

  • досвід самостійного планування та ведення декількох паралельних дослідницьких проєктів із відповідальністю за терміни, якість і результат;

  • уміння формулювати research questions на основі бізнес-запитів, обирати відповідні методи та оцінювати методологічні обмеження;

  • навички аналізу кількісних і якісних даних, синтезу інсайтів і формування обґрунтованих висновків;

  • сильні навички підготовки дослідницьких звітів і презентацій: пріоритизація висновків, executive summary, чіткі рекомендації для бізнесу;

  • розвинені комунікаційні навички: управління очікуваннями стейкхолдерів, конструктивна робота зі зворотним зв'язком, аргументація рішень;

  • системність, самостійність, відповідальність за домовленості та проактивність у вирішенні проблем;

  • досвід постановки задач, делегування, контролю результатів і надання конструктивного feedback команді;

  • досвід роботи з інструментами управління задачами та дослідницькою документацією;

  • англійська мова на рівні Upper-Intermediate (B2) або вище.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід досліджень міжнародних ринків;

  • досвід у iGaming, FinTech, Entertainment або інших висококонкурентних B2C-індустріях;

  • досвід роботи із зовнішніми дослідницькими агентствами, панелями респондентів і міжнародним рекрутингом;

  • досвід побудови або вдосконалення Research Operations, систем управління знаннями та стандартів якості;

  • практичний досвід автоматизації дослідницьких процесів із використанням AI, no-code інструментів або скриптів;

  • знання статистичних методів аналізу даних і досвід роботи з BI-інструментами;

  • досвід управління дослідницькими бюджетами та оцінки ефективності досліджень.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

Forvis Mazars Next Evolution of Accounting Resourcefulness (NEAR), is comprised of team members who provide centralized services for the firm’s assurance, tax and advisory practices. The NEAR team supports the firm by performing tasks that are generally lower risk, repetitive, and sometimes administrative in nature. The ideal candidate will enjoy working with team members across the firm and they will focus on productivity and innovative solutions to deliver quality work products to our teams. Through NEAR, team members are trained and developed to continually take on more meaningful work and provided opportunities to continue advancing their careers and required educational credentials.
As a seasonal position, this position has flexible hours as mutually agreed upon by Forvis Mazars. We ask for a commitment of at least 30 hours per week, but 40 hours or more would be preferred. This is a fully remote work opportunity.

What You Will Do:

In this role, you will primarily be responsible for augmenting Forvis Mazars tax engagement teams in applying tax laws, regulations, and accounting principles to prepare and review individual and trust tax returns while delivering outstanding internal client service.

  • International and state tax return experience a plus
  • Learn/use Forvis Mazars tax technology applications through on-the-job training

  • Coach and develop NEAR Associate and Sr. Associate I staff through the review of their work.
  • Independently manage multiple workflows and deliver quality work timely.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting
  • 3 years or more of tax accounting, preferably within a large public accounting environment
  • Supervisory experience
  • Tax return review experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • GoSystem and SurePrep experience
  • CCH Axcess experience
  • CPA or EA certification

Hey there!

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly.

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.
  • You will have participated in the launch of one of our new microservices, from 0 to production.
  • You will mentor other team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • You will participate in some of the team-building we organise for your team or the whole engineering team.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of good practices, testing, and design patterns.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Handling services with high concurrency and high-volume requests.
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • You are proficient in business English

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
    • Base Salary: 50K - 75K EUR
    • Total Compensation: 67K - 90K EUR (Including Base, Variable, and Stock Options)

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

  • Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
  • Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.
