jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an AI/ML & MLOps Engineer to lead the architecture, deployment, monitoring, automation, and governance of production machine learning capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an AI/ML & MLOps Engineer to lead the architecture, deployment, monitoring, automation, and governance of production machine learning capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This SME-level position will maintain training, validation, and testing datasets; design and operate production ML architectures; automate model deployment; monitor model performance and drift; and control updates to models, datasets, pipelines, and supporting configurations. The engineer will establish reproducible, traceable, and secure processes for moving machine learning capabilities from development through validation and into production.

The AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will work closely with mission owners, data scientists, data engineers, cloud architects, software developers, cybersecurity personnel, testers, and operations teams. The successful candidate must combine advanced machine learning engineering knowledge with production automation, secure cloud architecture, data governance, and operational monitoring expertise.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will:

  • Lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and supportable production machine learning architectures.
  • Develop, maintain, and govern training, validation, and testing datasets used for model development and evaluation.
  • Establish repeatable processes for dataset ingestion, preparation, transformation, labeling, validation, versioning, and approval.
  • Ensure datasets are maintained in or transformed into analysis-ready and model-ready formats.
  • Implement controls for dataset quality, completeness, integrity, provenance, lineage, security, and authorized use.
  • Design and automate end-to-end ML pipelines covering data preparation, training, evaluation, packaging, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
  • Deploy machine learning models into approved cloud, application, analytical, and operational environments.
  • Establish automated model build, test, validation, promotion, deployment, rollback, and recovery procedures.
  • Implement model registries and controlled repositories for model artifacts, dataset versions, code, configurations, dependencies, evaluation results, and approvals.
  • Develop automated tests for model pipelines, data transformations, interfaces, deployment packages, and production behavior.
  • Define model evaluation frameworks, performance thresholds, validation criteria, and release-readiness requirements.
  • Evaluate model accuracy, reliability, robustness, performance, scalability, security, and alignment with documented mission requirements.
  • Implement production monitoring for model performance, data drift, concept drift, inference quality, latency, availability, errors, and resource utilization.
  • Establish thresholds, alerts, escalation paths, and response procedures for model degradation, drift, data-quality issues, and operational failures.
  • Investigate model and pipeline anomalies and coordinate corrective actions with data, application, infrastructure, security, and mission teams.
  • Control updates to production models, datasets, features, pipelines, configurations, and dependencies through documented review and approval processes.
  • Maintain traceability among source datasets, data transformations, model versions, evaluation results, deployment records, and production outcomes.
  • Develop rollback and recovery procedures for models, datasets, pipelines, and supporting services.
  • Support secure data pipelines used for AI development, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and operational decision support.
  • Implement technical controls supporting model and data governance, including version control, separation of environments, approval gates, auditability, and change management.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation covering model purpose, training data, evaluation methods, limitations, dependencies, approvals, changes, performance, and known risks.
  • Support the evaluation and auditing of model outputs to identify inaccurate, unsupported, or unexpected results.
  • Help establish human-review checkpoints and escalation procedures for model outputs that could materially affect mission or operational decisions.
  • Support compliance with applicable Government data-handling, cloud-security, cybersecurity, and operational-risk requirements.
  • Integrate model development and deployment workflows with continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and incident-management capabilities.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to address vulnerabilities, access controls, secrets management, software dependencies, logging, encryption, and authorization requirements.
  • Coordinate with data warehouse and data engineering teams on data models, metadata, Extract-Transform-Load processes, data quality, and governed access.
  • Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code and design reviews, troubleshooting support, and knowledge transfer.
  • Prepare architecture diagrams, model lifecycle documentation, deployment procedures, monitoring plans, test results, operating guides, and technical reports.
  • Communicate model performance, drift, risks, incidents, corrective actions, and deployment status to technical teams, Government stakeholders, and program leadership.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, engineering, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience leading the architecture of production machine learning systems.
  • Experience designing and operating production ML or MLOps environments.
  • Experience developing and maintaining training, validation, and testing datasets.
  • Experience establishing model-evaluation methods, performance measures, validation criteria, and acceptance thresholds.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models into production environments.
  • Experience automating model build, test, deployment, promotion, rollback, or retraining processes.
  • Experience implementing model and data drift monitoring.
  • Experience with model governance and data governance.
  • Experience controlling model, dataset, pipeline, and configuration updates.
  • Experience with cloud-based machine learning platforms or production cloud architectures.
  • Experience implementing model, dataset, code, artifact, and configuration versioning.
  • Experience building or integrating automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous delivery capabilities for machine learning systems.
  • Experience monitoring production model performance, reliability, and operational health.
  • Understanding of secure data pipelines, access controls, audit logging, encryption, secrets management, and software supply-chain security.
  • Ability to establish traceability across datasets, transformations, model versions, evaluation results, deployments, and operational outcomes.
  • Ability to document and communicate model limitations, performance, drift, risks, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate or a comparable machine learning platform certification.
  • Advanced AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or comparable cloud architecture or data engineering certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience operating machine learning capabilities in regulated, controlled, or mission-critical environments.
  • Experience with MLflow, Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Kubeflow, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with containerization, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Experience implementing feature stores, model registries, metadata repositories, experiment tracking, or data-lineage tools.
  • Experience with observability platforms, automated alerting, incident response, and production reliability engineering.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI, explainability, output validation, human oversight, bias evaluation, and model-risk management practices.
  • Familiarity with DoD Impact Level 4 or comparable Government cloud and data-protection requirements.
  • Experience with analytical models, generative AI, retrieval workflows, or agentic AI systems.
  • Experience leading technical teams, architecture reviews, or cross-functional ML delivery initiatives.

Skills

  • Production machine learning architecture.
  • MLOps engineering and lifecycle automation.
  • Model deployment and serving.
  • Training, validation, and testing dataset management.
  • Model evaluation and performance measurement.
  • Model and data drift monitoring.
  • Model, data, and configuration governance.
  • Automated testing and deployment pipelines.
  • Cloud ML platforms and secure data pipelines.
  • Version control, traceability, and audit documentation.
  • Production monitoring and incident troubleshooting.
  • Cybersecurity and access-control implementation.
  • Technical leadership and architecture communication.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with mission, data, software, cloud, security, testing, and operations teams.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Nuclear & Radiological Security Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Nuclear & Radiological Security Experts to support a customer’s initiative focused on defining standards for nuclear-safety evaluations, information abstraction, and escalation protocols. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Define evaluation scope and standards for nuclear and radiological safety, nonproliferation, and security.
  2. Develop frameworks for safe abstraction of sensitive or classified information in technical contexts.
  3. Establish robust escalation thresholds and protocols for handling nuclear security risks in research and operational scenarios.
  4. Contribute expert guidance on benchmarking nuclear and radiological risk assessments, ensuring effective nonproliferation safeguards.
  5. Review, refine, and validate technical guidelines for nuclear/radiological safety in support of advanced-model training.
  6. Collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders to ensure safety standards protect national and global security interests while enabling legitimate scientific progress.
  7. Document best practices and decision rationales for information security and compliance in nuclear domains.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 5+ years of relevant experience in nuclear physics, radiological safety, nonproliferation, or nuclear safeguards (ideally 8–20 years for senior contributors).
  2. Advanced degree, professional certification, or equivalent operational experience in nuclear or radiological domains.
  3. Proven background with government agencies, national laboratories, regulatory bodies, or academic research in nuclear security or policy.
  4. Thorough understanding of nonproliferation frameworks, international safeguards, and weapons-relevant controls.
  5. High credibility and recognition in nuclear or radiological safety communities.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for diverse audiences.
  7. Experience contributing to or overseeing security evaluations, compliance protocols, or risk assessments within sensitive technical environments.

jobs.description:
Thrivent Financial Advisor

Meaningful work. Rewarding career.

Make an impact providing expert financial advice with heart. Thrivent is a different kind of financial services firm, one that puts generosity at the center of saving and investing. Here, you’ll make an impact in the lives of the people you serve, helping them build, grow and protect financial well-being through purpose-based advice, investments, insurance, banking and generosity.

At Thrivent, you’ll receive the support, stability and opportunity of a Fortune 500 leader. We offer up to 14 weeks of paid training and coaching as you obtain your state insurance licenses (life, health & variable contracts), Series 7 and 66 registrations, and complete Thrivent’s comprehensive advisor onboarding program. After onboarding, you’ll have control over the income you earn, as you’ll be paid through commissions and incentives based on your success.

Job Description

As a Thrivent Financial advisor, you’ll:

  • Build a financial practice guiding Christians on their journeys to financial clarity, empowering lives of service and faith.
  • Provide personal, actionable and achievable advice and connect clients to Thrivent products and programs.
  • Develop and maintain genuine, long-term relationships throughout generations based on trust and understanding, with the ability to serve clients in your chosen community.
  • Make client appointments by leveraging your network and Thrivent’s reputation, delivering award-winning financial workshops and marketing your practice.
  • Have the flexibility to control your schedule, allowing for work-life balance.
  • Find a collaborative culture with colleagues who want you to be successful and are willing to help you do so.
  • Get the support of specialists from every facet of the organization—such as business development, marketing, technology, engagement, and experienced advisors—as you build your business.

Desired Characteristics

Our culture and our people are special. We’re looking for people who are – or want to become – part of the communities where clients live, work and worship. Whether you’re a seasoned financial professional or looking for a career change, you could be a successful Thrivent Financial advisor if you’re:

  • Self-disciplined, independent and driven to succeed.
  • Motivated by helping others and seeing them achieve their goals.
  • A natural coach or guide with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Passionate about living a life of generosity by serving others, not just selling products.

Successful Thrivent financial advisors have come from a variety of career backgrounds, including outside sales, business management, education, ministry, hospitality, military and more. Skills acquired in these fields transition well into the financial advisor role.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Military veterans are encouraged to apply.
  • Attainment of FINRA SIE, life and health licenses (licensed role only) before contracting.
  • Satisfactory background check, fingerprinting and securities registration and/or insurance licensing verification, if applicable.

Compensation and Benefits
You’ll get all the benefits of a Fortune 500 organization and more. Here, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited earning potential through biweekly base commissions, bonus opportunities and incentive pay structures, recurring revenue streams, and dedicated planning fees for those who qualify.
  • Medical, dental, vision, disability and accidental death and dismemberment insurance.
  • Pension, 401(k) and retiree medical plans.
  • Ongoing support, training and opportunity for professional growth as you build your business.
  • Well-being programs to help you manage your physical, emotional and financial health.
  • Gift matching program to double your contributions to eligible nonprofit organizations and volunteer programs that support your efforts to make a difference.
  • Membership programs that help you connect with your clients and engage Christians to make a real impact in your community.

About Thrivent
Thrivent is a diversified financial services organization that, with its subsidiary and affiliate companies, serves more than 2.4 million clients, offering advice, insurance, investments, banking and generosity products and programs. For more than 100 years, Thrivent has been helping Christians build their financial futures and live more generous lives. jobs.description:
Job Title: Enterprise Sales Executive (Hunter Multimodal)

Company: TA Services
Department: Commercial / Enterprise Sales
Reports To: Nicholas Shroeger Head of Commercial Strategy
Locations: Open nationwide (role requires regular travel; location agnostic)

Compensation

Base Salary:

  • Target range $125,000 $150,000, depending on experience and size of prior portfolio.

Variable Compensation:

  • Commission paid from dollar one; no draw required.
  • Commission is margin-based.
  • Higher commission percentage for new business (first 2 years).
  • After 2 years, accounts convert to existing and earn a different commission tied to gross margin growth.
  • Designed to reward constant new customer acquisition and sustained account expansion.

About the Company

TA is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial transportation and logistics provider undergoing strategic expansion under new commercial leadership. Backed by a strong foundation, differentiated service capabilities, and a culture rooted in agility not bureaucracy. TA is building a mature, enterprise-level sales organization focused on long-term growth, vertical specialization, and multimodal solutions. The Executive leadership team prioritizes hiring exceptional talent, building scalable processes, and delivering customer-centric solutions across modes.

Position Overview

TA is seeking experienced, relationship-driven Enterprise Sales Executives who can bring direct shipper relationships, an active or recent book of business, and the ability to generate new multimodal freight customers. This role is not account management. TA is intentionally seeking hunters capable of opening mid-market to enterprise accounts and scaling them over time.

The ideal candidate has a deep background in transportation sales, sells multimodal solutions, and has proven success landing mid to large-cap shippers. The company is specifically targeting sales professionals with direct customer portfolios, not those whose business is primarily with competing 3PLs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a strategic plan to acquire and grow mid-market and enterprise shippers.
  • Leverage existing relationships and past portfolio experience to rapidly onboard new customers.
  • Drive new business development prospecting, cold outreach, networking, and customer-facing meetings.
  • Maintain CRM discipline, pipeline reporting, and high-level customer relationship management.
  • Travel regularly for customer visits, quarterly business reviews, and in-person strategy sessions.
  • Expand existing accounts after they are landed, ensuring relationship retention and incremental growth.
  • Operate across multimodal offerings (truckload, intermodal, LTL in the future, etc.).
  • Support vertical expansion efforts (e.g., automotive, CPG, industrial).

Target Candidate Profile

  • Proven track record selling to mid-market and enterprise shippers.
  • Existing customer relationships that could realistically transition to TA.
  • Experience selling across multiple modes (truckload is core; LTL background is not required).
  • Strong hunter mentality not afraid to prospect, challenge, and win new logos.
  • Prior book of business that is customer-direct, not primarily through competing 3PLs.
  • Ability to travel frequently; comfortable being in front of customers regularly.
  • Polished, strategic, and skilled in relationship cultivation.

Not a fit: Pure LTL sellers or talent whose book is heavily dependent on competitors (e.g., Echo, RXO, Robinson) rather than direct shippers.

Performance Expectations

Year 1 Minimum Goal:

  • $5 million in new business revenue (considered a minimum, not a stretch).

Longer-Term Expectation:

  • Build a portfolio that ultimately drives ~7x margin relative to salary (mature stage, typically year 3 and beyond).

What Success Looks Like

  • A large portion of the new business originates from your existing relationships or recent customer interactions.
  • You consistently funnel high-value new accounts into TAs network.
  • You help TA build vertical strength automotive first, followed by expansion into CPG and additional sectors.
  • You embrace the entrepreneurial culture and thrive outside large-corporate bureaucracy.

Additional Notes from Hiring Leader

  • Location does not matter talent can live anywhere since travel is expected.
  • TA is intentionally building a more sophisticated enterprise sales structure and is prioritizing relationship-based sellers who understand strategic, multimodal selling.
  • Timing matters: certain modes (e.g., LTL) are not yet mature enough to fully support LTL-heavy sellers, but this will change over time.
  • TA plans to hire 34 sellers in 2025, staggered through Q1Q3.

Why This Role Is Compelling

  • High autonomy, low red tape, and a leadership team that values entrepreneurial thinking.
  • Strong runway for growth the company is actively building toward the $1B revenue milestone.
  • Direct access to commercial leadership; decisions are fast, strategy is evolving, and top talent is genuinely valued.
  • Major upside for sellers who can bring business or land new enterprise accounts.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

SENIOR DATA ANALYST — WORKFORCE PLANNING

CenterWell Pharmacy, a Humana company

ABOUT THE ROLE
Every prescription CenterWell Pharmacy fills depends on a chain of people being in the right place at the right time. The Workforce Planning team makes sure that capacity exists before the demand arrives. The team conducts long-term forecasts that impact hiring, mid-term capacity plans that shape staffing strategy, and short-term plans that hold service levels week to week.

If you have done demand planning or S&OP for a physical supply chain, this is the same discipline — our constrained resource is licensed, trained people instead of inventory.

We are building this function from the ground up. The architecture, the metrics, and the tooling are not decided yet, and we are hiring two Senior Data Analysts to help decide them.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Turn messy, multi-source operational data into planning inputs the business can act on

  • Partner with operations, finance, and department leaders to understand what they actually need to decide

  • Build the tooling and data products that let planners and leaders answer their own questions

  • Bring rigor to how we measure ourselves — forecast accuracy, capacity use, cost per prescription, and the drivers underneath them

TWO WAYS IN

Every analyst here shares the work above. Beyond it, you will anchor in one of two focus areas.

Focus Area 1 — Data Engineering & Architecture

You would own how planning data reaches the people who use it — the pipelines that consolidate workforce, volume, and operational data across platforms, and the models our forecasting tools run on. You have built ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud data environment (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar), work fluently in Python, and know dimensional modeling and data warehouse design.

jobs.title: Jr. AI Native Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The opportunityAt Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth.
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

Why Valtech?

At Valtech, we are transforming how people experience the world through technology. Our culture is built around a mindset to make, learn and grow, bringing together technology, creativity and experience to solve meaningful business challenges. [valtech.com]
AI is rapidly changing what it means to build software, and we want people who are excited to be part of that change.
We are looking for an AI Native Engineer who has spent the last few years building strong software engineering foundations while actively exploring what's possible with AI. You are someone who didn't wait for AI to become part of your job description. You started experimenting, building, breaking things and learning.
You may have built an agent because you wanted to understand how agents actually work. You may have experimented with several models to understand their strengths and limitations. Maybe you've created a RAG application, automated part of your development workflow, contributed to an AI project, or simply spent countless hours turning new ideas into working prototypes.

That curiosity matters to us.

If you're an engineer who sees the emergence of AI as an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how software is built, we'd like to meet you.

The role

As an AI Native Engineer, you'll work with multidisciplinary teams to design, prototype and build intelligent digital products and experiences.
You'll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI capabilities, working across large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, APIs, cloud platforms and emerging development tools.
Importantly, you'll help us discover what's next.
The AI landscape is moving quickly. We don't expect you to have all the answers. We expect you to be excited about finding them.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and ship AI-native applications and experiences for real-world use cases.
  • Build applications using large language models, generative AI APIs and agentic architectures.
  • Develop high-quality software using Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or comparable modern languages.
  • Work with models and platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and open-source models.
  • Build RAG and knowledge-retrieval solutions using embeddings, semantic search, vector databases and enterprise data.
  • Experiment with AI agents, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration and multi-step workflows.
  • Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, existing platforms and enterprise systems.
  • Rapidly prototype new ideas, test assumptions and turn promising experiments into scalable solutions.
  • Build approaches for evaluating and testing AI systems, considering quality, accuracy, reliability, latency and cost.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to explore new ways of designing, developing, testing and maintaining software.
  • Apply sound engineering practices around security, privacy, responsible AI, observability and human oversight.
  • Share what you're learning and contribute to the evolving AI engineering practices across Valtech.

What we're looking for

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering or application development experience.
  • Strong programming experience with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or another modern programming language.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including application architecture, APIs, testing, debugging, version control and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience building with generative AI, whether through client work, production applications, prototypes, internal innovation, hackathons, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
  • Practical experience working with LLMs and model APIs, including prompting, context management, structured outputs and model selection.
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, semantic search or vector databases.
  • Exposure to agents, function/tool calling or AI workflow orchestration.
  • Experience connecting applications to APIs, data sources, databases and cloud services.
  • An understanding that building a great AI demo and building a dependable AI product are two very different challenges.
  • Most importantly, a demonstrated habit of exploring emerging technology and turning your curiosity into something tangible.

We'd love it if you've...

We don't expect you to check every box. You might have:
  • Built your own AI application, agent, copilot or developer tool.
  • Experimented with multiple models and learned where each performs well, and where it doesn't.
  • Built RAG solutions using real-world or enterprise data.
  • Explored agentic architectures, tool use or multi-agent workflows.
  • Worked with frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph or LlamaIndex.
  • Used technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or Weaviate.
  • Built applications on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Used tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Cursor as part of your engineering workflow.
  • Created evaluations or testing approaches for AI outputs.
  • Participated in AI hackathons, internal innovation initiatives or open-source communities.
  • Seen a newly released AI capability and thought,“I need to try that.”
Specific frameworks will come and go. We're more interested in how you learn, what you've built and what you've discovered along the way.

You are

A builder.
You don't just read about AI. You build with it. You're comfortable moving from an idea to a prototype and learning through experimentation.
An explorer.
New models, multimodal experiences, agents, reasoning systems and AI development tools genuinely interest you. You're energized by a technology landscape where the playbook is still being written.
An engineer.
You care about what happens after the demo. Reliability, maintainability, architecture, security and testing matter to you.
A pragmatic thinker.
You understand that AI isn't the answer to every problem. You're interested in finding where it creates genuine value, not adding AI for AI's sake.
A learner.
You won't know every new model, framework or technique. That's okay. What matters is being able to say:“I haven't worked with that yet. Let's figure it out.”

What you can expect from us

You'll join an environment where experimentation and continuous learning are part of how we work. You'll collaborate with people across engineering, data, experience and strategy, and have opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to meaningful client and business challenges.
Valtech currently recruits across AI-focused roles alongside engineering, cloud, data and digital experience disciplines, reinforcing that AI is being embedded within the broader technology organization rather than existing solely as a standalone specialty.
You'll have room to make, learn and grow, while helping shape what AI-native engineering means at Valtech.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Ruby on Rails)
jobs.excerpt: About WunderWunder is building a Modern Energy Company.
jobs.description:
About Wunder

Wunder is building a Modern Energy Company.

We were founded with one simple vision: to address the greatest crisis of our generation by accelerating the deployment of solar energy. In doing so, we help businesses, municipalities, and schools save money by delivering clean on-site power. We convert simple warehouses into electrified industrial platforms built for the future. We enable the nation’s leading commercial and industrial real estate firms to capture the benefits of solar across their properties. We align ESG goals with revenue targets, and the renewable energy assets we’re deploying today will power America’s tomorrow.

Wunder is actively developing hundreds of commercial solar projects across the country. Our team has evaluated more than 30,000 properties for solar across all 50 states to meet our customers where they are. Our customers have a national footprint and so do we. Wunder’s proprietary technology platform enables us to develop solar at scale, across a portfolio that includes everything from self-storage facilities and schools to data centers and industrial logistics facilities. Our average solar system—about 430 kilowatts in size—can offset 350,000 pounds of coal burned each year of system operation!

The Role

At Wunder, we're building a team of high-performing, effective, and sophisticated engineers. We come from a wide range of backgrounds, but regardless of where we come from, we all agree that the most fun we've had as engineers is when we're working on challenging problems surrounded by peers who are dependable, ambitious, and supportive.

With that in mind, we have an amazing opportunity for an experienced, intellectually curious, and creative Senior Backend Engineer to join our fast-growing company. Like the rest of us, this person will wear many hats; you will work closely with our founders, our product team, and Wunder’s various teams of finance and solar experts. Your role, broadly speaking, will be to solve problems and push renewable energy forward. Specifically, you will work alongside our talented team of engineers to bring automation to our solar development, solar value evaluation, and loan servicing systems.

Your typical week might involve:

  • Writing, reviewing, and maintaining code primarily written in Ruby (Rails + Hotwire)
  • Developing and maintaining our CI/CD pipeline which allows our team to rapidly deploy well-tested code to production multiple times per day
  • Solving complex problems inherent to our domain with our unique blend of Rails’ best practices, functional principles, and service-oriented design
  • Working with our Product team to identify high-leverage solutions to help Wunder achieve its mission
  • Shaping our architectural philosophy and technical direction by exploring nascent technologies or problem spaces new to Wunder
  • Enjoying unallocated, flexible time for deep work, collaboration, or attending to the important non-work aspects of life (the engineering team has 5 hours of “no meeting zone” per day.
  • Establishing the way in which our team and processes evolve as Wunder embarks on its next phase of rapid growth

If you’re looking to build the next iPhone app for teenagers or the next SaaS product for agencies, this role isn’t for you. But if you obsess about your users (at Wunder, they’re often your teammates), are passionate about solving complex problems on a daily basis, and want to fight climate change, then this is the role for you!

Want even more information on what it's like being on the Software Engineering Team at Wunder? Click here for the Wunder Engineering Handbook.

About You

  • You’re a Builder - You have called yourself a hacker/dev/engineer for 5+ years, during which you’ve dug deep into designing and building high-quality backend systems. Our stack includes Ruby on Rails, Hotwire, PostgreSQL, Heroku, AWS, and CircleCI. While in depth knowledge on each of these is not required, some understanding is useful.
  • You Know What You’re Doing - You should be excited to work on a high-output team, be challenged, and do the best work of your career.
  • Excited About Cleantech - You are motivated to build technology which drives our clean energy future and, ideally, you are familiar with building the systems necessary to facilitate assessment, development, and management of energy assets.
  • You have a Team Ethos - You thrive in a creative, inventive, fast-paced rapid-growth environment, with people who are passionate about their work and mission. You’re not just excited to work cross-functionally, you demand it.
  • You Believe That No Problem is Too Hard - In an industry where people are constantly stuck, we find ways to get it done. You know how to articulate and roll out solutions, recognizing there are many solutions to the same problem. You find new and effective ways to streamline and create processes to increase efficiency.

Some Benefits To Look Forward To

Wunder provides one of the only tangible opportunities to truly save the planet - and that’s hard work! Your job impacts nearly every facet of your life, so we provide an extensive compensation and benefits package to ensure Wunder has a positive impact on your life, both personally and professionally.

Salary & Equity

The base salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 per year, plus equity in the form of stock options. Wunder determines the successful candidate's compensation package throughout the interview process based on experience and expertise, and the final compensation package will be discussed with the candidate during the final stages of the interview process.

Benefits & PTO

Wunder truly cares about your happiness and well-being, so we strive to ensure our benefits offerings are of top quality. We offer the following benefits to all team members:

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental & vision insurance for all team members
  • 50% employer-paid medical, dental & vision insurance for dependents
  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability & life insurance
  • 401k Matching (50% match up to 4% of your base salary)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) & Dependent Care FSA
  • Up to 14 weeks fully paid Parental Leave for childbearing parents; 6 weeks fully paid Parental Leave for non-childbearing parents
  • 11 paid holidays & unlimited PTO

Culture

Wunder believes connecting with your team members is instrumental to job satisfaction and your ability to solve complex problems, and facilitating opportunities that support team cohesion is more important than ever! You’ll find our team taking coffee walks or collaborating on Zoom, while also cycling, hiking, climbing, skiing, camping, and dining all over our mile-high home: Colorado. Here are some of the ways we facilitate a flexible yet cohesive work environment:

  • A big, bright, modern office located in Downtown Boulder; in-office meals and a fully stocked kitchen
  • Commitment to diversity, equity & inclusion through company principles, programs, and events (see below for even more details)
  • In-person & virtual events, team offsites, and company retreats
  • Annual professional development budget and unlimited book budget
  • And so much more!

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)

Wunder is focused on providing a happy, productive workplace, and we’re constantly improving it! We’re committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace in which all team members have an opportunity to contribute to the success of our mission. At Wunder, people are valued for their skills, experiences, and diverse perspectives, and we encourage all individuals to apply, even if they don’t check every box in the ‘About You’ section above.

Our commitment to equity is embodied in company policy, but it’s also evident every day in how we conduct business and the internal initiatives and programs we provide for our team. Here are some of the ways we strive to ensure everyone feels welcome, safe and free to be themselves at Wunder:

  • A holistic, actionable DEI learning strategy that enables all team members to advance inclusivity in a meaningful way
  • Inclusive, objective recruiting processes and partnerships with diverse candidate pools & organizations
  • Monthly Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), events and initiatives focused on inclusivity
  • Equitable Compensation Principles that ensure every team member is paid fairly and equitably
  • An environment that values feedback, active listening, flexibility and open communication

jobs.title: General Manager, Healthcare Practices
jobs.excerpt: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
jobs.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.
- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.
- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.
- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

    Flex is hiring a General Manager to build and run its healthcare practices business. You own the sector end to end: the strategy for winning it, the relationships and partnerships that open it, the product priorities it needs, and the P&L it produces. You build on Flex’s platform, balance sheet and teams, and you are responsible for making Flex the primary financial institution for healthcare practices.

    The role is modeled on sector coverage at an investment bank. You decide which relationships matter, which partnerships can move hundreds of owners onto Flex at once, and what the product must deliver to win them. Flex’s product, credit, risk and member experience teams execute and service alongside you. The role reports directly to the CEO.

    Healthcare practices are a large, fragmented and fast-consolidating owner market: independent physician, dental, aesthetic, veterinary and specialty practices, and the DSOs, MSOs and sponsors rolling them up. Practices carry steady receivables, significant supply and equipment spend, and frequent ownership transitions, and they decide where to bank on the advice of GPOs, lenders, brokers and the software they run on. The General Manager owns that circle.

What You'll Do

  • Own the sector P&L. You are accountable for one number: owners in healthcare practices banking with Flex and the revenue they generate. You build the model behind it, report against it weekly, and answer for it.
  • Map the sector and cover it. Within 90 days you have identified the 200 people who move healthcare practices and have a coverage plan for each. From then on, that is where your time goes.
  • Originate. Bring owners and firms to Flex directly, through dinners, site visits, conferences, portfolio days and referrals. You represent Flex in your sector and you are expected to be present in it.
  • Structure the partnerships that move the sector. A GPO or buying group. A DSO or MSO standardizing its practices on Flex. A practice-management or EHR integration. An equipment-lender or practice-broker referral program. A specialty society. You identify them, negotiate them, and own the relationship after signature.
  • Set the product agenda for your sector. You tell product leadership what owners require before they will move their primary banking relationship, in what order, and why.
  • Build the team as the book grows. You begin with Flex’s account executives, account managers and member experience team supporting you. When the pipeline exceeds what one person can cover, you hire and lead your own sector team.
  • Work AI-native. Research, relationship tracking, outreach and modeling run on tools you build or adopt, so your time goes to relationships.

Requirements

  • 7 to 12 years in investment banking, private credit, private equity, venture, or a senior commercial seat inside healthcare practices. You have a demonstrable record of originating business, not servicing it.
  • An active network in healthcare practices. You can name the 50 people who matter and most of them would take your call this week.
  • Fluent in practice economics: payer mix, collections cycles, supply and equipment spend, how practices are bought and sold, and who lends to them.
  • Comfortable structuring partnerships, negotiating referral economics, and working through a term sheet without support.
  • You build your own models. Banker-level Excel and a working understanding of the unit economics of deposits, cards and credit.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in fintech, banking or lending, or selling a financial product to business owners.
  • A standing in healthcare practices: a podcast, a newsletter, a conference stage, or a board seat at a trade body.
  • Investing, advisory or operating experience in a company in healthcare practices.

How To Prepare

    As part of the application, please be prepared to submit a one-pager along with your CV on how you would bring healthcare practices to Flex. It should cover:
  • The sector and its owners. Who they are, how many of them fall in Flex’s range, how they make money and where their capital gets tied up.
  • What they need from a bank. The products and terms that would make owners in the sector move their primary relationship, and in what order.
  • The map. The 20 to 30 people and institutions that move the sector, and how many of them you know personally.
  • The first three partnerships. The programs that would put hundreds of owners on Flex at once, and why each counterparty would say yes.
  • The investment and the return. A light P&L for the sector: what Flex would need to put in over the first two years (people, product, partnership economics, marketing) and how that investment comes back, in the form of owners banking with Flex and the revenue they produce. We are looking for the shape of the business and the logic behind it.
  • The plan and the team. How you will build this out and what you will need to do it.
    • Treat it as a coverage pitch. Bring the map, the partnerships and the economics, and be ready to defend each one.

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.
Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.
Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.
True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.
Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.
High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.
Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.
Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition & Retention Specialist

Position Overview

The Talent Acquisition & Retention Specialist owns the full employee lifecycle at Ayoroa Simmons, LLC (A|S), from sourcing and hiring through onboarding, development, and retention. The role reports to the CEO and supports a 30+ person team of licensed surveyors, geomatics technologists, BIM and architectural technicians, UAV operators, and project managers across Lexington, KY, Nashville, TN, Washington, DC, and Puerto Rico. A|S is growing through new offices, federal contract awards, and teaming partnerships, and this role builds the workforce capacity that growth requires. It suits a self-directed HR generalist who builds programs from the ground up and represents the firm credibly to technical candidates in the AEC and federal contracting markets.

Key Responsibilities

Growth and Workforce Planning

  • Communicate regularly with executive leadership, project managers, and directors to monitor contract, client, and project requirements that will affect staffing needs, and respond with hiring timelines and headcount plans
  • Translate the firm's growth plan, including new office openings, contract awards, task orders, and joint venture work, into workforce forecasts reviewed with the principals
  • Build local candidate pipelines and recruiting relationships ahead of entry into new markets
  • Develop staffing plans in support of RFQs and RFPs in coordination with executive leadership, project managers, and directors, including key personnel, contingent hires, and letters of commitment
  • Maintain a current library of team resumes, organized and formatted (including SF 330 Section E) so marketing and proposal staff can access and use them in pursuits
  • Research labor markets, compensation benchmarks, and licensing requirements in target geographies and advise the principals on workforce cost and availability
  • Scale onboarding, EDP, and HR processes so each new office and remote team operates on the same standards
  • Identify the point at which added HR or recruiting headcount is warranted and present the case to the CEO

Talent Acquisition

  • Partner with the principals and division leads to forecast hiring needs by office, service line, and contract
  • Draft and maintain job descriptions aligned with the Employee Development Plan (EDP) career ladder
  • Run sourcing and recruiting as an ongoing, year-round effort through job boards, LinkedIn Recruiter, university programs, professional societies, and the employee referral program, with weekly performance metrics (outreach volume, new candidates added, screens completed, interviews scheduled, offers extended) tracked and met
  • Maintain an active candidate pipeline for each recurring role, organized by position and location in the applicant tracking system and vetted through screening so qualified candidates are ready when a need opens
  • Screen applicants, coordinate technical interviews with hiring managers, and keep candidates informed at each stage
  • Prepare offer packages using the Total Compensation Calculation workbook and coordinate offer letters with the principals
  • Manage the applicant tracking system, reference checks, and pre-employment requirements, including eligibility documentation tied to federal and DoD work
  • Represent A|S at career fairs, SAME and industry events, and campus recruiting visits

Onboarding and Retention

  • Run the onboarding program for office, remote, and field staff, with 30, 60, and 90 day check-ins
  • Administer the EDP: maintain career ladder documentation and coordinate promotion reviews with division leads
  • Coordinate the performance review cycle, including timelines, templates, and manager guidance
  • Conduct stay interviews, exit interviews, and engagement surveys; recommend action to the principals
  • Support training and certification planning (PLS licensure, UAV Part 107, software credentials, CMMC and CUI awareness)
  • Administer recognition, referral, and incentive compensation programs under the firm's compensation policies

HR Operations and Reporting

  • Maintain personnel records, organizational charts, and the employee handbook with the Business Manager
  • Coordinate benefits enrollment and renewals and answer employee benefits questions
  • Support compliance with EEO, FLSA, ADA, FMLA, and state employment law in Kentucky, Tennessee, DC, Maryland, Virginia, and Puerto Rico, including federal contractor reporting
  • Track time-to-fill, offer acceptance rate, cost per hire, turnover, and engagement; report monthly to the principals and maintain the HR section of the management scorecard

Success Profile

A strong Talent Acquisition & Retention Specialist treats sourcing as continuous work, meets weekly recruiting activity metrics, fills technical roles ahead of project need, keeps candidates engaged through an offer acceptance rate of 80% or higher, and delivers each new hire into a documented onboarding path with a clear supervisor handoff. Retention work shows in voluntary turnover below the AEC industry benchmark, promotion reviews completed on the firm's cycle with documented evidence, and engagement survey results that lead to action. The specialist staffs each new office, contract, and task order on schedule, so growth is paced by opportunity instead of hiring capacity. Growth in this role shows through increasing ownership of workforce planning and people programs with the principals involved at decision points only.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field; candidates with demonstrated equivalent experience are welcome to apply
  • Three or more years of experience in talent acquisition, HR generalist work, or a combined recruiting and retention role
  • A record of filling technical or professional positions (engineering, surveying, architecture, GIS, IT, or similar) with evidence of improved time-to-fill or retention
  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment law, EEO reporting, and federal contractor HR requirements
  • Experience with an applicant tracking system, LinkedIn Recruiter, and HRIS platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with sound judgment in handling confidential information
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Teams, SharePoint)

Preferred

  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification
  • Recruiting experience in the AEC, geospatial, or government contracting sectors
  • Experience building an onboarding, career ladder, or performance program from the start
  • Bilingual, English and Spanish, in support of the firm's Puerto Rico subsidiary

Professional Conduct

Represents A|S with professionalism to candidates, universities, and industry partners; maintains strict confidentiality of compensation, performance, and personal information; applies hiring and promotion standards consistently across offices; and collaborates effectively with the principals, the Business Manager, division leads, and staff at each level.

Advancement

Readiness for increased scope, including a People Operations leadership role or added headcount under this function, is demonstrated through a reliable candidate pipeline, retention results that hold across review cycles, documented programs others can run, and sound judgment in advising the principals on workforce decisions.

Compensation

  • Base salary of $65,000 to $90,000, commensurate with experience and certification
  • Per-hire bonus, tiered by the position filled, paid after the new hire completes 90 days of employment

Benefits

  • 401(k) with company match
  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Paid Time Off
  • Professional development support, including HR certification and SHRM membership

Ayoroa Simmons is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Job Description Summary

Analyzes business functions, processes, and procedures to provide solution recommendations, including system specifications and business process implications, based on business objectives, business requirements, and cost effectiveness. Collaborates with others in system development and design, including database, report, and interface design. Assists in the development of test plans and coordination or execution of testing activities and helps triage issues, anomalies, and opportunities to improve solutions. Demonstrates the ability to analyze workflows, identify root causes of operational challenges, redesign processes to improve straight-through processing, and leverage automation solutions to reduce manual effort and rework. This role is Telecommuter.

What You’ll Do

Job Responsibilities

  • Represent the business within an Agile delivery team; develop and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders; demonstrate deep expertise in the aligned business domain, including business processes, stakeholder needs, and technology strategies; and serve as a liaison between business and IT for new system implementations, enhancements, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Lead requirements elicitation and analysis efforts for complex initiatives; facilitate decomposition sessions to identify and define high-level scope, dependencies, risks, and delivery considerations across business and technology teams.

  • Apply advanced business analysis techniques, including business process analysis, cost-benefit analysis, workflow analysis, business capability assessment, and solution evaluation, to support decision-making and solution design.
  • Evaluate automation opportunities and develop low-code solutions to reduce repetitive manual work and improve process consistency.
  • Use a variety of requirements-gathering and discovery techniques, including stakeholder interviews, workshops, document analysis, story mapping, process mapping, and workflow analysis.
  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of Premera systems, business processes, data assets, and technology capabilities within the aligned domain and related business areas.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Knowledge of healthcare or health insurance industry processes and systems.
  • Experience with product development and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Confluence, and Product Plan.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Customer-focused with demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions to strategic business objectives and customer value.
  • Demonstrates accountability and consistently delivers results within a self-organized team environment.
  • Ability to analyze complex business processes, system interactions, and operational workflows to identify improvement opportunities and scalable solutions.

  • Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms to analyze operational data.

  • Deep understanding of business strategies, processes, and operational needs within the aligned domain and the ability to translate those needs into technology solutions.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership audiences.

What You’ll Do

You’ll build an understanding of Champ for ERP, Unanet’s AE customers, and the core workflows where AI can deliver measurable business value. You’ll shadow discovery sessions, onboarding conversations, and customer working sessions to learn how Champ is positioned and operationalized in real customer environments.

You’ll help shape early customer use cases, participate in working sessions, and contribute to getting initial workflows live. In your first 90 days, you’ll comfortably lead customer discovery sessions, help customers define future-state workflows, and guide initial use cases from concept to operational adoption. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders, support measurable customer outcomes, and contribute repeatable best practices that improve implementation, adoption, and expansion.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of experience in customer success, consulting, professional services, solutions consulting, transformation, or business process improvement.
  • Experience working with AE firms or other project-based professional services organizations.
  • Experience leading software adoption programs that require changes to workflow, behavior, and team accountability.

  • Proficiency with AI, automation, copilots, and natural-language workflow tools, including the ability to apply them to business process transformation.

  • Proven experience driving adoption and change management with customers, including influencing stakeholders with different goals and levels of technical comfort.
  • Strong solutioning mindset with the ability to connect customer pain points to practical AI-powered workflows, use cases, prompt strategies, and phased rollout plans.
  • Comfortable facilitating working sessions, executive conversations, and cross-functional alignment focused on AI adoption and operational change.
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed.

Your Differentiators

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Operations, Consulting, or a related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in AI, automation, and natural-language interfaces, with the ability to translate emerging capabilities into practical business value.
  • Ability to uncover business value, define success metrics, and guide customers toward measurable outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence and customer-facing communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Our Values

  • We are a Team: Employees, customers, and partners working together.
  • We are Customer-Focused: Customers are the heart of everything we do.
  • We are Driven: Seeking exceptional outcomes.
  • We Own Our Success: Every employee has a stake in our company.
  • We do the right thing and have fun in the process.

You will be eligible for employee equity as well as discretionary bonus compensation, subject to plans that may be in effect from time to time. Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.
  • Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking
  • Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.
  • Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

Desired:

Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

jobs.excerpt: About TurvoTurvo provides a collaborative Transportation Management System (TMS) application designed specifically for the supply chain.
jobs.description:
About Turvo

Turvo provides a collaborative Transportation Management System (TMS) application designed specifically for the supply chain. Turvo Collaboration Cloud connects freight brokers, 3PLs, shippers, and carriers to unite supply chain ecosystems, delivering outstanding customer experiences, real-time collaboration, and accelerated growth. The technology unifies internal and external systems, providing one end-to-end solution that streamlines operations, enhances analytics, and automates business processes while eliminating redundant manual tasks. Turvo’s customers include some of the world’s largest Fortune 500 logistics service providers and shippers as well as small to mid-sized freight brokers. Turvo is based in Dallas, Texas, with offices in Hyderabad, India. ().

About the Role

Turvo is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of our digital marketing strategies. This role will be responsible for driving brand visibility, attracting qualified prospects, generating sales pipeline, and contributing directly to revenue growth through integrated, data-driven marketing programs.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on digital marketing strategist with deep expertise in search engine optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, website optimization, marketing automation, and performance analytics. They understand how to leverage digital channels to engage B2B buyers throughout the customer journey, convert interest into qualified opportunities, and continuously improve marketing ROI.

This individual will own Turvo's digital demand generation strategy, combining inbound marketing, paid acquisition, account-based marketing (ABM), and lifecycle campaigns to accelerate new customer acquisition and support customer engagement and retention.

Primary Responsibilities

    Digital Marketing Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, own, and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy designed to increase qualified website traffic, generate inbound leads, build sales pipeline, and support annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth.
  • Plan, execute, and optimize integrated digital campaigns across paid search, organic search, social, email, retargeting, and other relevant channels.
  • Manage digital marketing budgets and optimize channel investments based on performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and pipeline contribution.
  • Identify and test new digital channels, technologies, and tactics to expand reach and improve demand generation performance.

    • SEO, AEO & Website Optimization

  • Own Turvo's SEO and AEO strategies to improve organic search visibility, increase high-intent traffic, and strengthen brand discovery across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
  • Develop and execute keyword, content, technical SEO, and on-page optimization strategies to improve search rankings and organic lead generation.
  • Partner with internal teams and agencies to optimize website content, landing pages, calls to action, and conversion paths to improve visitor-to-lead conversion rates.
  • Monitor website performance, user behavior, and conversion metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

    • Paid Media & Digital Advertising

  • Develop, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit, and other relevant B2B advertising platforms with agency partners.
  • Own campaign strategy, audience targeting, budget allocation, creative development, A/B testing, and performance optimization.
  • Continuously evaluate campaign performance against key metrics, including cost per lead, cost per opportunity, conversion rates, and pipeline ROI.
  • Develop retargeting and audience segmentation strategies to engage high-intent prospects and accelerate conversion.

    • Marketing Automation, ABM & Lead Nurturing

  • Leverage HubSpot to build and optimize automated marketing workflows, lead nurturing programs, segmentation strategies, and lifecycle campaigns.
  • Develop targeted ABM campaigns to engage high-value accounts and key decision-makers within Turvo's priority industries and market segments.
  • Partner closely with Sales to align digital marketing initiatives with account priorities, pipeline objectives, and buyer engagement strategies.
  • Optimize lead capture, lead scoring, lead routing, and nurturing processes to improve marketing-to-sales conversion.

    • Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimization

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across digital channels, including website traffic, engagement, lead generation, conversion rates, marketing-sourced pipeline, and revenue attribution.
  • Utilize Google Analytics (GA4), HubSpot, and other reporting tools to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into marketing performance and ROI.
  • Present campaign results, insights, and strategic recommendations to Sales and executive leadership.
  • Apply data-driven insights, testing, and continuous experimentation to improve campaign efficiency and maximize marketing investment.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Sales, Product Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to develop compelling messaging, digital content, and campaigns aligned with Turvo's growth objectives.
  • Partner with content and creative resources to develop high-performing digital assets, including landing pages, advertising creative, emails, and campaign content.
  • Stay current on emerging digital marketing trends, AI-driven marketing technologies, and evolving B2B buyer behaviors.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of experience developing and executing B2B digital marketing and demand generation strategies, preferably within SaaS, enterprise technology, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success driving measurable results through digital marketing, including qualified lead generation, pipeline growth, and marketing ROI.
  • Strong expertise in SEO, AEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), paid social advertising, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Advanced proficiency in HubSpot, including Marketing Hub, CRM, marketing automation, campaign management, lead scoring, workflows, and reporting.
  • Experience managing LinkedIn advertising and other B2B paid media platforms.
  • Strong understanding of website optimization, landing page performance, content strategy, and digital buyer journeys.
  • Experience developing and executing ABM campaigns, email nurture programs, and audience segmentation strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate marketing performance data into actionable strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience managing digital marketing budgets and evaluating campaign performance against acquisition costs and pipeline contribution.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and emerging search and content discovery trends.
  • Proficiency with collaboration and creative tools such as Slack, Canva, and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and hands-on approach, with the ability to independently manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Turvo?

At Turvo, we're transforming how the logistics and supply chain industry connects, collaborates, and operates with a vision to unify the global supply chain network. As our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll play a critical role in shaping our marketing strategy, expanding our market presence, and driving measurable business growth.
We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, thrives on performance data, and is passionate about using digital marketing to generate real business results.
If you're excited about building high-performing digital marketing programs and making a direct impact on revenue growth, we'd love to hear from you.

LocationAs a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in the United States (Eastern time zone), the UK, or Ireland.

Who We AreDoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityWe are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing this work in-house, and we're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to own it. You will own our financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - as an engineer, not just an administrator.

What sets this role apart is mindset. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice and instinctively looks for ways to automate it away. You will own the configuration and business logic of the financial systems, keeping each one doing what it does best, and partner with our internal engineering team on cross-system integration rather than wiring it together by hand.

This is a high-ownership role serving Finance and Accounting directly. You will be their dedicated systems partner - someone who knows the platforms deeply, is invested in making them better, and treats reducing manual, error-prone work as the core of the job rather than something to do on the side. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how finance operations run as the company scales

Responsibilities

  • Own and administer our core financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - including configuration, business logic, and day-to-day system health.
  • Identify manual, recurring, or error-prone finance operations (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting, procure-to-pay) and reduce or remove them through automation, choosing the simplest effective approach and partnering with engineering for heavier builds.
  • Serve as the business-logic and data expert for the finance domain, partnering with engineering to define and maintain the rules and canonical definitions the systems rely on.
  • Build cross-system integrations on a central, version-controlled, observable integration platform in partnership with engineering, rather than as one-off scripts buried inside individual tools.
  • Act as the dedicated systems partner to Finance and Accounting: translate their needs into system capability, own those working relationships, and serve as the technical owner for financial-vendor onboarding, configuration, and administration.
  • Use modern AI tooling to draft automations and accelerate routine system work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.

Qualifications

  • 3-6 years administering a financial or ERP system, with hands-on NetSuite administration required, including:
    • configuration, customization, user access, roles, permissions, and workflows;
    • core modules such as General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management, Accounts, and subsidiary / multi-location structures;
    • designing and implementing custom records, fields, and automations;
    • building SuiteFlow automations in response to changing business needs;
    • managing the NetSuite integration ecosystem.
  • A working understanding of core finance and accounting processes: month-end close, reconciliation, accounts payable / procure-to-pay, and revenue.
  • A strong drive to eliminate repetitive manual work, with a demonstrated track record of automating it (e.g. scripting, saved searches, workflow automation, or low-code/iPaaS tools).
  • Sound judgment about where logic belongs - what should be system configuration, what should be a cross-system integration, and which system is the source of truth for a given piece of data.
  • Comfort with at least one of SuiteScript, SQL, general scripting, or API-based automation, and the ability to read and reason about integrations even when engineering builds them.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across both finance and engineering teams, with the ability to translate between them.
  • Fluent English; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.

Bonus Points:

  • FloQast administration experience.
  • Experience working against a central integration platform or in an event-driven environment.
  • Comfort using AI coding and automation tools in day-to-day work.
  • Depth in SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0), RESTlets, or NetSuite web services.

Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
