Summary

Job Description

KERING EYEWEAR Divisonal Manager Lindberg & Maui Jim

Über uns

Kering Eyewear ist der weltweit führende Anbieter von Luxus- und High-End-Brillen (Korrektionsfassungen & Sonnenbrillen) und entwickelt ein einzigartiges Portfolio starker Marken. Wir entwerfen, entwickeln, produzieren und vermarkten die begehrenswertesten Brillen und Sonnenbrillen in zwei wachstumsstarken Segmenten: Luxus sowie Sport & Lifestyle. Dank unserer Branchenexpertise ermöglichen wir es unseren Marken, ihre Grenzen in dieser vielversprechenden Geschäftskategorie zu überschreiten. Wir unterstützen sie dabei, ihre Führungsrolle und Innovationskraft im Bereich Eyewear auszubauen und ihr kreatives wie finanzielles Potenzial auf einfallsreiche und nachhaltige Weise zu entfalten.

Deine Chance

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine strategische Schlüsselposition mit voller Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Performance von zwei Marken. Du gestaltest aktiv unser Multi‑Brand‑Geschäftsmodell mit und bringst deine Ideen gezielt ein. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management sowie internationalen Brand Headquarters zusammen und leistest einen maßgeblichen Beitrag zu strategischen Entscheidungen. Dein Fokus liegt klar auf dem Business Steering statt auf operativer Führung – mit direktem Impact auf den Unternehmenserfolg. Gleichzeitig nutzt du die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken in den Bereichen Strategie, Analyse und Marktverständnis wirkungsvoll einzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • End-to-end Verantwortung für die Markenperformance bei Umsatz, Margen
  • Entwicklung, Abstimmung und Umsetzung von jährlichen Business- und Vertriebsplänen
  • Forecasting und Budgetverantwortung und kontinuierliches Tracking und Steuerung der KPIs
  • Performance-Analysen und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Steigerung von Umsatz und Effizienz
  • Identifikation von Risiken und Opportunitäten sowie Initiierung gezielter Gegenmaßnahmen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Sales Managern zur Weiterentwicklung der kommerziellen Markenstrategie
  • Go-to-Market-Pläne einschließlich Priorisierung von Kunden, Kanälen und Initiativen
  • Steuerung und Abstimmung mit Sales Managern zur Sicherstellung einer konsistenten und effektiven Marktbearbeitung
  • Aktive Begleitung der Umsetzung im Markt durch regelmäßige Reviews und klare Zielvorgaben
  • Zentrale Schnittstelle zu den Brand Headquarters inklusive Abstimmung von Launches, strategischen Initiativen und kommerziellen Rahmenbedingungen
  • Proaktive Einbringung von Marktfeedback, Performance-Daten und Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Verantwortung für die Sortiments- und Kollektionsstrategie im lokalen Markt
  • Analyse der Produktperformance und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zu Pricing, Portfoliooptimierung und Trade Marketing
  • Aufbau und Nutzung von Markt-, Kunden- und Wettbewerbsanalysen zur Identifikation von Wachstumspotenzialen
  • Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen entlang der Customer Journey und Umsetzung effizienterer Prozesse
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen zur Verbesserung von Prozessen und Kundenerlebnis

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Brand Management oder invergleichbarer Business-Verantwortung
  • Fundierter Hintergrund in dynamischen, schnelllebigen und stark ergebnisorientierten Unternehmensumfeldern
  • Umfangreiche Erfahrung in performancegetriebenen Organisationen, idealerweise in der Eyewear-, Luxus- oder Modebranche
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Strategien zu entwickeln und erfolgreich in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse umzusetzen
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung von Umsatz, Profitabilität und zentralen KPIs
  • Starke Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie sicheres Auftreten und ausgeprägte Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenz
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit klarem Fokus auf Prioritäten und Umsetzung
  • Hohe Markt- und Kundenorientierung sowie ein gutes Gespür für Markenpositionierung, Trends und Wettbewerb

Warum Kering Eyewear?

Dies ist eine großartige Gelegenheit, Teil der Kering Eyewear-Erfolgsgeschichte zu werden und aktiv zur Entwicklung des Unternehmens beizutragen – als Mitglied eines florierenden Unternehmens innerhalb eines globalen Luxuskonzerns, der unzählige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet. Talentförderung ist ein zentrales Prinzip bei Kering, und wir setzen uns aktiv für interne Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein. Unsere gemeinsame Vision fördert Führungsqualitäten und unterstützt jede:n Mitarbeitende:n dabei, das persönliche Potenzial in einem inspirierenden und erfüllenden Arbeitsumfeld voll auszuschöpfen.

Kering engagiert sich für den Aufbau einer vielfältigen Belegschaft. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Vielfalt in all ihren Formen – Geschlecht, Alter, Nationalität, Kultur, Religionszugehörigkeit und sexuelle Orientierung – den Arbeitsplatz bereichert. Sie eröffnet Menschen die Möglichkeit, ihre Talente individuell wie gemeinsam zum Ausdruck zu bringen, und stärkt unsere Fähigkeit, uns in einer sich wandelnden Welt erfolgreich anzupassen. Als Arbeitgeber mit Chancengleichheit freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Kandidat:innen – unabhängig von deren Hintergrund.

jobs.excerpt: Join the Rest RevolutionThe world is wired and tired.
jobs.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Role: How You'll Make an Impact

Team: Mobile Engineering | Reports to: Director of Mobile Engineering| Location: Remote-friendly (US/Canada, PST hours)

You'll be a leader on engineering development for our mobile apps. That means the iOS and Android apps that keep millions of devices humming in real homes.

You’re a great fit if you thrive in environments of rapid learning and delivery. You’re self-motivated and have demonstrated strong ownership and self-direction. You strive to understand the business of what we are trying to accomplish and push engineering solutions to provide customer value. As a small company where AI-assisted development is core to how we work, we expect this role to ramp up quickly, use AI fluently in their day-to-day, and deliver broadly across our mobile systems.

Working across Mobile, and partnering closely with Product, you'll lead feature development, set technical direction, and mentor engineers.

What You'll Do

First 90 Days: Learn & Contribute

  • Review existing codebase and identify immediate technical improvements.
  • Ship meaningful code to production and begin to establish credibility with the engineering team.

First 6 Months: Drive Real Impact

  • Technical Leadership: Lead delivery of features, and jump into production issues or improvements, debug cross-platform problems spanning mobile/firmware/backend
  • Cross-Pillar Ramp: Build context on how the full mobile platform fits together. Contribute meaningfully to your team’s initiatives — shipping features, improving platform reliability, and driving daily app engagement
  • Architectural Ownership: Understand problem spaces, partner with stakeholders to shape architectural problems and solutions, and bring proposals to Mobile Strategy and Engineering Forum meetings.
  • Engineer Mentorship: Provide feedback and support for other engineers. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other stakeholders to scope, plan, and rapidly ship features
  • AI Integration: Champion AI-assisted development practices within your team — not just using the tools yourself, but creating the conditions where others adopt them faster and go deeper.

First Year: Transform & Scale

  • Strategic Impact: Drive business strategy through mobile initiatives and shape the roadmap across the mobile organization — contributing to decisions that benefit all pillars and the people who use Hatch every night.
  • Raise the AI Bar: Serve as a critical evaluator and implementor of our AI strategy.. Help define what "good" looks like so that as new engineers join, there's a standard to onboard into, not just an assumption.

What You'll Bring

  • Deep Mobile Craft: You’ve spent 6+ years building mobile apps that matter—whether in Swift/SwiftUI or Kotlin/Jetpack Compose. You care about code quality, reliability, and making great experiences for real people
  • Technical Leadership: You love leading by example—writing production code, unblocking others, leading architectural decision-making, and helping teams make smart, pragmatic decisions. You’re as comfortable setting direction as you are rolling up your sleeves
  • Mentorship: You believe great teams make great products. You’ve mentored other engineers, built trust, and created environments where people do their best work
  • Collaborative Energy: You thrive in cross-functional spaces—partnering with Product, Design, and other engineering leaders to turn ideas into reality. You communicate clearly and lead with empathy
  • AI Curiosity: You’re genuinely excited about what AI unlocks—how it can make us more effective builders and open new ways to serve our customers
  • Broad Technical Reach: You bring experience with modern mobile tooling, CI/CD, testing, and cloud services—and you’re always eager to explore new technologies, tech stacks, and approaches

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
  • We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

The Perks & Benefits That Matter

  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)
  • Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here
  • 401(k) match with no vesting schedule
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • 16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)
  • Financial support for family planning
  • Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement
  • Friends and family discounts on Hatch products
  • Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

  • Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
  • Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
  • Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?

We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.

About the Role

Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK domiciliary care provider for an experienced and organised Rostering Coordinator. The provider delivers approximately 2,000 hours of home care each week across around 90 care staff.

You will plan, maintain and adjust care workers' schedules so that client visits are covered consistently, staff availability is used effectively and travel between visits is practical. This is not a data-entry role. It requires independent judgement and active problem-solving across a two-week rolling rota.

This role covers rostering only. You will not change assessed care needs, reduce agreed care durations or decide that a required visit can be missed. Unresolved staffing and care-delivery risks must be escalated to the designated line manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain the two-week rolling rota, keeping regular clients with the same care worker wherever practical.

  • Use bank staff and pickup arrangements for short-term and weekend cover rather than permanent runs.
  • Plan runs using full client postcodes, allowing practical travel time between visits.
  • Allocate work within each care worker's availability and contracted hours, avoiding over-allocation or double-booking.
  • Assess new care packages against geography, visit times and staff capacity, working to the Wednesday cut-off for Monday starts.

We're looking for an experienced performance marketer who can confidently take ownership of paid media strategy and execution across multiple client accounts. About You
To excel in this role, you need:

You’re comfortable taking ownership from initial strategy and forecasting through campaign setup, launch, optimisation, reporting and scaling, with clear accountability for performance.

You understand the role different channels play within the wider acquisition strategy and can allocate budgets strategically across paid social, paid search, programmatic and emerging platforms based on commercial objectives.
  • A strong commercial and analytical mindset. You don’t just look at clicks, CPMs or platform conversions - you understand how media performance connects to revenue, profitability, CAC, LTV and overall business growth. You’re able to analyse the full customer journey, identify conversion bottlenecks and optimise campaigns based on meaningful business outcomes.
  • Strong technical knowledge of tracking, attribution and measurement, including Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, pixels, server-side tracking, Conversion APIs, UTMs, click IDs, attribution windows and affiliate tracking platforms.   • Hands-on experience with cloaking is highly desirable and, given the nature of the role, a willingness to learn is essential if you haven’t worked with it before.
  • Experience working in iGaming, FinTech, Crypto or other highly regulated industries, with a strong understanding of advertising policies, market restrictions, compliance requirements and responsible advertising practices. You should be comfortable adapting campaign strategies to different regional regulations and market conditions.
  • Experience negotiating, acquiring and setting up Business Managers and advertising accounts across different platforms, vendors and resellers, with the resourcefulness to find solutions when access to standard platforms or accounts is limited. You should also understand how to test, scale and migrate campaigns across different ad accounts and Business Managers, with a strong focus on minimising data loss and ensuring previously built audiences remain reusable and scalable.
  • A strategic approach to audience development and growth. You’re able to use customer behaviour, market conditions, competitor activity and regional insights to develop audience strategies, identify sustainable growth opportunities and determine where each channel can have the greatest impact.
  • Strong creative and cross-functional collaboration skills. You can translate performance data, audience behaviour and psychology into clear, actionable briefs for creative, content, design and landing-page teams. You’re comfortable providing creative direction and building a structured testing roadmap to continuously improve campaign performance.
  • Resourceful, commercially minded and comfortable with ambiguity. You can make sound decisions, manage risk and maintain performance when working with constraints, imperfect data or limited platform capabilities. You’re proactive about identifying challenges, gaps and opportunities rather than waiting for someone else to point them out.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with internal teams, clients, creative partners and other stakeholders.

Nice-to-have's
  • Exposure to email marketing campaigns / CRM initiatives
  • Experience with Google Ads
  • Knowledge or experience with Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)
  • Experience working directly with clients and managing stakeholder relationships

The ideal candidate is collaborative, positive, and highly proactive. They enjoy solving problems, communicating with teammates and clients, and taking initiative without needing constant direction.
They're a team player with a can-do attitude and they understand that great results come from collaboration.

We’re looking for someone who is collaborative, positive, highly proactive, and naturally takes ownership. You’re the kind of person who doesn’t wait to be told what to do - you spot a problem, figure out what needs to happen, and take it through to completion, while keeping the right people involved along the way.

You’ll be joining a growing two-person paid media team, so being comfortable working independently is important. You should be able to manage projects with little-to-no supervision, while also knowing when to ask questions, involve others, or flag something that needs attention. We’re looking for someone who can go beyond simply executing tasks - you should be curious enough to dig into projects, identify challenges, risks, gaps and opportunities that may not be immediately obvious, and think about how things could be improved.

At the same time, you won’t be working in isolation. Collaboration is a big part of the role. You’ll work closely with teammates and wider internal stakeholders, as well as clients, and project-related decisions will be made collectively rather than individually. You should enjoy exchanging ideas, communicating openly, and bringing your perspective to the table while being equally comfortable listening to others and finding the best solution together.

Things won’t always be perfect or straightforward, so adaptability and resourcefulness are important. We want someone who can stay calm when faced with constraints, changing priorities or imperfect circumstances, and focus on figuring out what can be done rather than why something can’t. You naturally approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset and look for practical, thoughtful solutions rather than assigning blame.

Finally, we’re looking for someone who is curious and thoughtful about AI. You should be comfortable using AI to support your research, analysis, thinking and day-to-day efficiency, while still bringing strong judgement, experience and critical thinking of your own. We’re not looking for someone who uses AI as a shortcut or lets it do the thinking for them. Instead, we value people who know when AI can add value and when their own expertise should take the lead, and who can use these tools intelligently while maintaining a high standard of original, human-led work.

jobs.description:
NORTH CAROLINA REMOTE PSYCHIATRIC-MENTAL HEALTH NURSE PRACTITIONER (PMHNP)

Initiating Visit & Supervising Practitioner : Principal Illness Navigation, Peer Support (PIN-PS)

Independent Contractor (1099) | Telehealth/ Remote position | You Are Accountable

ABOUT THE ROLE

You Are Accountable operates behavioral health programs built around Principal Illness Navigation – Peer Support (PIN-PS), a Medicare care-navigation benefit in which certified peer support specialists walk alongside patients living with serious behavioral health conditions. Every patient's navigation episode must begin with a qualifying initiating visit furnished by a billing practitioner, and the ongoing peer navigation is billed incident to that practitioner's services under general supervision. That practitioner is you.

This is a flexible, telehealth-based contractor role with meaningful clinical leverage: you conduct the psychiatric evaluation that opens each patient's episode, set the plan of care the peer team supports, and remain available as the supervising clinician while peer specialists deliver month-to-month navigation. You control your own schedule, and compensation scales directly with the work you personally perform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct initiating visits (e.g., psychiatric diagnostic evaluations, CPT 90791, or E/M visits) via telehealth for patients entering PIN-PS programs, establishing the diagnosis, medical necessity, and plan of care the navigation services will support.
  • Document each visit in our EHR within 48 hours to clean, billable standards, including patient consent to navigation services where required.
  • Serve as the billing practitioner of record for enrolled patients and provide general supervision of the certified peer support specialists furnishing navigation incident to your services.
  • Furnish follow-up visits for your enrolled patients where clinically indicated and mutually agreed.
  • Cooperate with quality, audit, and payer-compliance activities relating to your patients.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Active, unrestricted APRN/NP licensure in one or more of: Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Tennessee, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or New York (multi-state licensure a plus). State credential titles vary (APRN, CRNP, APN, NP) — all are welcome.
  • National board certification as a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC).
  • Any physician collaboration, supervision, or protocol arrangement required by your state (e.g., prescriptive authority agreement in TX; collaborative agreement in PA; joint protocol in NJ; practice agreement or NP Modernization Act qualification in NY; supervisory protocol in FL) — we can discuss support here. We also have physicians that we work with that can provide this.
  • Active NPI; eligibility to enroll with and reassign benefits to our professional entities for Medicare and Medicaid; never excluded from any federal or state health care program.
  • Comfort with telehealth care for adults with serious behavioral health conditions, and an appreciation for peer support as part of the care team.

COMPENSATION

  • Professional services: 80% of net collections for each service you personally furnish, paid within 30 days after the month we receive payment from the funding source, with full per-service reporting.
  • Supervision stipend: $5.00 per supervised patient per month for each month billable navigation services are furnished to that patient under your supervision.
  • Malpractice coverage: professional liability coverage for your services under this engagement provided at our expense ($1M per claim / $3M aggregate).

ENGAGEMENT DETAILS

1099 independent contractor; you keep full independent clinical judgment and set your own schedule around agreed availability. The role is non-exclusive — most of our practitioners maintain other practices. Because each patient's navigation episode depends on continuity with their billing practitioner, the agreement includes a 12-month notice period for termination without cause, which ends early automatically once your enrolled patients have been transitioned to a successor practitioner with continuity of care maintained; after giving notice you are never obligated to take on new patients.

You Are Accountable is an equal opportunity organization. All engagements are subject to credentialing, exclusion screening, and payer enrollment.

jobs.excerpt: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did.
jobs.description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote in Latin America.

About the Role

As our Technical Recruiter, you'll specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment and own hiring from intake to offer. That includes our hardest searches, Senior and Principal AI Engineers, plus our regular full-stack, front-end and back-end roles. You'll know the AI engineering market well enough to tell a mid-level from a senior, from a principal before they reach our interview team. You'll also use AI tools to source and run searches better than a manual process can.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Specialize in AI, ML and engineering recruitment: own full-cycle hiring for AI and ML Engineers (Senior and Principal) and for full-stack, front-end and back-end engineers. That covers intake, sourcing, screening, scheduling, feedback, debriefs and offers.
  • Design and execute recruitment strategies: build a search plan for each role, covering target profiles, channels, messaging and timelines. Adjust it when the market says otherwise.
  • Find principal-level AI talent: build pipelines for Senior and Principal AI Engineers beyond LinkedIn. Look in GitHub, open-source projects, research papers, technical communities and referrals.
  • Level candidates accurately: screen against senior-vs-principal so the interview team only meets candidates at the right level.
  • Use AI tools to improve search: use AI tools and LLM assistants for market mapping, search strings, candidate research and outreach.
  • Turn recruiting data into insights: track time-to-fill, pass-through rates, sources and decline reasons in Greenhouse. Use them to show where searches stall and what to change.
  • Optimize hiring processes: tighten intake, scorecards, scheduling and candidate communication. Document playbooks and interview plans so searches run the same way every time.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting, with full-cycle ownership of engineering searches.
  • Recent experience hiring AI or ML engineers at Senior level or above, and you can explain how a Principal differs from a Senior.
  • Enough technical fluency to discuss LLM applications, RAG, evaluation, fine-tuning and MLOps with engineers, and to probe their claims.
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools in your recruiting work, with examples of what changed because of them.
  • A track record of sourcing passive senior candidates through channels other than LinkedIn.
  • Fluent written and spoken English. You'll work with engineers and leaders across many countries.
  • A data-driven approach: you use funnel metrics to make decisions and explain them to hiring managers. Comfortable with Greenhouse or a similar ATS.
  • Experience designing recruitment strategies and improving hiring processes, not only running them, in a small team where processes are still being built.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for consulting firms or agencies with client-driven hiring
  • Experience hiring across multiple LATAM countries and the US
  • Spanish or Portuguese
  • Experience with Juicebox AI or similar AI sourcing tools

What Success Looks Like

We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is:

  • AI-fluent. You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently.
  • A builder. You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection.
  • A clear communicator. You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.

As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed
  • Payments made in USD
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Full Stack Engineer to lead technical delivery on a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them.

This role spans both sides of that work. You will keep the existing Java, Spring, and Oracle applications stable, performant, and secure, leading defect resolution and delivering approved enhancements. You will also design and build the replacement platform on cloud, container, and DevOps foundations, shaping its target architecture, its integrations with related federal systems, and the path for moving users and data off the legacy stack. Priorities shift between the two, so we're looking for a hands-on technical leader who is equally comfortable sustaining a production system and building a new one.

You will set technical direction, mentor engineers, and partner with our Project Manager, designers, and security lead. You will also work directly with the client's technical leads and product owner, translating complex trade-offs into clear recommendations.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $145,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as technical lead for the program, setting engineering standards, reviewing code and architecture, and guiding technical decisions across existing and new systems.

  • Lead the Target Solution Architecture and Analysis of Alternatives for the replacement platform, weighing integration, containerized deployment, DevOps efficiency, case and workflow management, and security.

  • Design, prototype, build, and deploy applications on cloud, container, and DevOps foundations, while maintaining and tuning existing Java, Spring, Tomcat, and Oracle applications on Red Hat Enterprise Linux.

  • Design reusable platform capabilities such as user access, workflow routing, document management, audit history, reporting, notifications, and public-facing APIs.

  • Lead triage, analysis, and resolution of priority defects affecting functionality, availability, security, or data integrity.

  • Design and deliver approved enhancements driven by new laws, executive orders, policy changes, and agency needs.

  • Build integrations with related federal systems, such as eRulemaking, FDMS, , the Federal Register, and .

  • Plan and support data migration, cutover, and decommissioning of legacy capabilities.

  • Support 99.5% uptime through patches, upgrades, performance monitoring, alerting, and rapid response to production issues.

  • Identify, prioritize, and pay down technical debt, including outdated code and unsupported libraries.

  • Own CI/CD pipelines that build with a single command, deploy automatically from version control, deploy without downtime, and roll back immediately when needed.

  • Hold the team to the contract's quality bar: at least 90% test coverage, zero linting errors, zero accessibility errors, and no unresolved medium or high security findings.

  • Build in Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and secure coding practices from the start.

  • Lead functional, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, and security testing, and support user acceptance testing.

  • Keep dependencies, licenses, inline documentation, and system diagrams current.

  • Mentor engineers and review their work, helping the team grow its skills and consistency.

  • Work in an agile process with sprint cycles, contributing to planning, estimation, and roadmaps.

  • Brief client technical leads and the product owner on technical options, risks, and recommendations.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • At least 10 years of professional software engineering experience, including technical leadership of development teams.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Java and the Spring Framework, including building and maintaining production web applications.

  • Strong experience with relational databases (Oracle preferred), including data modeling, SQL, and performance tuning.

  • Experience designing and deploying cloud-native, containerized applications (such as Docker and Kubernetes) on a major cloud platform.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing with tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Experience designing RESTful APIs and integrating multiple systems.

  • Experience modernizing or replacing legacy systems while keeping production stable.

  • Working knowledge of secure coding (OWASP), accessibility (Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA), and Linux server environments.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

  • Polished communication skills, with experience presenting technical options and trade-offs to clients and non-technical stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience delivering for federal government clients, especially GSA or other civilian agencies.

  • Experience integrating with or other federated identity and single sign-on services.

  • Experience with , AWS, or Azure, and related certifications.

  • Experience building workflow, case management, or document management systems.

  • Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections.

  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki.

  • Experience supporting systems through FISMA Moderate ATO processes.

  • Embed static and dynamic security testing (such as Snyk and OWASP ZAP) in CI/CD pipelines so every release meets OWASP ASVS with no unresolved medium or high findings.

jobs.description:
About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

Our company culture is defined by a dedication to our mission of utilizing open data to prevent illicit commercial and financial activity, a passion for exploring innovative solutions to complex problems, and an understanding that diverse perspectives lead to optimal outcomes. We foster cross-team collaboration, promote training and learning opportunities, and recognize initiative and innovation. If you like working with supportive, high-performing, and curious teams, Sayari is the place for you.

Our People Team Mission

We build elegant, user-friendly systems that help great people at Sayari do their best work. Clearly. Consistently. With pride. Our People team is here to scale our impact by enabling high performance and strategic alignment at every level of the organization.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-oriented Principal HR Business Partner (HRBP) to support our US based Go-to-Market (GTM) teams partner directly with our Chief Revenue Officer. This is a high-impact role for a seasoned HR Business Partner (HRBP) who understands the pace, complexity, and customer focus of enterprise Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) organizations. You will be a thought partner to GTM leaders, supporting organizational growth, talent strategy, and leadership effectiveness during a critical phase of scale.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to GTM leaders across global sales, CS, marketing, and partnerships, helping to align people strategies with business objectives.
  • Guide and support org design, team scaling, talent planning, and structural changes to support rapid growth and evolving business needs.
  • Drive core people programs including performance management, engagement, succession planning, employee development, and change management.
  • Use a data-informed approach to diagnose team health, track performance trends, and provide actionable insights to business leaders.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring strategies that support GTM scale and structure.
  • Partner across the HR and leadership team to create role-specific development plans for enterprise sales and customer-facing roles.
  • Support total rewards benchmarking and incentive design alignment for GTM roles in partnership with the Compensation team.
  • Operate inside Sayari’s PeopleOS framework, using Claude/Cowork-based skills to accelerate the recurring prep work of the role — stakeholder briefs, performance cycle packets, calibration intelligence, and engagement synthesis — so your time goes to coaching, org design, and the judgment calls only a human can make.
  • Champion our culture and values, and foster a high-performance, inclusive environment that supports retention and growth.

How You’ll Work: AI-Native by Design

Sayari’s People team runs on PeopleOS, our AI-native operating system built in Claude and Cowork. This HRBP role is expected to work inside that system, not around it:

  • Use PeopleOS skills for the recurring, time-consuming parts of the role — stakeholder prep briefs, performance cycle and calibration packets, and engagement synthesis — so more time goes to coaching leaders and making judgment calls.
  • Follow Sayari’s auditability-first governance model for any AI-assisted output: named employee data can be processed in our enterprise Claude instance with human review, but any output touching a hiring, performance, compensation, or termination decision requires a named reviewer’s sign-off before action, with the official record kept in the system of record (Rippling, Lattice).
  • Build ongoing fluency with Sayari’s approved AI tools and surface new automation ideas to the Talent Experience pillar lead — the People Team is expected to model AI-native ways of working for the rest of the company.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years as an HRBP supporting global GTM teams in an enterprise SaaS or high-growth tech company.
  • Deep understanding of the revenue lifecycle, including sales motions, customer onboarding, success metrics, and partnership development.
  • Demonstrated success in scaling GTM functions through people programs, leadership coaching, and organizational design.
  • Proven ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels in a fast-paced, evolving business.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills; able to influence and drive alignment at all levels.
  • Experience working with tools like Lattice, Rippling, or equivalent HR systems is required; knowledge of quota-based compensation structures is a plus.
  • Global HR exposure or experience supporting distributed teams is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort operating in an AI-native People function — using tools like Claude/Cowork to accelerate people analytics and prep work, with sound judgment about data governance, PII handling, and when a human review step is required.

The target base salary for this position is $165,000-$185,000 plus bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

BENEFITS

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and quarterly bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range
$165,000—$185,000 USD

About TaskUs:

TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:

At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

per year.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position across our US locations. The "pay scale" provided is a good faith estimate of the range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of hire. Actual salary will be determined based on various factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and specific geographic location.


Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; and paid time off including vacation, sick leave, and holidays.


Application Window:

This position is expected to remain open until 11-30-2026 . We recommend that interested candidates apply within 7 days of the posting date to ensure consideration.

Job Description:

Cyber Investigator


TaskUs partners with pioneering technology companies to build the safety, intelligence, and human-in-the-loop operations powering next-generation artificial intelligence.


In this role, you will join a frontline cyber investigations pod supporting one of the world’s foremost frontier AI research and safety companies. Their Safeguards mission is clear: prevent state-of-the-art AI systems from being leveraged by malicious actors to cause harm. While automated detection systems catch abuse at scale, human investigators provide the crucial analytical ground truth.


As a Cyber Investigator, you will conduct day-to-day triage and analysis of flagged telemetry. You will evaluate high-risk cyber prompts, differentiate legitimate defensive security research from malicious intent, apply structured labels that train automated safety classifiers, and package well-documented escalations for Senior and Principal investigators.

What you will do:

  • Queue Review & Triage: Investigate automated system flags across priority threat categories, including:
    • Ransomware and malware authoring / obfuscation
    • Local and remote exploit discovery and weaponization
    • Large-scale data scraping and automated exfiltration
    • Offensive operations, recon, and intrusion staging
  • Dual-Use Evaluation: Determine whether observed activity represents benign security research (e.g., CTFs, academic exercises, vulnerability remediation) or actionable policy violations, clearly detailing your rationale.
  • Ground-Truth Labeling: Apply precise, policy-aligned labels to adjudicated cases to directly test, benchmark, and improve automated machine learning safety filters.
  • Adversary Mapping: Map observed user prompts and tool usage to specific MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques.
  • OSINT & Context Enrichment: Conduct targeted open-source intelligence (OSINT) research on indicators, tooling, and infrastructure to provide operational context.
  • Escalations & Handoffs: Prepare concise, evidence-backed case dossiers to escalate high-severity, ambiguous, or novel threats to Senior and Principal Investigators.
  • Calibration & Feedback: Actively participate in pod calibration sessions, adopting quality feedback to maintain high labeling consistency across the pod.

What you bring:

  • 1–3 years of practical experience in SOC analysis (Tier 1/2), digital forensics, incident response (DFIR), threat intelligence, military cyber operations, or technical OSINT investigations.
  • Understanding of Attack Lifecycles: Solid working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK matrix, basic network/system internals, and how common cyber intrusions and exploit chains progress.
  • Analytical Documentation: Proven ability to synthesize complex case details into concise, objective written English summaries under operational timelines.
  • Investigative Mindset: Natural curiosity, attention to detail, and sound judgment when evaluating noisy, incomplete, or borderline information.
  • Location & Authorization: Based in the United States with unrestricted work authorization (Texas residency preferred).

Nice to have:

  • Prior background in military service, government intelligence, or federal/local cyber law enforcement.
  • Practical exposure to scripting languages (SQL, Python, or Bash) for basic log parsing and telemetry review.
  • Foundational cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GCIH, or CEH).
  • An active or previously held U.S. Government Security Clearance (Secret or higher).
  • Familiarity with large language models, prompt engineering, or AI red-teaming concepts.

Good to know:

  • Material Exposure: Daily responsibilities involve reviewing flagged prompts, exploit instructions, offensive scripts, and potentially malicious payloads.
  • Schedule & Rotation: The role may require rotational shift or weekend/holiday coverage to maintain rapid escalation turnarounds for critical threat events.
  • Security Screening: Selected candidates may be subject to client-directed insider threat screening and specialized background checks prior to and during engagement.

Location: US (Texas preferred)

jobs.description:
About the Role

Senior PHP/Symfony Engineer — Integrations & Automation

We are looking for a senior PHP/Symfony engineer to help own and scale our internal business automation platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who has built and maintained complex integrations between ecommerce, ERP, CRM, and other business systems, and who enjoys solving challenging problems involving data synchronization, asynchronous processing, and production reliability.

You'll work alongside an existing developer to improve architecture, strengthen monitoring and error handling, and build reliable automations that support our ecommerce and sales operations.

Company Mission

Our mission is to help customers save time and money when purchasing commercial kitchen equipment and supplies by providing a customer-centric shopping experience and by leveraging our industry buying power.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack PHP Developer to own our in-house business automation platform, together with an existing developer. The platform connects our ERP, e-commerce stores and sales tools, keeping customers, orders, leads and product data in sync. Your primary objective is to make it reliable, maintainable and monitorable. Key focus areas are product architecture, data modeling, a Symfony back end with caching, queues and asynchronous processing, integrations, crawling and a React front end. The ideal candidate is an experienced full stack Symfony developer who has built integrations at scale, pays close attention to detail, learns fast and enjoys solving problems creatively.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own the architecture of our automation platform, keeping it maintainable, monitorable and scalable.
  • Design and maintain the data model behind customers, orders, leads, accounts and products.
  • Build and run daily sync chains between our ERP, ecommerce stores and sales tools: customer and order sync, lead scoring, account assignment and write-backs.
  • Integrate with ecommerce platforms through GraphQL APIs, bulk operations and webhooks, and with other systems through REST and SOAP.
  • Keep syncs reliable despite rate-limited APIs and missing records, and protect write-back data quality.
  • Build resilient browser automation with headless browsers in Node.js for workflows that have no API, and web scraping behind proxies.
  • Enrich and categorise product data using AI models, controlling cost and accuracy.
  • Run Symfony Messenger queues, cron jobs and background workers, handling failed messages quickly.
  • Keep production healthy with alerts, digests and runbooks, and reduce alert noise.
  • Build React front end screens for internal users, and automate sales engagement and SEO tasks.
  • Raise unit and end-to-end test coverage and keep it running in CI.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • At least 5 years of professional software development experience.
  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience building and running integrations and automations with third-party APIs (ERP, ecommerce, CRM and sales tools) at scale.
  • Proven product architecture skills: designing and running maintainable, monitorable, scalable applications.
  • Strong data modelling skills and deep experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL) and Doctrine ORM.
  • Expert knowledge of PHP 8 and Symfony on the back end.
  • Strong knowledge of caching systems (e.g. Redis).
  • Hands-on experience with Symfony Messenger or other message queues, and with asynchronous and background processing.
  • Experience with REST, GraphQL and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with web crawling and headless browser automation (Node.js).
  • Strong experience with a modern JavaScript front end, ideally React.
  • Automated testing experience, unit (PHPUnit) and end-to-end (Playwright), and CI/CD pipelines.

Personal qualities:

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Creativity in finding simpler, better solutions.
  • A fast learner who picks up new systems quickly.
  • Hard working, with real ownership of results.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with ERP or ecommerce platform data models.
  • Experience with sales engagement or CRM automation.
  • Knowledge of SEO automation.
  • Knowledge of foodservice equipment or the wider equipment supply industry.

Working Hours

This is a full-time role, working remotely from anywhere within Europe. Your working hours should overlap with the team between 10:00 and 19:00 Paris time (CET, UTC+1; CEST, UTC+2 in summer).

jobs.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Senior Virtualization / Automation Engineer to design, operate, secure, automate, and modernize the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager (SRM), and associated Infrastructure as Code capabilities.

The role owns the hypervisor and SDDC platform layers across production, development, test, COOP, disaster-recovery, and hybrid-hosting environments; guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads remain with their respective teams. The engineer also supports the transition of applicable services to centralized DISA-hosting platforms through discovery, migration planning, migration support, validation, and stabilization.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Serve as senior engineering owner for the SDDC platform, establishing architecture, configuration standards, operational procedures, and engineering roadmaps.
    • Build, configure, and optimize virtualization clusters, including vSphere HA, DRS, resource pools, hosts, datastores, and distributed switches, and manage ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, and certificates.
    • Monitor platform capacity, availability, performance, and compliance, and recommend scaling, balancing, or remediation actions.
    • Engineer vSAN clusters, storage policies, and fault domains, and troubleshoot vSAN performance, resynchronization, and policy-compliance issues.
    • Engineer NSX segments, transport zones, gateways, routing, and distributed security controls, coordinating changes with network and cybersecurity teams.
    • Administer SRM protection groups and recovery plans, develop and maintain automated failover and failback procedures, and support quarterly COOP exercises and continuity events.
    • Design and implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI, or APIs, with version control, peer review, testing, rollback, secrets protection, and drift detection.
    • Coordinate with workload owners on resource requirements, placement, templates, and snapshots, preserving the division between platform and workload ownership.
    • Provide Tier 4 engineering support for cross-platform incidents, isolate platform faults during outages, and conduct root-cause analyses and develop corrective actions.
    • Maintain platform configuration backups, apply DISA STIGs and security baselines, and support RMF evidence, vulnerability remediation, and vendor-advisory reviews.
    • Support technology refreshes and modernization; develop platform roadmaps, technical options, and rough-order cost estimates.
    • Support DISA-hosting transitions through discovery, dependency documentation, readiness assessment, migration waves, test and rollback plans, cutover, and post-migration stabilization.
    • Maintain architecture diagrams, as-built documentation, SOPs, and recovery procedures, and provide platform metrics and modernization status for program reporting.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.
    • Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in virtualization, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation.
    • Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter and with vSAN, NSX, SRM, or comparable software-defined storage, network-virtualization, and disaster-recovery technologies.
    • Experience developing or maintaining infrastructure-automation solutions and troubleshooting complex issues across compute, storage, network, virtualization, and automation layers.
    • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, capacity management, and lifecycle practices.
    • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

      • Preferred:

      • Formal Terraform and Ansible training.
      • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Aria, and PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs.
      • Experience supporting federal or DoD virtualization environments and migrations to DISA enterprise-hosting platforms.
      • Experience with DISA STIGs, RMF controls, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance.
      • Experience developing Infrastructure as Code within CI/CD and Git workflows with automated testing and code scanning.

Certifications

    • Required: None.
    • Preferred: VMware Certified Professional, VMware Certified Advanced Professional, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant cloud, security, storage, or network certification.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.
    • Occasional on-site support, after-hours maintenance, disaster-recovery exercises, incident response, and travel may be required.

jobs.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Database Programmer is responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance, and archiving of clinical study databases throughout the study lifecycle. This role will play a key part in supporting the deployment, adoption, and ongoing development of Medidata Rave EDC as Alimentiv expands its Electronic Data Capture (EDC) capabilities.

The successful candidate will bring hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC and C# programming to develop custom functions, support database configurations, and contribute to clinical database programming activities independently. Working closely with internal project teams and sponsors, this position will help ensure successful database delivery, technical support, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and test files required for electronic data uploads, data transfers, and integrations.

  • Program and generate clinical data listings and project tracking reports to support ongoing studies.

  • Manage database access, process change request (CR) publishing requests, and archive electronic data and documentation upon study completion.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve database programming issues, providing technical expertise and support to internal teams and sponsors.

  • Communicate database setup progress, project milestones, and technical issues to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in C# programming, with the ability to independently develop, test, and troubleshoot custom functions within Medidata Rave EDC.

  • Experience developing and maintaining electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs) and automated edit checks.

  • Knowledge of clinical database programming processes, including data transfers, electronic data uploads, and reporting.

  • Experience generating clinical data listings and project tracking reports.

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently address database programming challenges.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with internal project teams, sponsors, and external stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet project milestones.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Ghost Story Games is a self-publishing game development studio founded by Ken Levine (Creative Director of System Shock 2, Bioshock, and Bioshock Infinite) and former Irrational Games developers. The studio’s mission is to create narrative-driven experiences rooted in immersive world building and gameplay.

The Challenge:

Ghost Story Games is seeking a talented remote Senior Technical Level Artist to join us on Judas, the highly anticipated game led by Ken Levine (System Shock 2, BioShock series). Unique in its creative vision, Judas is also built upon novel technology by which the visual world, gameplay, and story unfolds in meaningful, dynamic ways. The result is a significant and personal journey adapted to each player’s experience and offers a new approach to the art and storytelling of video games.

For the Senior Technical Level Artist role, you should be experienced in a breadth and depth of generalist real-time CG expertise, including modular level layout and scene composition, modeling, materials, and lighting. You should be passionate about telling compelling stories through environmental art, while thoughtfully crafting spaces and visuals with the needs of gameplay in mind. It is essential the Senior Technical Level Artist is fully immersed in the novel technical pipelines, world and storytelling systems of Judas. We both expect and welcome you to contribute creative and technical suggestions to elevate the technology and workflows further, while collaborating closely together with Narrative, Design, and other Art counterparts, to bring the best vision of Judas to life.

At Ghost Story Games we place the utmost importance on memorable, immersive visual storytelling, through all aspects of the game experience, and the close team collaboration necessary to realize a shared vision together. Join us and play a key role in Judas’ success!

What You’ll Take On

  • You will work with the Art Director and Lead Artist and various level art teams to ensure the various thematic spaces of the world of Judas are executed to a high degree of technical and creative standards.
  • With a deep immersion in the lore and purpose of the environmental spaces you will leverage your technical skillset and approach to thoughtful world building and visual storytelling. You will help span narrative-driven visual support of quests, the development of overall environmental ‘theme’ visual identities, and support key Level and System Design features that overlap the environmental design of Judas.
  • You will develop a deep understanding of the Judas’ visual and level building systems: how its thematic spaces are built, organized, and triggered in-game. This includes partnering with level artists and quest pods to ensure those spaces are set up correctly and functioning as intended, and collaborating with tech and QA to troubleshoot and resolve any issues.
  • Serve as the key driver of all visual assets supporting spaces under your responsibility. This includes highly proactive and collaborative engagement with Art Leadership, Level and Narrative Design, Concept Art, and External Art Vendors 
  • As a Senior Technical Level Artist, you are expected to help uphold the high standards of aesthetic and technical quality of your own work and leverage your expertise to identify opportunities for both visual and technical quality improvements across the project and effectively pitch to project leadership

What You Bring:

  • Established experience in the game industry as a Senior Artist, preferably with experience working with larger, complex productions
  • Proficient art and technical experience within a real-time Game Engine (Unreal 4 is a plus).
  • Experienced eye for form, line, value, rhythm, composition, and crafting deliberate visual hierarchy reads (focus direction, small-medium-large shape balance, ‘80/20 rule’)
  • Familiarity with performance evaluation and optimization – working mindfully within metrics to maintain a smooth player experience
  • Experience with effective team-based iteration techniques, including a thoughtful consideration of the bigger picture of the overall game experience and creative vision and an ‘order of operation’ and ‘ROI’ approach to iterative development.
  • Ability to learn and understand technical tools and systems so they can be pushed to the limit to create the most visually interesting spaces

Who You Are:

  • Proactive problem solver that enjoys cross-department collaboration, asks engaging questions, and can thoughtfully pitch both creative and visual ideas, as well as technical and process improvements to benefit the quality and efficiency of the project
  • For the Senior role, we are especially looking for individuals with experience and mindfulness towards both individual and team efficiency, and proven ability to work on more challenging cross-functional tasks with a very high degree of ambiguity and autonom

Great To Have:

  • Passion for deeply narrative driven games, particularly First Person Shooters
  • Additional traditional art, lighting, or cinematography background
  • Experience working effectively and collaborative with a diverse mix of internal and distributed teams

Description

​​Centralized monitoring is an integral part of a risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers, and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.

The central monitor is responsible for conducting a holistic and centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock according to the centralized monitoring plan, using analytical tools to identify emerging and existing risks to critical study data and process. The central monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level. ​

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • ​​Follow established procedures for the review of clinical trial data (Operational and Subject data) using a variety of tools and systems in alignment with the centralized monitoring plan and with support from the senior team members.
  • ​Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site and track the evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
  • ​Ensure results of reviews are appropriately documented per procedures.
  • ​Support Central Monitoring teams with performance of assigned reviews with high quality, on-time results.
  • ​Provide input to senior team member as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.
  • ​Support review set-up as directed by assigned lead including updating department database, pulling reports, etc. as assigned.
  • ​Share the responsibility for data quality at the study, country and site levels.​

Requirements

Education

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

Experience

  • ​Minimum of 1 year of experience in central statistical monitoring with overall 6 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
  • ​Basic understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
  • ​Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
  • ​Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS, etc.).
  • ​Good computer skills, with knowledge of advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
  • ​Ideally a basic level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
  • ​Must have been involved in the analysis and review of clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
  • ​Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.

Attributes

  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels in an organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Satisfactory understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

Note that this opening is for a home-based position in India. Attendance at some meetings outside of regular business hours (primarily in the evening) is required.

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology and Rheumatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.
