jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Senior Regional Commercial Category Manager - Mechanical & Electrical Installations is a new role for the Projects Business Line, in response to market and client preferences for EP+ delivery models, and will lead strategic procurement and category management for specialized, high-value electrical and mechanical installation activities across North American projects. This role is responsible for executing North American procurement strategies while developing tailored regional approaches aligned with project execution and overall business objectives. Key focus areas include supplier development and strategy, proposal costing and optimization, execution negotiations, risk mitigation, and ensuring on-time delivery of critical installation scope. In a collaborative matrix environment with project execution teams, engineering, and construction leadership, this role drives cost optimization, schedule adherence, and operational excellence while managing complex contractor relationships and specialized contractual frameworks.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management - Develop and manage a preferred network of electrical and mechanical installation contractors. Evaluate contractor qualifications including technical expertise, safety performance, insurance coverage, bonding capacity, and geographic reach. Create long-term partnerships and framework agreements that balance cost, quality, schedule, and risk. Analyze market trends, pricing, and contractor capacity to inform sourcing strategies. Drive continuous improvement with key contractors on productivity, safety, and performance. Optimize contractor allocation across projects to maximize capacity utilization and cost efficiency. Execute multi-million dollar cost reduction initiatives. Consolidate orders across national and regional projects to leverage negotiation power and achieve economies of scale.

Proposal Development & Cost Analysis - Lead proposal development, tendering, and evaluation for electrical and mechanical installation packages. Build detailed cost models incorporating labor rates, material escalation, equipment costs, mobilization, and site-specific factors. Conduct total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses evaluating schedule impact, quality risk, contractual considerations, and post-installation support. Optimize contractor proposals to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising scope or safety. Benchmark costs against industry standards and historical project data.

Contract Negotiations & Commercial Strategy - Lead negotiations with contractors on pricing, terms, conditions, and commercial frameworks throughout proposal and execution phases. Develop specialized contract terms tailored to installation scope, risk profile, and project requirements. Establish clear scope definitions, division of responsibility, and interface management protocols. Negotiate insurance requirements, bonding, and risk allocation frameworks. Secure favorable payment terms, performance incentives, and schedule-based adjustments. Manage contract amendments and change orders to maintain cost control and schedule integrity.

Risk Management & Compliance - Develop comprehensive risk management strategies addressing installation-specific hazards, schedule risks, and performance uncertainties. Define appropriate insurance requirements, coverage limits, and liability frameworks. Document clear divisions of responsibility between contractors, clients, and other trades. Implement risk mitigation strategies including performance bonds, parent company guarantees, and liquidated damages provisions. Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental requirements, and industry standards.

Contractor Performance & Delivery Management - Establish post-award management protocols ensuring contractor mobilization, resource allocation, and schedule adherence. Monitor contractor performance against key metrics (schedule, quality, safety, cost). Conduct regular performance reviews and implement corrective action plans for underperforming contractors. Manage invoicing, payment processing, and financial reconciliation. Coordinate with project teams on schedule optimization and delivery risks. Drive on-time delivery through proactive management and contractor accountability. Manage escalations, disputes, and change management processes. Conduct post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner with project execution, legal, insurance, contract management, engineering, and construction teams to align procurement strategies with business objectives. Collaborate with tendering teams to develop competitive bid packages and evaluation criteria. Implement best-in-class procurement practices and leverage global frameworks. Coordinate with safety, quality, and compliance functions to ensure contractor alignment with organizational standards. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to understand project needs and identify optimization opportunities.

The above is not designed to capture all the employee’s responsibilities but is intended to capture essential functions of the role. Responsibilities may change over time and may be assigned at any time.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Deep knowledge of electrical and mechanical installation execution, contractor operations, construction methodologies, and site realities
  • Strong negotiation skills with proven ability to secure favorable terms in complex, high-stakes contractor agreements
  • Deep knowledge of procurement category management, contractor management, and installation-specific procurement practices
  • Respond constructively to changing project requirements, site conditions, and contractor performance issues
  • Work independently with strong drive toward schedule adherence and cost optimization
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders at all levels; clear documentation of contractual frameworks and expectations
  • Proven ability to work effectively across project teams, procurement, contract management, engineering, construction, legal, and contractor organizations; building trust and accountability

Education & Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Business Management
  • 10+ years of experience in electrical and mechanical installation procurement, contractor management, or EPC construction execution
  • Proven experience in procurement, sourcing, contract management, or project management within an EPC project setting
  • Demonstrated expertise in installation contractor management, including evaluation, development, and performance management
  • Advanced knowledge of specialized terms and conditions, insurance requirements, bonding, and risk allocation frameworks specific to installation contracts
  • Proven ability to develop detailed scope of work definitions and manage division of responsibility across multiple contractors and trades
  • Strong understanding of installation execution, construction methodologies, site logistics, and contractor operations
  • Expertise in proposal evaluation, cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis for installation services
  • Demonstrated success in complex negotiations with contractors on pricing, terms, and commercial frameworks
  • Proven track record of managing post-award contractor performance and ensuring on-time delivery
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to identify cost optimization and schedule improvement opportunities
  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities
  • Advanced knowledge of construction industry standards, safety regulations, and compliance requirements

Preferred

  • 15+ years of experience in electrical and mechanical installation procurement, contractor management, or EPC construction execution
  • Direct EPC firm, construction company, or major industrial contractors experience with a focus on contractor installations
  • Professional procurement certification (e.g., C.P.M., CPSM, CIPS)
  • Professional project management certification (e.g., PMP)

What you’ll do

This role sits at the intersection of technology, law, and healthcare. Reporting to the Director of Legal and Regulatory Operations, you will manage Flatiron’s regulatory program and partner with Legal, technical and other business stakeholders to ensure Flatiron’s point of care products meet and maintain regulatory and certification requirements. You will also play a key role in driving daily legal operations and strategic projects to improve overall Legal team efficiency and effectiveness. Core job responsibilities includes:

  • Develop and execute against the regulatory program roadmap to ensure regulatory requirements are timely and effectively implemented
    • Serve as primary liaison between legal and business and technical stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into actionable plans
    • Drive accountability with teams to ensure timely completion of regulatory requirements
    • Compile and submit regulatory reporting requirements, coordinating across Product, Legal, and external regulatory certification bodies.
  • Manage and refine regulatory program processes that support compliance with industry regulations.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve processes to ensure efficiency and effectiveness, incorporating feedback from technical and legal teams.
    • Manage training programs to educate relevant teams on regulatory requirements, policies, and best practices and ensure that teams understand how regulatory compliance impacts their work.
  • Ensure Flatiron’s adherence to all regulatory obligations.
    • Monitor the overall compliance of Flatiron’s regulated products and services.
    • Supports regulatory incidents or corrective action plans that may impact regulatory compliance, as needed.
    • Maintain good standing with federal regulatory certification programs, including the ONC certification program for Health IT developers.
    • Participate in relevant regulatory communities/industries; gathers regulatory policy intelligence and analyzes changes in the regulatory environment to inform decision making.
  • Drive contract lifecycle management (CLM) to ensure the timely execution of commercial agreements
    • Support ongoing maintenance of CLM tool, Ironclad, across legal and all business units, configuring system and workflows to meet stakeholder needs
    • Maintain contracting process documentation and provide end user training for new sales representatives and account managers.
    • Route contracts for signature as needed and ensure all executed agreements are correctly archived
    • Establish reporting to assess CLM KPIs and drive data-driven process improvement
  • Identify opportunities and lead projects to enable greater efficiency across the Legal team
    • Identify and implement tools (including AI functionality) to streamline practices, as well as manage design, rollout, and training for new systems
    • Assist in developing legal and regulatory knowledge management systems and practices to preserve and deploy information assets (e.g. organization of Legal team drive and document management processes, etc.)

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate and collaborative individual, excited by the prospect of rolling up your sleeves to tackle meaningful problems each and every day. You have 3-5 years of experience in operations, program management, or project management in a highly regulated environment (ideally health tech or healthcare). You have familiarity with software development and contracting processes and are willing to learn the legal and regulatory landscape that impacts our products and services.

  • You have robust problem solving and project management skills and a bias for action with demonstrated success executing projects with multiple dependencies and maintaining accountability and relationships with stakeholders
  • You demonstrate autonomy in decision-making and execution while maintaining open communication with stakeholders, ensuring collaboration and seeking input when necessary. You recognize and escalate issues appropriately to avoid working in isolation and to address challenges efficiently
  • You have the ability to identify what’s important and effectively prioritize competing workstreams
  • You have excellent communications skills, with the ability to synthesize, simplify, and explain complex topics to different cross-functional stakeholders
  • You have demonstrated ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • You have a high degree of comfort with ambiguity and are able to quickly develop hypotheses with limited information

Extra Credit

  • Knowledge of the following healthcare regulatory programs: Office of the National Coordinator for Health Information Technology (ONC)’s Health IT certification program and certain CMS regulatory programs (e.g., MIPS)
  • Experience developing, implementing, and using legal department technology solutions, e.g., Ironclad/Contract Lifecycle Management software and Docusign e-signature
  • Experience identifying, implementing, or leveraging AI tools or AI agents to streamline and scale legal or regulatory processes (e.g., Credal, Claude Cowork, Gemini)

Where you’ll work

This role can be based remotely or in our NYC or Durham office. For NY and Durham candidates you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and 3 office days set by you and your team. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

  • Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals
  • Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice
  • Mental well-being tools and services
  • Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave
  • Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate Diversity in the workplace.

As a Senior Lead Analyst, Enterprise Data Governance, you will own the execution and ongoing management of the enterprise data quality framework, methodology, and measurement approach across data domains. You will provide an independent view of data quality performance, helping leaders understand where data issues create business risk and where improvements can deliver measurable value. In addition, you will lead the Critical Data Element (CDE) approach, establish meaningful quality measures and thresholds, develop executive and Board-level scorecards, and drive remediation of data quality issues to their source.


Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred to accommodate business needs.

What You Will Do

  • Author and maintain the enterprise Data Quality Policy, framework, and methodology; socialize and drive adoption
  • Define the CDE methodology and support Domain Working Groups in identifying CDEs and setting defensible thresholds
  • Build and run Board-level Data Quality (DQ) scorecards; establish baselines and report trends against them
  • Oversee remediation: track issues to closure at source, escalate systemic defects, and drive root-cause analysis with process and system owners
  • Independently assess master data quality reported by Enterprise MDM, so measurement is separated from execution
  • Translate quality performance into business outcome and cost-of-poor-quality terms: preventable disputes, working capital, close effort, straight-through processing, and acquisition integration time

What You Need

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Data Management, Business, or a related field
  • Minimum 6+ years in data quality, data management, or analytics, including ownership of an enterprise or multi-domain Data Quality program
  • Demonstrated experience building Data Quality frameworks, rules, scorecards, and remediation processes
  • Strong analytical and SQL capability; comfort profiling and interpreting large data sets
  • Experience presenting quality performance to senior leadership

Preferred:

  • Master’s Degree
  • Experience with Informatica Data Quality (DQ) or comparable DQ tooling
  • Experience in a regulated industry with DQ experience (ALCOA+, Part 11)
  • Experience quantifying cost of poor data quality

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices.
jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

As a Senior Product Designer, you will shape the systems and experiences that support our customers across web and mobile products. Your primary focus will be leading the evolution, quality, and adoption of our established design system, including its components, tokens, documentation, accessibility standards, and governance. You will partner closely with engineering to maintain alignment between designed and coded components while helping teams use the system effectively and consistently.


You will also serve as a UX partner to product management for TheraNest initiatives, applying product design and user research expertise to create accessible, responsive, and intuitive experiences. This role is an opportunity to influence design at scale while remaining connected to customer needs and hands-on product work.


***A portfolio/website is required to apply.***


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the evolution, management, and quality of the design system across web and native mobile experiences.
  • Own and improve its components, patterns, tokens, documentation, accessibility standards, and governance practices.
  • Partner closely with your engineering counterpart to plan, design, review, test, quality-assure, and release design system updates.
  • Maintain strong parity between designed and coded sources, and help teams understand how components should behave across responsive experiences.
  • Build accessibility into components and patterns from the beginning.
  • Evaluate and test design system solutions for accessibility and usability, advocate for WCAG and ADA-aligned practices, and document accessibility expectations for designers and engineers.
  • Maintain clear design system documentation, including usage guidance, responsive behaviors, specifications, implementation considerations, and accessibility standards.
  • Support the system’s AI readiness through effective documentation, tokens, guidance, skills, and connections.
  • Lead design system meetings, office hours, demonstrations, critiques, and other team rituals.
  • Communicate updates, gather feedback, support adoption, educate teams, and identify emerging system needs.
  • Execute and strengthen design system governance.
  • Review requests from designers and engineers, balance consistency with product needs, and help teams make informed decisions about when to use, adapt, or propose additions to the system.
  • Write and prioritize design system backlog items in partnership with the product owner and engineering. Translate user, product, design, and technical needs into clear, actionable work.
  • Partner with product managers as their UX counterpart for assigned TheraNest initiatives. Provide product design and research expertise while collaborating with engineering, subject-matter experts, and stakeholders throughout iterative product cycles.
  • Design user-centered solutions that align with business goals and target success metrics.
  • Create experiences that are useful, highly usable, responsive, accessible, and thoughtfully crafted.
  • Produce a range of design artifacts, including concepts, wireframes, user flows, mockups, prototypes, specifications, and detailed design deliverables.
  • Plan and conduct user research and usability testing in collaboration with product partners.
  • Analyze and synthesize findings, translate insights into product decisions, and communicate results to cross-functional teams.
  • Present design work to internal teams, subject-matter experts, and stakeholders to explain decisions, gather feedback, and build alignment.
  • Consider, follow, and advocate for applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including requirements related to protected health information and HIPAA.
  • Use approved AI tools to assist, automate, accelerate, and improve the quality of design, research, documentation, and related workflows.
  • Mentor other designers, provide constructive design feedback, and help raise design craft and design system fluency across the team.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in product or UX design, including 3+ years leading design systems used by multiple product teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience managing and evolving an effective design system, including components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and governance.
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to design quality.
  • Strong knowledge of accessibility standards and practices, including WCAG and ADA, with experience advocating for and implementing accessible design approaches.
  • Experience designing responsive web and native mobile experiences.
  • Proven experience designing complex products in partnership with product managers and cross-functional teams in iterative product cycles.
  • Advanced Figma skills, including component design, prototyping, branching, token management, AI tools, documentation, and methods for maintaining design and code parity.
  • Experience partnering directly with engineering on a coded component library, along with a working understanding of HTML and CSS.
  • Strong communication skills, including presenting to stakeholders and effectively giving and receiving design critique.
  • An online portfolio demonstrating both design system and product design work. A portfolio is required to apply.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AI tools in design, research, prototyping, documentation, or product development workflows.
  • Experience preparing design systems to work effectively with AI-enabled tools and development practices.
  • Experience conducting design and research for healthcare, behavioral health, regulated, or data-sensitive products.
  • Experience migrating products from legacy interfaces or systems to a modern design system.
  • Strong technical proficiency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience designing React components or working with Material UI.
  • Experience using product analytics platforms to inform design decisions and measure outcomes.
  • User research and user testing capabilities, including planning, data collection, and analysis.

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria.

The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

AtEnsora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. ​

​We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.

Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.


Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position is a remote opportunity in the Abbott Diabetes Care Division. We are helping people with Diabetes lead healthier, happier lives. As a global leader in diabetes care, Abbott is constantly working to deliver the highest quality products and unwavering support to our customers. Consistent and accurate glucose monitoring is the foundation of any diabetes management plan, so we’re committed to continuous improvement in the way patients and professionals measure, track and analyze glucose levels.


The Diabetes Sales Associate is responsible for growing sales with HCPs assigned to the territory by developing customer relationships, being an ambassador for Abbott’s FreeStyle products, and strengthening overall market presence. This role is instrumental in delivery of sales and profitability objectives, as well as expanding brand reputation. This is a field-sales opportunity.

  • Meeting or exceeding sales quotas/objectives for FreeStyle Libre portfolio.
  • Leverage company generated targets to prospect for new business and close for new sales in expanded marketplace.
  • Collaborate with various channels partners within HCP, Managed Care, Retail, and Point of Care organizations.
  • Establish strong relationships with a broad base of internal and external health care constituents (e.g., physicians, nurses, pharmacists, CDEs, etc.).
  • Act with a sense of purpose and urgency, engaging in a friendly, respectful manner. Focus on the needs and interest of others, while motivating change.
  • Keep current on internal and competitive products and position by utilizing a variety of resources.
  • Develop proficiency in the Company’s sales model to ensure product adoption and utilization along the buying cycle.
  • Understand and convey information professionally and accurately.
  • Develop business plans based on current trends and goals that include short and long-term actions.
  • Keep current in market trends and competitor’s strategy.
  • Deliver sales results as assigned in primary care market, focusing on driving broad awareness and education of CGM and the FreeStyle Libre brand. Deliver sales results within endocrinology market as assigned.
  • Position products and services using appropriate resources using confident, convincing logic.
  • Tailor sales approach to meet customer needs by utilizing appropriate resources.
  • Handle objections and explore perspectives and tactfully address them.
  • Develop and implement plans (e.g., territory, account and call) that include goals, action plans, time frames and resources.
  • Convey information clearly and concisely. Respond to others and listen carefully to understand the message.
  • Regularly track and report progress against plan. Redirect efforts as necessary.

  • Document daily, weekly and monthly activities utilizing call reporting / tracking system.
  • Maintain accountability for all samples in accordance with Division guidelines.
  • Work within quality guidelines established for compliance.
  • Implement and maintain the effectiveness of the quality system.

  • Minimum of 1-3 years previous sales experience with a successful sales track record from previous positions
  • Excellent communication skills, high energy, integrity and ambition to succeed

Preferred

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Divisional Information

Medical Devices


General Medical Devices:

Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.


CRM

As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.


Diabetes

We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.


Vascular

Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive, and cost-effective products for treatment of vascular disease.


Neuromodulation

Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.


Structural Heart

Structural Heart Business Mission: why we exist

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.


EP

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


HF

In Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


Diagnostics

We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.


Abbott Molecular is a leader in molecular diagnostics and the analysis of DNA, RNA, and proteins at the molecular level.


Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key heath and therapeutic areas, including infections disease, cardiometabolic, informatics and toxicology.


Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments and informatics systems are often the first step in patient care decision making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.


Our rapid diagnostics solutions are helping address some of the world’s greatest healthcare challenges.


Nutrition

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow to keeping adult bodies strong and active. jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

In our mission to take care of every member like they were our own family,, we believe that data is a super power to deliver great service and clinical care. Our Data Platform team designs and builds the infrastructure to support this capability.

In this role, you will write tools to make it easier for our Data Scientists and Engineers to build and deploy scalable, reliable data pipelines, machine learning models, and LLM powered tools. You will help develop and improve a Data Platform built with tools like Snowflake, Apache Airflow, dbt, Kubernetes, Terraform, and all the leading AI labs. You will work on a wide range of impactful projects. Examples of our work include a Change-Data-Capture solution to stream data to Snowflake, a custom Snowflake SQL formatter, an internal Semantic Layer and Data Agent that lets users ask questions about our data in plain language and develop dashboards and analyses. We write most of our tools in Go.

You will be joining a team that values using the right tool for the job with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and maintainability. We also believe in continuously evaluating decisions and striving for improvement as a team. Additionally, we value sharing knowledge, eliminating silos, and collaboration. We use AI coding agents as part of our everyday workflow and are always looking for ways to work smarter.


Responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop and maintain a robust, scalable data platform that serves analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads
  • Build and evolve the infrastructure behind our Semantic Layer and Data Agent, including how LLMs discover, understand, and safely query our data
  • Establish evaluation, observability, and quality practices for AI systems that depend on the data platform, so we can measure accuracy and catch regressions
  • Collaborate with Data Science and Product Engineering on tooling to develop and deploy reliable data and AI products
  • Ensure data availability, quality, and reliability in the data platform
  • Identify areas for improvement with the platform
  • Propose new/improved solutions and lead them from design to implementation
  • Develop best practices for data modelling, pipelines, and testing


Attributes to success:

  • Experience coupled with a willingness to learn new things, especially in a fast-moving AI landscape
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to be close to business problems
  • Pragmatism about AI. Excitement for what it can do, paired with clear thinking about where it isn’t the right tool
  • Desire to work in a collaborative environment and improve as a team
  • Desire to contribute individually with the ability to self-direct work

Required skills and experience:

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment
  • 5+ years working as an individual technical contributor
  • 5+ years' experience with data platforms
  • Experience working with Cloud Data Warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.)
  • Experience developing in Python or Go
  • Experience with a Workflow Orchestrator (Airflow, Luigi, Dagster, Prefect, etc.)
  • A strong understanding of data warehousing and data modelling principles
  • Experience with semantic or metrics layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML, etc.)

Desired skills and experience:

  • Regular use of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in your development workflow
  • Hands-on experience building or supporting applications that use LLMs (via Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar APIs)
  • Experience designing evaluations for LLM systems, such as text-to-SQL accuracy

    Salary range: $131,000-200,000 plus cash bonus and equity

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

jobs.title: Senior Identity Governance Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Ready to be a Titan? At ServiceTitan, we are building a next-generation identity fabric, and this role engineers the governance layer on top of it.
jobs.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we are building a next-generation identity fabric, and this role engineers the governance layer on top of it. Identity spans cloud environments, SaaS applications, data systems, machine identities, and now AI agents, which makes it one of the most sprawling attack surfaces in the enterprise. You will make sure every identity, whether a Titan, a third-party contractor, a service account, or an AI agent, has the right access, for the right reason, at the right time, and that we can prove it.


Corporate Engineering (IT) administer our identity platforms, including Okta and Lumos, and run lifecycle operations. InfoSec defines identity governance requirements and validates that controls work. You sit in InfoSec and engineer the governance layer: authentication and authorization design standards, entitlement models, access review automation, and audit-ready evidence. You administer Veza with Corporate Security, Security Architecture, Product Security, and Security Operations, work with Corporate Engineering and System Owners to put governance requirements into practice, and you will be a key owner of our ISPM and IGA program.


What you'll do:

You engineer identity governance: the tooling, automation, and design standards that make access reviewable and provable. Corporate Engineering and IT administer the identity platforms, and InfoSec GRC owns the policies and the review program.

  • Access Request Governance: Define governance requirements and design patterns for access request workflows across privileged systems (code repositories, databases, infrastructure), including role-based, time-bound, delegated, and just-in-time access, and measure adoption so access is not granted outside the governed workflow. Corporate Engineering and IT administer Lumos and implement the workflows; you specify the requirements, build the monitoring that detects bypass, and validate that they work.
  • Authentication & Authorization Design: Partner with Security Architecture to define authentication and authorization design standards (SSO, MFA and phishing-resistant requirements, OIDC/SAML/SCIM patterns, least-privilege role models) for enterprise tools, and review integrations against them.
  • Authorization Governance & Entitlement Design: Provide the technical design for authorization decisions on job functions and privileged data access, including critical systems such as ST Admin roles, Snowflake, Salesforce, and other high-risk entitlements. Build role models scoped to job function and normalize entitlement data across applications in Veza so access can be reviewed like for like.
  • Access Review & Lifecycle Automation: Build and operate the tooling and automation behind the user access review program (SOX ITGC, PCI DSS, SOC 1/2, ISO 27001), which InfoSec GRC owns, and behind joiner/mover/leaver control assurance, including leaver access-reversion evidence, reconciliation against the authoritative HR source, and orphaned account detection.
  • Privileged Access Governance: Build visibility into standing privileged access across core cloud infrastructure and the data platform and drive it down, moving toward time-bound elevation (PIM and JIT) with governed exceptions for the access that must remain.
  • Identity Fabric Architecture: Define the target-state governance architecture across Okta, Veza, and Lumos and the risk-based identity lifecycle it supports. You administer Veza in combination with Corporate Security, Security Architecture, Product Security, and Security Operations, building its data source integrations, policies, and alerts. Corporate Engineering and IT administer Okta and Lumos, and you partner with them on lifecycle and workflow integration.
  • ISPM & Continuous Governance: Add continuous monitoring to periodic certifications. Build identity analytics that detect over-privileged accounts, shadow identities, dormant access, and identity drift, and automate remediation workflows with named owners.
  • Non-Human Identity & AI Security: Build the inventory and governance workflows for service accounts, API keys, personal access tokens, and AI agents, including ownership, rotation, and attestation requirements, and drive remediation with owning teams. Ensure AI integrations are covered by rigorous entitlement management, in partnership with our AI governance review process.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Corporate Engineering, the administrative owner of identity platforms and lifecycle operations, alongside Security Architecture and System Owners to ensure every enterprise tool is integrated with identity by design, while InfoSec GRC defines identity governance requirements and validates control effectiveness.
  • Compliance as Code & Audit Support: Provide the technical identity evidence for audit requests (SOX, PCI, ISO 27001, SOC 1/2), partnering with our SOX IT compliance team, who coordinate with auditors. Automate evidence collection so compliance is a byproduct of good engineering, not a manual chore.
  • Vendor Engagement: Partner with Corporate Engineering to engage our strategic identity vendors (Veza, Okta, Lumos). Hold vendors accountable to their commitments and service levels, influence their product roadmaps, and secure the implementation and adoption support we need to maximize our return on investment.

What you'll bring:

We are looking for deep identity experience, whether in governance, administration, engineering, or a mix of these, paired with hands-on technical skills. You build the tools that make governance work.

  • The Fundamentals: 5+ years in identity and access, with depth in Identity Governance & Administration. Broader experience in identity and access engineering (SSO, provisioning, directory or identity platform automation) is welcome alongside a governance background. You deeply understand lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), RBAC/ABAC and entitlement modeling, Separation of Duties, privileged access governance, and the Principle of Least Privilege, and you can design and automate access certification programs at enterprise scale.
  • The Modern Stack: Hands-on experience with modern IGA and identity discovery tools (e.g., Veza for authorization graphs and entitlement visibility, Lumos for SaaS governance and access requests, Okta for lifecycle orchestration and identity governance workflows). Experience administering an authorization graph platform such as Veza is especially valuable, since you will own it in partnership with other security teams.
  • Authentication & Authorization Design: Working knowledge of authentication and authorization standards and patterns (SSO, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, MFA, RBAC/ABAC) and the ability to review enterprise integrations against them.
  • NHI Governance: Proven experience governing non-human identities (service accounts, API keys, workload identities) in cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP), including inventory, ownership assignment, rotation and expiry requirements, periodic attestation, and risk exception handling. You can read cloud IAM and secrets management configurations and partner with the engineering teams who operate those platforms.
  • Security Posture: Understanding of ISPM principles, including detecting identity drift, excessive entitlements, orphaned accounts, and misconfigurations before they are exploited, and turning those findings into governed remediation.
  • Compliance Fluency: Ability to translate regulatory and audit requirements (SOX ITGC, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) into identity controls, automated workflows, and audit-ready evidence. You are comfortable working directly with internal and external auditors.
  • Automation & Engineering Skills: Proficiency in a scripting language (e.g., Python or Go), plus API integration experience and familiarity with workflow or low-code tooling, to automate access reviews, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.

Who You Are

  • A Systems Thinker: You understand the balance between People, Process, and Technology. You don't just fix a ticket; you fix the process that created the ticket.
  • An Enabler of Innovation: You believe security should be a tailwind, not a headwind. You build identity governance that lets Titans move faster and collaborate safely.
  • Data-Driven: You use identity analytics to find high-risk areas and prioritize work based on actual risk data.

Why This Role Matters

As ServiceTitan scales and integrates AI across our platform, identity governance is what keeps access defensible. Your work protects customer data, supports the trust our customers place in us, and lets our teams move faster with confidence.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role isZone 1: $134,500 USD - $201,700 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WAZone 2: $125,700 USD - $188,500 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.description:
Build your market. Grow your network. Share in the success. Pure IP, a BCM One company, is expanding its U.S. sales presence and looking for entrepreneurial National Account Executives who are energized by creating new business from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to own your territory, build your pipeline, and directly influence your financial success while developing channel partnerships that create meaningful growth for our partners. We’re looking for a true new-logo hunter who combines urgency and initiative with a consultative, value-based approach to selling, connecting customer challenges to business outcomes and turning strong relationships into shared growth.

Work Location:

This is a remote position based in New England (ideally CT, MA, or VT) and will be responsible for managing the local territory. Candidates must reside within the region and be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for relocation or sponsorship.

Travel:

25-50% Domestic Travel Annually

What You Will Do:

  • Build a book of business from the ground up, driving net-new logos and self-generated pipeline through proactive prospecting and networking.
  • Develop and cultivate strong channel relationships that create mutual opportunities and drive financial growth for Pure IP and our partners.
  • Lead consultative, value-based sales conversations that uncover business challenges, quantify impact, engage key decision-makers, and connect solutions to meaningful customer outcomes.
  • Own your territory strategy, consistently managing prospecting activity, partner and customer engagement, pipeline, and forecasting.
  • Achieve sales and revenue goals while representing Pure IP’s business value and differentiation in customer meetings, partner engagements, and industry events.

What You Will Need:

  • 5+ years of relevant sales, business development, or channel experience within telecommunications, technology, or a related industry.
  • Proven success hunting and winning new-logo business and generating pipeline through proactive prospecting.
  • Experience building productive channel relationships and creating opportunities alongside partners.
  • Strong consultative and value-selling skills, with the ability to uncover business needs, qualify opportunities, articulate value, and align solutions to customer outcomes.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-driven, with the initiative and urgency to create opportunities rather than wait for them.
  • Strong business acumen, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with confidence engaging senior-level customers and partners.

Compensation:

$90,000 to $120,000 base salary. Commissions and benefits will be in addition to the base salary. Compensation at BCM One varies depending on a wide variety of factors, including and not limited to: office location, role, skill set, degree/certifications, and level of experience.

Who We Are:

BCM One is a leading telecom provider of NextGen Communications and Managed Services that has been in business for 30 years with more than 18,000 business customers and 5,000 channel partners who rely on our products, services, and teams to support their critical underlying network infrastructure. BCM One is the parent company to our family of brands that includes SIP.US, SIPTRUNK, Flowroute, SkySwitch, and Pure IP.

Joining the BCM One team is a chance to be part of a financially strong company with an exciting growth story; over the past 4 years we’ve brought together leading companies in our space who have built products, services, and programs to innovate and disrupt our industry. Now, operating under one roof, we are taking BCM One to the next level and looking for talented individuals to help make that happen.

When you choose to work at BCM One, you get to work with a talented team and build experience with the leading technologies, suppliers, and partners in our industry. We don’t offer cookie-cutter solutions, so the opportunities are endless, and the work is always varied and interesting. We take our mission “to provide a world-class experience with every human interaction” seriously, which means everything you do makes a difference. And we’re committed to building and nurturing a diverse and inclusive workforce and environment that empowers you to do your best work, spread your wings and reach your full potential. At BCM One, we encourage our team to learn something new every day, so you don’t just become part of our growth story, we become part of yours.

Why BCM One:

We are committed to creating an environment that fosters accountability, innovation, and teamwork. Many BCM One employees have been with the company for 10+ years, which we think says a lot about our culture.

We Are a Team

  • We pride ourselves on our team-based approach to providing quality solutions for our clients. BCM One encourages a culture of collaboration, exposing employees to different areas of the business and fostering career growth.
  • We support employee involvement and provide opportunities to be responsible stewards via our BCM One Gives Back Program and our Emergency Fund to help our team members who are going through difficult times.

Hard Work is Recognized

  • We offer an Employee of the Quarter program with a monetary award and Employee of the Year that includes a 7-day vacation package to the Caribbean. In addition, we host various regional team-building gatherings throughout the year.
  • We believe in developing our team members and offer many opportunities for training, professional development and career growth.

Your Voice is Heard

  • We empower our team members to speak up and look for opportunities in challenges.
  • We have an Employee Council and a Diversity Equity and Inclusion Committee made up of volunteers from across the company who share a passion for making BCM One a great place to work and find ways to positively impact our communities.

How we take care of you:

We are hiring a Facility Services Operations Manager to lead the daily operation behind our services.

The right person will stay close enough to the daily work to see where problems are happening, then improve the process so those problems do not keep repeating.

  • Set clear expectations for communication, documentation, urgency, and follow through
  • Monitor incoming requests, open work orders, response times, estimated arrival times, and completion progress

  • Make sure approved service providers are assigned based on trade, location, availability, and client requirements
  • Step in when a service provider is unresponsive, a client is frustrated, or a job is falling behind
  • Review work orders for accurate notes, photos, estimates, approvals, completion details, and invoices

  • Prepare regular operational reports for Bedrock leadership
  • Participate in an escalation schedule for urgent issues outside normal business hours
  • Travel to client locations or meet with service providers in Florida when needed

What We Are Looking For

  • At least five years of experience in facility services, maintenance operations, service dispatch, property operations, construction services, or a related field
  • At least two years of experience leading or supervising employees
  • Experience managing a high volume of work orders or service requests

Put the client first. Stay close to the work. Fix problems instead of passing them along. Set clear expectations and follow through.

Designer

About the role

We’ve just rebuilt Replika and we’re going through a renaissance, and our goal is exponential growth.

Growth creative is how we get there — across channels. We need a creative producer who can take a positioning idea on Monday and have it live by the end of the week, wherever it needs to run: paid campaigns on Meta, UGC on TikTok and Instagram, whatever the numbers point to. Written, cast, shot, cut, and shipped. This is the engine that feeds our growth, and you’re the one running it.

You’re not strategizing from a deck. You’re generating concepts, writing the scripts, writing the ad and TikTok copy in English yourself, sourcing and briefing creators, directing the shoots, cutting the paid ads, and reading the numbers to decide what to make next. Four, five, six shoots a week is normal, and so is a steady stream of paid creative iterations. The output is high, the bar is high, and the loop is fast.

Two things sit at the center of the role: paid campaign creative and UGC. On paid, you produce and iterate the ad creative that runs on Meta — the concepts, the hooks, the variants, the cuts that actually move the numbers. On UGC, you own our creator roster: a pool of creators and clippers you feed a steady stream of concepts worth making, and get quality work back from. Both are creative-first — the ideas are the job.

We work directly with product. When a creative idea needs a product hook, we ship the product hook the same day. You’ll be in the room for that, not waiting on it.

One thing we won’t compromise on: your English has to be genuinely excellent, and you have to have really written ad or TikTok copy in English that performed. If that’s you, keep reading.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Turn positioning and creative concepts into growth content across channels — ideate, script, storyboard, shoot, cut, and ship. Some of it’s UGC, some of it’s paid ad creative; the concept comes first, the channel follows.

  • Produce and iterate paid campaign creative for Meta — hooks, angles, variants, and cuts built to move the numbers. You make the ad, watch how it performs, and make the next one sharper. A steady stream of iterations, not a one-off drop.

  • Own and grow the UGC creator roster — recruit, brief, and manage a pool of creators and clippers. Feed them a steady stream of concepts worth making, develop the ideas they run with, and get quality work back without it eating your week.

  • Write the copy yourself — ad copy, hooks, captions, and TikTok-native copy in English that actually converts, not translated, not close enough.

  • Source, brief, and direct creators and actors. You find the right people, write briefs that don’t need rewriting, run the shoot, and get the best work out of them.

  • Own production end-to-end — concept, casting, locations, props, on-set direction, and post. You don’t hand this off, you run it.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in post-training methodologies, with a special focus on agentic behaviors and tool use. Your work will refine pre-trained models so that they not only deliver enhanced intelligence and domain specific capabilities, but also learn to reason, plan, and autonomously invoke external tools to solve real world, multi step tasks and applications on edge devices (i.e., smartphones).

You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from streamlined, resource efficient agents that run on limited hardware to complex multi modal architectures integrating text, images, and audio, all optimized for tool augmented decision making.

We expect you to have deep expertise in large language model architectures and substantial experience in post-training for agentic workflows, including tool use fine tuning, function calling, and reinforcement learning from feedback on multi turn interactions. You will adopt a hands-on, research driven approach to developing, testing, and implementing new post-training algorithms that unlock goal directed behavior, self correction, and reliable tool invocation.

Your responsibilities include curating agentic training data (e.g., trajectories of tool use, reasoning chains, environment interactions), strengthening baseline performance, and identifying as well as resolving bottlenecks in post-training for tool augmented agents to achieve SOTA model quality. The goal is to build models that do not just know but also act, use tools, and adapt, pushing the limits of what agentic AI can achieve.

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering initiatives to advance post-training of agentic and tool-use models to achieve SOTA results.

  • Drive broad, cross-cutting model improvements, including factuality, instruction adherence, tool/function use, multi-agent coordination, and reasoning calibration.

  • Design and enhance large-scale post-training systems, including data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation frameworks, and benchmark infrastructure.

  • Develop rigorous evaluation suites and diagnostic tools to assess model readiness for deployment.

  • Strengthen feedback loops from real-world product usage, incorporating both explicit and implicit user signals into post-training.

  • Collaborate with tooling, product, and training teams to improve the usefulness, reliability, and agentic capabilities of frontier models.

  • Closely liaise with research, engineering and cross-functional teams to determine which integrations are production-ready for inclusion in major model releases.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; advanced degree (MS/PhD) preferred with a strong publication record in top-tier AI conferences.

  • Experience with multimodal post-training workflows and data pipelines, particularly for agentic systems and tool use.

  • Demonstrated experience improving model capabilities in areas such as reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent coordination that achieve SOTA results.

  • Publications at leading AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, ECCV).

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.

We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.

About The Role

We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.

This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.

You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.

The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.

If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.


What You’ll Make Happen

  • Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
  • Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
  • Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
  • Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
  • Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
  • Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
  • Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
  • Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
  • Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
  • Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
  • Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
  • Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.

Your Expertise

  • Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
  • Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
  • Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
  • A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
  • Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
  • Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
  • Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
  • High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.

What Success Looks Like
  • Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
  • Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
  • You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
  • You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
  • You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
  • You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
  • You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.

This Role Will Suit You If
  • You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
  • You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
  • You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
  • You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
  • You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
  • You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.

This Role Will Not Suit You If
  • You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
  • You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
  • You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
  • You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
  • You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.

What It’s Like to Work Here

Modern Tools And Working Methods
Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.

Agility And Openness For Ideas
We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.

Client And Audience Impact
Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.

Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.

If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.

Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.

And that’s it!

jobs.description:
Vendor Expert (Cybersecurity Products)

Help security leaders make better technology decisions. Share your expertise on the products you know best.

IANS is building the Vendor Intelligence Database (VID), a next-generation cybersecurity practitioner intelligence platform designed to provide decision makers with practical, user written insights on cybersecurity products and services. Unlike traditional vendor profiles and analyst summaries, VID is built from the perspective of practitioners who have directly evaluated, implemented, administered, or operated these solutions in real-world environments.

We're looking for experienced cybersecurity professionals to serve as Vendor Experts and contribute insights for products they know through recent use.

What You'll Do

As a Vendor Expert, you'll share your experience with specific cybersecurity products by:

  • Contributing structured assessments and practitioner insights
  • Reviewing and validating product information
  • Highlighting strengths, limitations, and real-world use cases
  • Helping ensure information remains current as products evolve

Your contributions will help fellow practitioners cut through marketing claims and make more informed security technology decisions.

Why Participate?

  • Contribute only to the areas you have expertise
  • Work entirely on your own schedule
  • Earn compensation for sharing your insights and experience
  • Help improve technology decision-making across the cybersecurity community

This is not a traditional consulting or employment role. Most contributors participate on a flexible basis, providing current insight on products they already know well.

This opportunity is designed to fit around your existing role and commitments. Some experts contribute just a few hours each quarter, while others engage more often depending on their availability and areas of expertise.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you have recent hands-on experience with one or more cybersecurity products, including as:

  • Security leaders and executives
  • Security architects
  • Engineers and administrators
  • Product owners
  • Security operations professionals
  • Cloud and infrastructure security practitioners
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance professionals
  • Consultants with direct implementation experience

Experience may include evaluating, purchasing, implementing, administering, operating, or supporting cybersecurity technologies.

About IANS

IANS is a trusted cybersecurity research and advisory organization that helps security leaders make informed decisions through practitioner-driven insights and expert guidance. The Vendor Intelligence Database extends that mission by providing the cybersecurity community with deeper, experience-based perspectives on hundreds of security products.

Interested? We'd love to learn about the security products you know best and explore whether you'd be a fit for our Vendor Expert community.
