We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are eager about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company, have new ideas to approach subjects, lead implementations and make a difference through business analytics.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Position Description:

The Senior Business and Strategic Financial Analyst will be a key member of the Business Finance and Strategic team, and will provide financial strategic support the Senior Vice-President of Global Sales, the NSE Global sales organization and the Regional Sales Leaders; by providing financial insights, strategic guidance and business partnering to drive decision-making and achieve our financial goals and manage a worldwide sales budget spend within 95% accuracy. The role will provide financial advice around forward looking spend visibility, business analytics around bookings, revenue and funnel; support tracking of productivity metrics, average selling price trends, product portfolio analytics, , bookings/revenue per headcount, benchmarking analysis; highly involve in strategic and long range plans for the NSE group and responsible for worldwide sales budget plan, forecast and actual variance analysis. The Networking and Service Enablement Group (NSE) has reported annual sales of about $800m per annum and sizable selling budget.

VIAVI’s business finance operates in a fast-paced environment with Business Units groups, engineering , marketing, commercial teams and manufacturing locations across the globe. This role requires frequent interaction with senior management in the Business Unit and also partnering with members of the corporate office and other business and centralized functions.

Critical Success Factors:

  • Ability to work independently while providing optionality to business partners to keep VIAVI on track to financial commitments amidst changing business needs.
  • Exceptional analytical skills.
  • Capacity to prioritize and be effective with little overview and guidance.
  • Ability to produce coherent and succinct executive level management reports.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally across all levels of the organization.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Act as a strategic and financial business partner for the business unit, proactively providing decision-making support, business analytics, financial insights and data-driven recommendations
  • Develop annual plans, quarterly forecast, monthly and quarterly spend & headcount trackers, and provide detailed variance analysis to leadership.
  • Provide business leadership with key financial metrics, full P&L insights, and ad-hoc financial modeling.
  • Develop and maintain financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning.
  • Support the Senior Vice-President of Global Sales by delivering strategic insights through cross-functional financial reviews and operational analysis.
  • Continuous search for efficiencies and identifying improvement opportunities for margin expansion, productivity gains and cash enablement
  • Review and approve requisitions following corporate governance policies.
  • Track monthly actual spend and investments, and partner with the business to achieve the financial goals, through KPI’s, forward looking visibility, timely actions development and others.

How to make an impact:

  • Financial Planning and Analysis: Lead the financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes for the Worldwide Sales organization. Provide in-depth analysis of margin expansion opportunities, identifying trends, variances, and analytics cost optimization, productivity and inflationary mitigation actions. Work closely with the Global Sales Organization and Regional Sales groups to ensure robust processes and tools are in place for efficient availability of timely and high-quality financial data as well as actionable insights into leadership for critical financial and business management decisions.
  • Business Partnering: Act as a trusted advisor to Global Sales leadership, providing financial insights and strategic guidance to support decision-making. Advocate for the business and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Regional Sales groups, Global Sales Operations, as well as Regional Senior Sales leaders in Americas, Europe and Asia, to build credibility and trust with partner functions by becoming deeply knowledgeable about sales, pricing, spending, performance metrics and capital projects, as well as financial and business implications.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and present weekly, monthly and quarterly financial reports to Global Sales leadership and other stakeholders. Develop and maintain financial models to support business planning and decision-making.
  • Spend Management: Monitor and control cost and expenses, ensuring alignment with budget and strategic objectives. Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives and process improvements. Manage through trade off decisions across spend areas to maximize budget use and find continuous efficiencies.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives, including productivity metrics, lean initiatives and funnel or demand creation. Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support business cases and investment decisions in a face pace environment.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensure compliance with financial policies, procedures, and regulations. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and documentation.
  • Provide financial and strategic advice to the Business Partners
  • Support the annual budget with the expectation to land within [+0% / -5%] of target
  • A Senior Finance partner who is the point of contact and accountable of all the financial information, trending analysis, source data and translating into actionable initiatives to support the decision making.
  • Regular and timely updates around Plan, forecast, Actual and forward-looking financial visibility with the ability to elaborate from bottoms up to Executive overview around total Global sales Financials.
  • Fully understanding of Sales finance practices and operating mechanism to drive project investment and its close loop with original strategic plans.
  • Partnering with the Stakeholders to identify options to addressing any gaps presented at the monthly reviews.
  • Proactive and accountable participant in financial discussions, with the ability of problem solving.
  • Be the conduct between Global / regional Sales and all financial groups, such as accounting, accounts payable, corporate FP&A, etc. for accounting guidance and support.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Skills/Abilities/Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field is required.
  • Significant experience in finance, preferably within the manufacturing industry.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a global, publicly traded, matrixed organization is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Oracle 12 (including OBIEE and Project Accounting), Hyperion Planning, Essbase, Tableau is desirable.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and capability to work independently, taking ownership of complex financial challenges with minimal guidance.

You are intellectually curious and analytically relentless. Hand you a problem and you figure it out - you don't wait for a fully scoped brief or a clean data set. jobs.title: AI & Data Analytics Lead
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an AI & Data Analytics Lead to lead the company’s use of Artificial Intelligence, data, analytics, automation, and business intelligence.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI & Data Analytics Lead to lead the company’s use of Artificial Intelligence, data, analytics, automation, and business intelligence.

This is a hands-on role for someone who sees AI as a fundamental part of how a modern company should operate—not simply as another technology or tool. The goal of this role is to identify opportunities across the organization where AI can improve how we analyze data, make decisions, automate processes, build reporting, work in Excel, interact with systems, and operate the business.

The ideal candidate combines strong data and BI skills with a deep understanding of modern AI tools and capabilities. You should be someone who naturally asks:

“Why are we doing this manually, and how can AI make this better?”

You will work across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Product, Technology, and other areas of the business to identify opportunities, build solutions, automate workflows, and create a more AI-enabled organization.

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy, Implementation & Automation

  • Lead the company’s practical adoption and implementation of AI across business functions.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can eliminate manual work, improve decision-making, increase productivity, reduce errors, and create new capabilities.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, platforms, and models and determine how they can be applied to the business.
  • Build and implement AI-powered workflows rather than simply recommending AI tools.
  • Integrate AI into existing business processes, systems, reporting, analytics, and workflows.
  • Develop AI solutions that allow employees to interact with company data using natural language.
  • Use AI to automate recurring analysis, reporting, research, data preparation, reconciliation, forecasting, and other manual processes.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI for anomaly detection, trend identification, forecasting, classification, summarization, and predictive analytics.
  • Develop repeatable AI solutions that can scale across departments.
  • Establish best practices for responsible and secure use of AI with company data.
  • Stay current with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and continuously identify new opportunities to apply them.

AI + Excel

  • Transform how the company uses Excel by integrating AI into Excel-based analysis and workflows.
  • Develop AI-enabled Excel solutions that automate analysis, reporting, data manipulation, modeling, and repetitive tasks.
  • Connect Excel to Snowflake, APIs, BI platforms, and other data sources.
  • Leverage tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, APIs, Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Office Scripts, and other emerging technologies where appropriate.
  • Build workflows where users can ask questions of data and receive meaningful analysis without manually manipulating large datasets.
  • Automate recurring Excel reporting and eliminate unnecessary spreadsheet-based manual processes.
  • Identify opportunities to replace complex manual Excel processes with AI-enabled or automated solutions.

AI + Data & Business Intelligence

  • Use AI to fundamentally improve how the company accesses, analyzes, and understands its data.
  • Work extensively with Snowflake as a core data platform.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries and develop data models and datasets for analytics.
  • Use Tableau and other BI tools to develop dashboards and reporting.
  • Incorporate AI into dashboards and analytics so users can more easily understand and interact with information.
  • Develop natural-language or AI-assisted interfaces to company data where appropriate.
  • Use AI to identify trends, outliers, relationships, and insights that may not be obvious through traditional reporting.
  • Improve data quality and identify inconsistencies using automated and AI-assisted processes.
  • Partner with Technology and Engineering to improve data pipelines, integrations, APIs, and the overall data environment.

Business Analytics & Decision Support

  • Partner with leadership and business teams to identify high-value analytical and AI opportunities.
  • Translate business problems into data- and AI-driven solutions.
  • Develop KPIs, dashboards, analytical models, forecasts, and decision-support tools.
  • Use AI to accelerate and improve forecasting, scenario analysis, budgeting, financial analysis, and business planning.
  • Create tools that allow leadership and business users to quickly answer questions using company data.
  • Move reporting from static historical information toward automated, predictive, and actionable intelligence.

Process Automation

  • Identify manual and repetitive processes throughout the organization that can be automated using AI, APIs, workflow tools, or traditional automation.
  • Build automated workflows that connect data, applications, and AI models.
  • Look beyond the existing process and determine whether AI can eliminate the process entirely or fundamentally redesign it.
  • Measure the time, cost, and efficiency improvements generated by AI initiatives.
  • Create scalable solutions rather than one-off experiments.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, AI, Automation, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AI and generative AI tools and a demonstrated ability to apply them to real business problems.
  • Strong experience with Snowflake and SQL.
  • Strong experience with Tableau or another enterprise BI platform.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, Power Pivot, data modeling, and automation.
  • Experience integrating AI with Excel, APIs, databases, BI tools, and business applications.
  • Ability to build practical AI solutions—not just experiment with ChatGPT or other AI tools.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, data modeling, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to look at an existing process and identify how technology and AI can fundamentally improve it.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking projects from idea through implementation.
  • Strong business acumen and curiosity about how the entire business operates.

Technical Skills

Required:

· Generative AI / LLMs

  • AI workflow design and implementation

· Snowflake

· SQL

· Tableau

· Advanced Excel

· Power Query / Power Pivot

· Data modeling

· Data visualization

· Automation

Strongly Preferred:

· Python

· APIs

· Office Scripts / VBA

· Microsoft Copilot

· OpenAI / ChatGPT APIs

  • Claude / Gemini or similar LLM platforms

· dbt

· Data pipelines / ETL

· AI agents and agentic workflows

  • Machine learning / predictive analytics

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is not simply a BI analyst who knows how to use ChatGPT.

You are someone who understands data, technology, and business—and who sees AI as a tool that can fundamentally change how a company operates.

You are constantly looking for ways to:

  • Automate instead of manually perform.
  • Predict instead of simply report.
  • Ask AI instead of manually search.
  • Build instead of repeatedly analyze.
  • Connect systems instead of move data between them.
  • Give employees answers instead of making them build reports.
  • Eliminate processes instead of making inefficient processes slightly faster.

You should be excited by the opportunity to take an existing process, understand how it works, and ask:

“What would this look like if we built it today with AI?”

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, this person should help establish an AI-first analytics and automation culture across the organization.

Success will include:

  • AI is being used across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Product, and other business functions.
  • Significant manual reporting and analysis has been automated.
  • Employees can interact with company data more naturally and efficiently.
  • Excel-based processes have been transformed through AI and automation.
  • Snowflake and Tableau provide a scalable foundation for analytics.
  • AI is integrated into reporting, forecasting, analysis, and decision-making.
  • New AI-powered workflows and tools are continuously being developed.
  • Leadership has faster access to better information.

· The company is using AI not just to work faster, but to work differently and better.

·

Benefits

Competitive Compensation, Medical, Dental, Vision, & 401K with Company Match!

  • Skilled in developing relationships across the Company to accomplish work goals, and ability to listen and share ideas amongst coworkers.

Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

The Opportunity:
CACI, INC. – FEDERAL has a contract with a federal agency to implement, support, and maintain a mission-critical SAP S/4HANA solution supporting transportation and logistics operations for the Department of Defense. The CACI Team manages Planning, Procurement, Fulfillment, Financials, Application Development, and Technical Operations, including Security, GRC, and Identity & Access Management—within the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS) environment.

CACI is seeking to hire an SAP Integration Suite Senior Developer that will be responsible for the solutions that typically exchange data among SAP instances and external systems that are integral components across the JTMS landscape. The typical interface model embraces Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) principles, building on SAP best practices and the SAP enterprise service architecture. This role requires deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite and prior experience supporting USTRANSCOM (USTC) transportation operations, systems, or programs. The architect will ensure SAP Integration Suite capabilities align with DoD transportation doctrine, regulatory requirements (DTR, DoD FMR), and Clean Core principles while supporting complex integrations across DoD and commercial transportation ecosystems.

Responsibilities:
The JTMS solution is foundational to the DoD mission, enabling the fielding and sustainment of transportation, logistics, and financial operations.

As the SAP Integration Suite Senior Developer, you will:

  • Build, test, and deploy integrations for data mapping and transformation using CPI, API Management and Event Mesh.

  • Define and implement mapping techniques (Message Mapping, Groovy Scripting, XSLT), Cloud Connector setup, and B2B EDI/TPM Configuration.

  • Using pre-built third-party connectors to simplify integration with non-SAP systems (e.g., Kafka, ServiceNow).

  • Developing and maintaining SAP design and technical specification documents

  • Conducting unit, integration, and release testing to validate functionality.

  • Provide L2/L3 support, troubleshooting production issues, and performing root cause analysis (RCA).

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active Secret clearance

  • 10+ years of SAP experience with SAP Integration Middleware.

  • Strong experience with SAP Integration Suite (CPI/Cloud Integration), SAP Integration Advisor, and BTP Architecture.

  • Configure standard and custom adapters (SFTP, REST, SOAP, OData, JDBC, IDoc) and manage message mapping, transformations, and routing.

  • Proficiency in Groovy scripts, XSLT, and implement message mapping (MIG/MAG) to bridge the legacy application mapping into SAP APIs.

  • Deep understanding of EDI standards (EDIFACT, X12) and experience with DoD EDI standards (DTEB preferred).

  • Configure EDI interfaces using TPM Configuration and configure adapters (AS2, SFTP, OData).

  • Deep understanding of REST, SOAP, OData, SFTP, EDI, and JSON/XML formats.

  • Experience in API Management publishing, securing and monitoring APIs while enforcing security policies (OAuth, SAML, SSL/TLS).

-

jobs.title: Project and Change Lead (Finance Transformation)
jobs.excerpt: As a Project and Change Lead, you will combine hands-on project delivery and practical change management to support execution of a large-scale Finance transformation program.
jobs.description:
As a Project and Change Lead, you will combine hands-on project delivery and practical change management to support execution of a large-scale Finance transformation program.

You will be part of a global Finance transformation program (~200 projects, 70% finance-driven), driving the delivery and adoption of multiple initiatives. You will ensure that projects are not only completed, but successfully embedded into the business and delivering real impact.

Acting as the key link between program structure, stakeholders, and impacted teams, you will bring structure, clarity, and execution focus across a complex and fast-moving portfolio.

This is a practitioner role - you will focus on doing, coordinating, and delivering, not only designing frameworks.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Coordination

  • Drive execution of multiple initiatives across the Finance transformation program
  • Build and maintain plans, milestones, dependencies, and reporting
  • Ensure alignment and connectivity across projects and workstreams
  • Track progress, risks, and outcomes, and proactively drive resolutions
  • Apply appropriate delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) depending on project type
  • Ensure deliverables move from completion to adoption and value realization

Change Management & Adoption

  • Conduct change impact assessments and stakeholder analysis
  • Translate program objectives into clear, actionable communication
  • Define and execute communication and engagement plans
  • Support and mobilize local stakeholders and change champions
  • Monitor adoption, identify gaps, and intervene to improve outcomes
  • Ensure impacted teams understand what is changing, why, and how it affects them

Stakeholder & Business Engagement

  • Partner with regional finance leaders (e.g., CFOs), SMEs, and operations teams
  • Coordinate across functions and geographies to ensure consistent execution
  • Facilitate alignment, decision-making, and issue resolution
  • Act as a bridge between technical teams, program leadership, and business stakeholders

Governance & Reporting

  • Provide clear, actionable updates to program leadership
  • Manage risks, dependencies, and escalation topics
  • Contribute to pragmatic improvements in project and change frameworks
  • Ensure transparency and consistency across reporting structures
  • Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s or MBA is a plus)
  • ~5 years of experience in:
    • Project Management, OR
    • Transformation / Program Coordination, OR
    • Change Management with strong delivery exposure
  • Experience in multinational, matrix organizations preferred
  • Exposure to finance transformation or operational change programs is a strong advantage

Skills

  • Strong project management fundamentals (planning, coordination, reporting)
  • Practical change management experience (impact assessment, communication, stakeholder engagement)
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives of different types simultaneously
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to translate complex topics into simple, actionable messages

Profile

  • Hands-on and execution-focused — delivers, not just designs
  • Pragmatic — focuses on what works in practice, not theory
  • Owner mindset — takes responsibility and drives work end-to-end
  • Fast learner — quickly understands, adapts, and applies
  • Business-oriented — understands operational impact and value delivery
  • Comfortable working in complex, fast-changing environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience as a change champion, project coordinator, or transformation contributor
  • Exposure to global transitions / operating model changes
  • Ability to operate across different delivery methodologies

Additional Information

  • Reporting line: Program Director
  • Location: Remote in Poland or hybrid in Katowice
  • Travel: up to 30%

Why SGS?

  • Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
  • Enjoy a flexible schedule and a remote work model.
  • Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
  • Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

Apply Now:
At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals. With more than 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.

Our brand promise – “when you need to be sure” – underscores our commitment to trust, integrity and reliability, enabling businesses to thrive with confidence. We proudly deliver our expert services through the SGS name and a portfolio of trusted specialized brands, including Applied Technical Services, Brightsight, Bluesign and Nutrasource.

  • Monitor recruiting metrics, hiring progress, and requisition status
  • Help identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes and candidate experience

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting or talent acquisition experience
  • Experience recruiting technical, engineering, construction, industrial, manufacturing, or skilled-trades professionals
  • Experience filling “hard to fill” roles
  • Strong sourcing skills using LinkedIn Recruiter and other recruiting platforms
  • Experience managing multiple open requisitions simultaneously
  • Excellent interviewing, communication, and relationship-building skills
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
  • Experience using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with hiring managers and internal stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting Commissioning Engineers, QA/QC professionals, inspectors, field engineers, project managers, or other technical professionals

Why Join FST?

At FST, recruiting is more than filling positions—it’s helping build the teams responsible for delivering some of the most advanced manufacturing facilities in North America.
When you join our Talent Acquisition team, you’ll enjoy:
  • Competitive salary of $80,000–$85,000
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays – FTO program (flex time off)
  • Collaborative leadership team
  • Opportunity to recruit for cutting-edge engineering and construction projects
  • Professional development and career growth
  • A company culture built on teamwork, integrity, and continuous improvement

Why This Role Matters

Every successful project begins with hiring exceptional people.
As a Recruiter at FST, you’ll play a critical role in identifying, attracting, and hiring the engineering and technical professionals who help deliver mission-critical facilities for many of the world’s leading technology and life sciences companies.
If you’re passionate about recruiting, enjoy building lasting relationships, and want to make a measurable impact on a growing organization, we’d love to meet you.
Apply today and help us build the future of high-tech manufacturing.

  • Expertise in geospatial data standards, data cataloging, and compliance with DoD metadata policies is required.

  • Tracking data lineage and ensuring metadata synchronization across a Data Catalog, ESRI Kubernetes, and enterprise metadata repositories.

  • Enforcing compliance with DoD metadata policies and NSG tradecraft standards for geospatial datasets

jobs.description:
The Information Security Specialist is a strategic role within DeepHealth’s Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance department, responsible for assisting in the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive information security compliance strategies. This position is critical in protecting organizational data, ensuring regulatory adherence, and mitigating potential security risks in the complex digital health landscape.

Requirements

Duties and Responsibilities

As the Information Security Specialist, this position will work with the Information Security Officer, IT Operations, Sec Operations and the broader Compliance team to:

Information Security Compliance Strategy:

· Develop and implement holistic security compliance programs

· Create comprehensive risk management frameworks

· Design and maintain security policies, procedures, and guidelines

· Continuously assess and update security strategies

· Ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements

Regulatory Compliance:

· Ensure compliance with complex regulatory standards including, but not limited to:

o HIPAA

o GDPR

o CCPA

o ISO 27001

o HITRUST

· Conduct thorough risk assessments and vulnerability evaluations

· Prepare detailed compliance reports and documentation

· Support external and internal audit processes

· Track and implement regulatory changes

Technical Security:

· Perform comprehensive security vulnerability assessment

· Develop and implement security control frameworks

· Monitor and analyze security incidents and breaches

· Design and conduct security awareness training programs

· Manage access control and identity management systems

· Evaluate and recommend security technologies and solutions

Incident Response and Management:

· Develop and maintain incident response plans

· Coordinate rapid and effective responses to security incidents

· Conduct pos-incident analysis and implement preventive measures

· Maintain detailed incident documentation and reporting

Interdepartmental Collaboration:

· Work closely with IT, Legal, Compliance, and Clinical teams

· Provide security guidance and recommendations

· Facilitate cross-functional security awareness and training

· Support technology implementation and security best practices

Please Note: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Qualifications include:

Qualifications include:

● Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience). Master’s degree or advanced security certifications preferred, such as:

o CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

o CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

o CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

● 3-5 years of progressive experience in security compliance with healthcare, medical technology, or highly regulated industries.

● Proven track record of developing and implementing security strategies.

● Experience with regulatory compliance in complex environments, including:

o An advanced understanding of security frameworks and compliance standards

o Proficiency in security tools and technologies

o Experience with risk assessment and management tools

● Excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to diverse audiences.

● High level of integrity and confidentiality

Working conditions

  • This position may be based in the European Union in a typical office setting.

  • This position will have the ability to work remotely.

Physical requirements

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally. The position requires the ability to travel (~10% of time), drive a vehicle, and utilize other forms of transportation.

jobs.title: Head of Regulatory Affairs - AI and P2P (100% remote)
jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives.

Responsibilities

  • Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance: Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.

  • Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership: Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.

  • Regulatory Strategy Development: As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.

  • Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.

  • Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.

  • Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.

  • Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.

  • Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

  • Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

  • Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Hallo, wir sind Ehrenkind! Unsere Vision ist es, durch unsere hochwertigen, nachhaltigen und langlebigen Kinder- und Babyprodukte Freude und Wertschätzung in jedes Kinderzimmer zu bringen!

Jedes Kinderzimmer? Aber es gibt doch extrem viele Kinderzimmer?

Genau! Wir haben eine große Vision, aber wir sind überzeugt, dass wir es schaffen werden. Daher haben wir das Ziel, unser Team in den nächsten 3-5 Jahren von aktuell 40 auf 100 Mitarbeiter zu vergrößern. Um das zu schaffen, suchen wir immer wieder talentierte, kreative Köpfe für unser einmaliges Team!

Wen suchen wir? Du kannst bei uns in den Bereichen Produktentwicklung, Einkauf, Content- und Performance-Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, Grafikdesign und IT durchstarten oder uns in den zentralen Funktionen wie People & Culture, Finance & Co unterstützen.

Requirements

Du findest bei uns aktuell keine offene Stelle, die gut zu dir und deinen Skills passt? Kein Problem!

Wenn du grundsätzlich Bock hast, bei einem wachsenden Start-up hautnah dabei zu sein, die Ärmel hochzukrempeln und Dinge voranzubringen- und zusätzlich noch das Kinderzimmer dieser Welt positiv verändern willst, dann kannst du dich auch jederzeit initiativ bei uns bewerben.

Schick uns dazu gerne doch einfach mal ganz unkompliziert deinen Lebenslauf zu und dann schauen wir, ob wir aktuell passende Einsatzmöglichkeiten für dich haben. Falls nicht, nehmen wir dich gerne in unserem Talentpool auf und würden dich direkt kontaktieren, sobald sich eine passende Gelegenheit ergibt! 😉

P.S. Wir arbeiten zwar alle Remote, sehen uns aber trotzdem mindestens 1x pro Monat für unser gemeinsames Co-Working/Teamevents, daher wäre es ideal, wenn du in einem Umkreis von ca. 2 Stunden von Schwäbisch Hall entfernt wohnst 😉 Falls nicht, ist das für uns aber auch kein Ausschlusskriterium. Wichtig ist für uns nur, dass du einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland hast / in Deutschland gemeldet bist.

Unsere Benefits

Wir leben die Möglichkeiten der digitalen Welt und arbeiten alle Remote - daher hast du bei uns maximale Freiheit und kannst mehr oder weniger arbeiten wie, wo und wann es dir passt. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir aber auch den Face to Face Austausch und kommen regelmäßig zu Teammeetings & -events sowie Coworking zusammen. Und wir haben noch einiges mehr zu bieten:

  • Modernste Technologien - Wir nutzen die neuesten und besten Tools bzw. diejenigen, die unsere Bedürfnisse am besten abdecken. Bei Bedarf entwickeln wir sie einfach selber ;) Denn insgeheim sind wir im Herzen doch irgendwie eine kleine Tech-Company

  • Weiterer Schnick Schnack (Macbook deiner Wahl, monatliche Sachbezüge (50 EUR) in Form von Gutscheinen, Jobrad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterbudget auf das gesamte Ehrenkind-Sortiment, 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, ein top Team, .... and so on 😉)

IIRR is looking for intelligent, strategic, and resourceful thinkers to support the organization’s global, regional, and country-level work. IIRR Interns have the opportunity to contribute to a wide range of organizational functions and projects, gaining practical experience in an international development organization while working with colleagues across a diverse global team.

Potential Areas of Support

Intern assignments will be tailored to organizational priorities as well as the intern’s skills, interests, and academic or professional goals. Depending on current needs, interns may support one or more of the following areas:

Fundraising & Development

  • Support research and preparation of grant proposals, concept notes, donor materials, and other fundraising documents.
  • Conduct research on prospective donors, funding opportunities, and relevant trends in international development.
  • Assist with organizing and maintaining information and materials related to fundraising and donor engagement.

Partnerships

  • Assist with partnership development activities, background research, and preparation of partnership materials.
  • Support coordination and documentation of meetings, collaborations, and learning exchanges.

Research & Learning

  • Conduct literature reviews and research on topics relevant to IIRR’s programs and organizational priorities.
  • Support the identification and documentation of tools, approaches, and evidence related to measuring program outcomes and impact.
  • Assist with research, analysis, and preparation of reports, briefs, presentations, and other knowledge products.

Projects & Programs

  • Support project initiatives in IIRR’s focus areas: health, education, food systems, economic empowerment, and the environment.
  • Assist with project planning, implementation, monitoring, documentation, and reporting.
  • Support the development of new program concepts in collaboration with colleagues around the world.

Operations & Organizational Support

  • Provide research, administrative, analytical, and coordination support to global, regional, and country teams.
  • Assist with developing and organizing operational documents, systems, processes, and internal resources.
  • Support ad-hoc organizational initiatives and assignments as needed.

Advocacy & Communications

  • Support the development of communications materials, including website content, social media, newsletters, reports, presentations, and other publications.
  • Conduct research to support advocacy and public engagement on issues relevant to IIRR’s mission and areas of work.
  • Assist with documenting and communicating program results, organizational achievements, and stories of impact.

Interns may contribute to one or several of these areas during their placement. Because IIRR operates in a dynamic international environment, assignments may evolve over the course of the internship in response to organizational priorities and opportunities.

Internship Structure

This is an unpaid internship but is available for class credit. We offer two internship models:

  1. Full-time: 5 days (40 hours) per week for 3 months
  2. Part-time: 3–4 days (20 hours) per week for 6 months

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (completed prior to internship start date)

  • Helpful and responsive, including when dealing with ad-hoc requests and providing support to colleagues
  • Resourceful, creative, and comfortable with problem-solving

  • Curiosity, creativity, and willingness to contribute new and bold ideas
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to meet deadlines and effectively manage multiple tasks
  • A willingness to learn from mistakes, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback while respecting and valuing input from a global and diverse team
  • Ability and willingness to work in a dynamic environment where responsibilities may evolve from week to week
  • Intermediate experience with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google applications
  • Responsive to manager’s feedback and able to take direction while executing work independently with minimal oversight in a remote working environment
  • Passionate about making a positive difference

Application Instructions

Submit a resume/CV, cover letter, and contact information for three references. In your cover letter, please indicate whether you are seeking a full-time or part-time internship and identify the areas of work that are of greatest interest to you (e.g., fundraising/development, partnerships, research, projects/programs, operations, or advocacy/communications). Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

No calls, please. If you have not received a response from us in two weeks, you should assume that your application was not successful on this occasion.

Join the power movement as Lead Piping Engineer

As the Lead Piping Engineer, you will lead all piping engineering functions, including pipe stress analysis, piping standards and material specifications, and pipe support design. Depending on project needs and team structure, perform these engineering activities directly or provide technical leadership by overseeing, coordinating, and delegating work to the piping engineering team or contractors.

What you'll do:

    Pipe Stress Engineering

  • Establish and document pipe stress methodologies, standards, and best practices
  • Perform pipe stress analyses using industry-standard pipe stress software (e.g., AutoPIPE)
  • Evaluate piping systems for sustained, thermal expansion, occasional, seismic, wind, and dynamic loading conditions
  • Design and specify pipe support systems, including spring supports, restraints, guides, anchors, and hangers
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the company's standard pipe support catalog
  • Prepare and maintain piping stress calculations, reports, design documentation, and supporting engineering records
  • Ensure piping designs comply with applicable codes and standards, including ASME B31.1, ASME B31.3, and other relevant industry standards
  • Coordinate with piping designers, mechanical engineers, civil/structural engineers, equipment engineers, and project teams to optimize piping layouts and support configurations
  • Evaluate equipment nozzle loads and ensure compliance with vendor allowable loads and applicable standards
  • Perform fatigue assessment and analysis for piping systems and components subjected to cyclic operating conditions
  • Conduct creep evaluations of piping systems operating within the creep temperature range to ensure long-term integrity over the plant's design life
  • Perform dynamic and pulsation analyses of suction and discharge piping systems to verify operational reliability and compliance with design requirements
  • Evaluate piping systems for vibration susceptibility and develop engineering solutions to mitigate vibration-related issues
  • Collaborate with equipment vendors to integrate pulsation dampeners and ensure compatibility with piping system design and performance requirements
  • Recommend design modifications to minimize piping stresses and improve system reliability and constructability
  • Perform buckling calculations on vacuum piping systems
  • Review vendor drawings, equipment data, and support details for compliance with project requirements

    • Pipe Specification and Material Engineering

    • Develop, maintain, and standardize company-wide piping material specifications
    • Establish material selection philosophies and engineering best practices
    • Select piping materials based on process conditions, operating temperatures and pressures, corrosion, erosion, fluid compatibility, and applicable codes
    • Prepare piping material specifications, valve specifications, specialty item specifications, and procurement documentation
    • Ensure piping materials comply with applicable codes, standards, and project requirements, including ASME, ASTM, API, MSS, NACE, and other applicable industry standards
    • Perform material compatibility and corrosion evaluations for process and utility piping systems
    • Review, evaluate, and approve piping specification deviations and technical exceptions
    • Support value engineering initiatives by evaluating alternative materials and products while maintaining compliance and reliability
    • Support procurement activities

      • Supervisory Responsibilities:

    • Serve as technical authority for piping engineering within the organization
    • Plan, prioritize, and coordinate pipe engineering resources to support project schedules, including staffing, resource forecasting, and workload planning
    • Assign, oversee, and review work performed by internal engineers, contractors, and third-party engineering firms
    • Ensure piping engineering deliverables are completed on schedule and meet company quality standards
    • Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, HAZOPs, constructability and design reviews
    • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to piping engineers and designers
    • Interface with clients, equipment vendors, contractors, and regulatory agencies on piping engineering matters

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, structural engineering, or equivalent engineering program from an accredited four (4) year university or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum ten (10) years of job-related experience in piping engineering, including pipe stress analysis and piping materials/specifications
  • Strong knowledge of applicable codes and standards, including ASME B31.1, ASME B31.3, MSS, ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, ASTM, API, MSS, NACE, WRC-537, and ISO
  • Experience using pipe stress analysis software, preferably AutoPIPE. Experience with CAESAR II, ROHR, or PEPS is also acceptable
  • Experience selecting materials for high-temperature service, molten salt systems, cryogenic applications, vacuum piping systems, corrosive environments, and pressure-containing systems
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a variety of audiences, including management, coworkers, vendors, and contractors
  • Proficiency with standard computer applications, including Google Workspace, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, web browsers, and email applications
  • Experience with Navisworks is preferred

Bonus points for:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure
  • Experience with Navisworks
  • Experience with 3D plant design software (e.g., Plant 3D, SmartPlant, AVEVA E3D, or CADWorx)
  • Experience in power generation, industrial process facilities, chemical processing, molten salt systems, or energy projects

Must-have Requirements:

  • Perform activities such as stooping, climbing, typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time
  • Dedication to safety to mitigate industrial hazards that may include heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, lead (Pb), high voltage, and cryogenics
  • Willingness to travel or work required nights/weekends/on-call occasionally

SunStrong Management is currently searching for an Accounting Manager to be responsible for various areas of general accounting operations for multiple asset-managed portfolios. Reporting to the Accounting Senior Manager and Director, this position will require the oversight of various monthly, quarterly, and annual close tasks, including the review of periodic journal entries, account reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Establish and oversee the accounting processes and functions required to maintain the general ledger in compliance with US GAAP and the applicable Company’s policies.
  • Liaison with external auditors, service providers, and other stakeholders to facilitate financial statements audits, tax compliance/return preparation, due diligence, valuations, etc. as necessary for financial reporting and tax compliance purposes.
  • Manage the completion of month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely financial reporting.
  • Review periodic journal entries and balance sheet account reconciliations
  • Review and clearly present and communicate various ad hoc analyses of financial and other information to members of management, external auditors, service providers, and other stakeholders as applicable to supplement
  • Coordinate with other functions such as Treasury, Accounts Payable, Asset Management, Legal, and Tax to advance effectiveness and efficiency of the accounting function.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelor's degree with an accounting concentration
  • 6+ years of financial accounting experience or auditing, preferably with Big4 accounting firm
  • CPA
  • Excellent judgement and decision-making skills
  • Ability to multi-task across multiple portfolios and prioritize critical deadlines
  • Impeccable integrity: words and actions must continually reinforce this characteristic
  • Ability to manage, develop, lead, and evaluate other accounting team members
  • Ability to define and establish accounting processes for newly onboarded portfolios based on understanding developed from review of historical financial information, operating agreements, purchase and sale agreements, debt agreements, etc.
  • Ability to research and apply accounting literature, such as ASC606 and ASC805

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience in renewable energy industry; previous exposure to hypothetic liquidation at book value (HLBV) modeling
  • Previous experience using Microsoft Dynamics, Xero, and/or Ramp
  • Experience working with preparing and reviewing consolidations for multi-tiered legal structures
  • Interested in exploring opportunities to leverage AI tools to enhance accounting workflows and deliverables
WORKING CONDITIONS
  • Overtime as required

jobs.title: VP Capital Formation
jobs.excerpt: One capital relationship, three ways to be useful.
jobs.description:
One capital relationship, three ways to be useful. You will serve the same investor as a fund LP, a deal co-investor, and an acquisition counterparty.

About Us

EPL Group Advisory is an independent M&A and capital markets firm. We have advised on more than $900 million in transactions. We work with Seed and Series A+ scale-ups in B2B technology and manufacturing, and with independent sponsors, SPVs, and VC managers raising capital for their vehicles. Over half our deals are cross-border.

We take a small number of clients at a time so senior partners stay involved from signature to close.

EPL Group operates through Finalis Securities LLC, an SEC-registered broker-dealer and FINRA member.

Tasks

The Role

You will own capital relationships across both branches of the firm.

M&A Advisory: buyer and capital coverage on sell-side and buy-side mandates.

Investment Vehicles: capital formation for VC funds, independent sponsor deal equity, and SPV syndication.

You will cover institutional allocators, direct-investing family offices, and wealth intermediaries including RIAs and advisor networks. The wealth channel is early for us. You are hired to build it, not inherit it.

We have no proprietary fund to distribute. You are not wholesaling a shelf.

What You Will Do

  • Build senior relationships across allocators, family offices, and RIA and advisor networks
  • Run raises for funds, sponsor deals, and SPVs from positioning through close
  • Support M&A mandates with live buyer and capital intelligence
  • Formalize partnerships with RIA firms, broker-dealers, and advisor networks
  • Educate advisors and investors on private markets structures and economics
  • Source mandates into both branches
  • Partner with Finalis on compliance, onboarding, and Regulation D requirements

Requirements

What You Need

  • FINRA registration through a broker-dealer, or sponsorable within 120 days
  • 5+ years in capital formation, LP coverage, placement, or alternative investment distribution
  • Verifiable capital relationships you can activate on day one. Required, not preferred
  • Direct experience raising private markets vehicles
  • Command of fund and sponsor economics: carry, waterfalls, hurdles, promote, side letters
  • Fluency in Regulation D and accredited investor standards
  • Bachelor's degree in finance or a related field

Preferred: transferable RIA book, prior platform or approved-list experience, buy-side M&A exposure, cross-border experience, Spanish or Portuguese.

Who You Are

A principal, not a passenger. You are comfortable alone in the room with a CIO or an investment committee. You are an educator before you are a salesperson. You say early when a mandate is not fundable. You want a small firm where your contribution is visible, and you accept there is no platform to hide behind.

Benefits

Partner-level exposure, ownership of the firm's capital relationships, attractive performance-driven variable compensation (revenue-sharing role only), cross-border reach, and the opportunity to build our wealth channel from scratch.

Send your CV and a note on your capital relationships and one mandate you drove from origination to close. All inquiries confidential.

EPL Group Advisory is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be an integral part of a diverse team working to help modernize essential industries through the application of cutting edge IoT solutions. Your work would directly contribute to a cleaner, more efficient and productive supply chain by creating safer roadways, reducing fuel consumption and emissions, and providing a consolidated platform for connecting operations. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around how IoT can positively impact logistics management, workplace safety programs, fleet maintenance strategies, global asset management, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful SE at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of the application of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on hardware installation strategies, managing data collection over carrier networks, presenting a robust cloud infrastructure, and building third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the best technical solution is presented to Samsara customers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the West region of the United States except for San Francisco Bay Metros, New York City Metro and Washington DC Metro. This position requires travel up to 50% of the time and proximity to an international airport is preferred.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve challenges common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Walk installers through any scenario, explaining best practices for installing Samsara products and helping build deployment plans.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SE’s to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelors’ of Science degree from a 4 year accredited university
  • 2+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation and control systems
  • Must be located within and authorized to work in the United States

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelors’ of Science degree or advanced education in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open API’s
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with raspberry pi, arduino, etc.)
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles

The range of annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that OTE pay may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$95,795—$144,900 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value Enterprise prospects and existing customers with ARR over $25k. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication Products business across the DACHRegion. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Be passionate about what you do and you are able to think outside of the box and have extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Able to balance challenging priorities and handle multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of Enterprise Sales experience and a track record of personally selling and closing complex solutions to enterprise and software companies.
  • Strong experience identifying, mapping and prospecting enterprise accounts
  • Proven success in selling complex, technical solutions such as cloud communications platforms, APIs, and/or enterprise software
  • Experience in account management, developing and managing large enterprise clients, and a history of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Experience working with Fortune 500 or similarly large enterprises
  • Background in working within a quota-driven environment with proven ability to close high-value deals (e.g., six to seven figures)
  • Expertise in solution-based selling or consultative selling
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills, including handling complex deals with long sales cycles.
  • Prospecting and lead generation skills—ability to develop a pipeline through multiple channels, including direct sales, partnerships, and networking.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives, decision-makers, cross-functional partners and key stakeholders in large enterprises
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic environment.
  • Fluent in German

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience
  • Understanding of the CPaaS ecosystem and familiarity with:
    • Cloud communications (voice, SMS, chat, video, etc.).
    • APIs and integrations for communication services.
    • Telecommunications industry dynamics.
    • Knowledge of enterprise technology architecture and the technical needs of large organizations, including how CPaaS solutions integrate with existing systems.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in UK or Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
