jobs.excerpt: DescriptionIf you are passionate about driving innovation, building high-performing sales teams, and scaling industry-leading partner programs, we want to hear from you.
jobs.description:
Description

If you are passionate about driving innovation, building high-performing sales teams, and scaling industry-leading partner programs, we want to hear from you. Apply today to be part of the IRONSCALES team and lead the charge in revolutionizing the MSP landscape.

IRONSCALES is a leading provider of self-learning, AI-driven email security solutions that continuously detect and remediate advanced threats for global organizations of any size. Our solution is fast to deploy, easy to operate, and provides unparalleled protection against email threats. Our MSP division is a critical component of our growth strategy, enabling managed service providers worldwide to protect their clients and drive their own success.

Who We Are

We are IRONSCALES. We care about people. We care about cybersecurity. We care about our customers and partners. Our team acts with intentionality, and our actions are always in the best interest of our teams, our customers, and our company. Our culture is focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and the drive to push boundaries and take everything to the next level. We are a rapidly growing team and welcome all who love a fast-paced, rewarding challenge to join us today!

Role Overview

The Manager, Global MSP Channel Development leads and scales a global team of Channel Development Managers (CDMs) responsible for recruiting net new MSP partners into the IRONSCALES MSP program. This is a player-coach, front-line sales leadership role: you will build, coach, and manage a growing team of territory-aligned CDMs (with continued fast growth expected), while owning the team's collective net new logo acquisition and new business topline growth targets and KPIs.

The ideal candidate has direct experience carrying and exceeding a new-logo/channel recruitment quota themselves, has since transitioned into building and leading high-performing hunting teams, and thrives on instilling a rigorous, metrics-driven, activity-based sales culture. This leader will partner closely with the VP of the MSP Global Business Unit, Partner Success, Marketing, and RevOps to ensure a seamless, high-velocity path from prospect to signed MSP partner to healthy handoff.

Core Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Talent

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and performance-manage a global territory-based Channel Development Managers.
  • Build a scalable recruiting and ramp plan to keep pace with rapid headcount growth across regions/territories.
  • Instill a culture of extreme ownership, pipeline discipline, forecast accuracy, and “can-do” hunting mentality across the team.
  • Run regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, call/deal coaching, and role-play sessions to continuously sharpen team skill (e.g., objection handling, discovery, closing).
  • Develop career paths and succession plans for high performers, performance manage poor performers

Net New Logo Acquisition & Topline Growth

  • Own the team’s collective quota for net new MSP partner recruitment (via direct and distribution) and associated new business topline revenue.
  • Set and manage territory assignments, quota allocation, and top-of-funnel targets in line with the IRONSCALES Ideal Partner Profile (MSP IPP).
  • Establish a healthy balance across the team between marketing-sourced inbound leads/meetings and self-sourced outbound prospecting.
  • Monitor and drive pipeline hygiene, conversion rates, and velocity from first touch through signed partner agreement.
  • Identify and act on upsell/expansion signal early in the recruitment cycle, ensuring clean context transfer to Partner Success.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with Marketing to ensure CDMs are enabled with sales and technical collateral, campaigns, and MDF/co-marketing support.
  • Partner with Partner Success Managers (PSMs) to ensure disciplined, high-quality handoff of newly signed MSPs per the CDM-to-PSM rules of engagement.
  • Work with Sales Engineering to ensure CDMs and their SE counterparts are effectively paired on demos and technical objection handling.
  • Collaborate with RevOps to maintain accurate forecasting, Salesforce/CRM hygiene, and reporting cadences across the team.
  • Represent the CDM organization in MSP Global Business Unit leadership discussions, surfacing market, competitive, and program feedback.

Reporting & Accountability

  • Deliver regular (weekly/monthly/quarterly) reporting on team performance: net new logos, pipeline, conversion, and revenue against target.
  • Lead and/or contribute to weekly MSP Momentum meetings and other cadence rituals that reinforce role play and skill-building as core team habits.
  • Escalate risks (territory coverage gaps, competitive pressure, ramp delays) proactively with clear, data-backed recommendations.

Requirements

What We Need from You

  • 5+ years of channel development, business development, or partner recruitment experience with a cybersecurity vendor, MSP, VAR, or DMR — including direct quota-carrying experience.
  • 2+ years of experience directly managing a quota-carrying sales or channel development team, ideally in a fast-growing SaaS or cybersecurity environment.
  • Proven track record of both personally exceeding recruitment/revenue targets and leading a team to exceed collective targets.
  • Experience scaling a team quickly (hiring, onboarding, ramping) while maintaining performance standards and culture.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, creative, high-energy, and comfortable operating in ambiguity as the team and program scale.
  • Strong coaching skills — able to diagnose rep-level gaps (discovery, objection handling, closing) and coach to improvement.
  • Rigorous approach to forecast accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and CRM discipline (Salesforce).
  • Excellent executive communication skills — comfortable presenting team performance and strategy to senior leadership.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple regions/territories and priorities simultaneously with strong attention to detail.
  • Bold, decisive, and not afraid to make the tough call on people, territory, or process decisions.
  • Ability to travel flexibly, ranging from 25–50% depending on time of year and events scheduled (including team ride-alongs and regional events).

What We Offer

We believe in our people; therefore, we provide a robust compensation & benefits package. This includes competitive salaries, 401(k) with match, PTO program, HSA & PPO options for health insurance, employer-provided life insurance, wellness benefits, and more!

IRONSCALES is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.description:
Description

Regional Sales Director – Europe / UK

Location: UK or EU — UK preferred

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Type: Individual Contributor / New Logo Hunter

About the Position

We are seeking a highly driven Regional Sales Director to lead new business development across the UK and European financial services market.

This is a true hunter role, focused primarily on identifying, engaging, and closing new logo opportunities within banks, brokerages, payments companies, fintechs, and other financial institutions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in selling Financial Crime, Fraud, AML, Digital Trust, Identity, Risk, AI, or related technology and advisory solutions, combined with a proven track record of B2B software and/or professional services sales.

You will be expected to create opportunities through proactive outbound activity, establish relationships with senior decision-makers, develop complex enterprise opportunities, and manage the sales cycle through to close.

The successful candidate will be comfortable selling to C-level executives and senior business, risk, compliance, fraud, security, digital, and technology leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive new-logo sales across the UK and selected European markets
  • Develop and execute a territory strategy focused on banks, brokers, payment providers, fintechs, and other financial institutions
  • Proactively identify and target high-value prospects through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, events, and industry relationships
  • Build relationships with C-suite and senior executives, including CEOs, CROs, CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, Chief Fraud Officers, and Heads of Financial Crime
  • Generate, qualify, develop, and close complex enterprise sales opportunities
  • Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through solution positioning, proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Sell technology, software, platforms, advisory, and professional services addressing challenges in:
  • Financial Crime
  • Fraud Prevention and Detection
  • AML / KYC
  • Digital Trust
  • Identity and Authentication
  • Risk Management
  • AI and Machine Learning
  • Transaction Monitoring
  • Cyber / Digital Security
  • Develop compelling business cases and demonstrate measurable business value to prospective customers
  • Work closely with solution architects, product, delivery, marketing, and executive leadership teams to develop and close strategic opportunities
  • Build and maintain a strong enterprise pipeline and provide accurate forecasting
  • Represent the company at financial services conferences, industry events, executive meetings, and customer forums
  • Develop a strong understanding of regulatory, fraud, financial crime, digital transformation, and AI trends impacting financial institutions
  • Establish the company as a trusted strategic partner rather than simply a technology vendor

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a high-energy enterprise sales hunter who has demonstrated the ability to create opportunities from scratch and consistently close new business.

You should have:

  • 7+ years of B2B sales experience in enterprise software, SaaS, technology, consulting, professional services, or technology-enabled services
  • Proven experience selling into financial services

  • Financial Crime
  • Fraud
  • AML
  • KYC / KYB
  • Digital Trust
  • Identity
  • Risk
  • AI / Machine Learning
  • Cybersecurity
  • Transaction Monitoring
  • RegTech
  • Demonstrated success generating new-logo revenue
  • A proven history of personally originating and closing enterprise opportunities
  • Experience selling complex solutions involving multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles
  • Strong experience engaging with C-level and senior executive buyers
  • Ability to understand business problems and translate technology and advisory capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Strong prospecting, networking, discovery, negotiation, and closing skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecasting
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently in a growth environment
  • Willingness to travel throughout the UK and Europe as required

What We Are Looking For

This is not primarily an account management or farming position.

We are specifically looking for a hunter who enjoys:

  • Opening doors that do not already exist
  • Building relationships with senior executives
  • Creating demand through outbound activity
  • Targeting strategic accounts
  • Developing new territories
  • Selling complex solutions
  • Building a pipeline from the ground up
  • Winning competitive enterprise opportunities
  • Closing new logos and delivering measurable revenue

Existing relationships and networks within financial services are highly valuable, but the ability to create and develop new relationships independently is essential.

Target Customers

Primary target markets include:

  • Commercial and Retail Banks
  • Investment Banks
  • Challenger / Digital Banks
  • Brokerages and Capital Markets firms
  • Payment Service Providers
  • Payment Processors
  • Fintechs
  • E-money institutions
  • Insurance and financial services organizations
  • Other highly regulated financial institutions

Target Buyers

The successful candidate should have experience engaging with senior stakeholders such as:

  • CEO / Managing Director
  • Chief Risk Officer
  • Chief Compliance Officer
  • Chief Financial Crime Officer
  • Chief Fraud Officer
  • Chief Information Officer
  • Chief Technology Officer
  • Chief Digital Officer
  • Chief Data Officer
  • Chief Information Security Officer
  • Heads of AML / Financial Crime
  • Heads of Fraud
  • Heads of Risk
  • Heads of Digital / Transformation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing network across UK and European financial services
  • Previous success selling Financial Crime, Fraud, AML, Digital Trust, Identity, Risk, AI, RegTech, or Cybersecurity solutions
  • Experience selling both software and advisory / professional services
  • Experience with complex enterprise transformation or technology programs

  • Multilingual capabilities are highly desirable, particularly:

  • Existing relationships with C-level executives within banking, payments, brokerage, or fintech organizations

Why Join Us?

You’ll work with a talented global team, contribute to meaningful technical initiatives, and help shape a high performing DevOps culture.

Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

jobs.description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION

The Mortgage Loan Processor II processes mortgage loans from application to closing. This position complies with all legal and regulatory guidelines related to the mortgage loan industry. The Mortgage Loan Processor II improves customer service by processing all loans in a timely manner.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Answer incoming phone calls and answer customer questions regarding mortgage loans in general or specific to a borrower's loan in process.

2. Process FHA, VA, Conventional, Bond and RD loans after application, which includes, but not limited to, processing various types of verifications, pulling credit report, ordering appraisals, ordering title work, running loans through an automated system, pulling flood certificates, getting loan files ready and submitting them to underwriting, following up with underwriting and clearing all underwriting conditions.

3. Correspond with customers, real estate agents, appraisers, and title companies as needed to obtain information necessary to getting the mortgage loan ready to close.

4. Prepare month end reports to various banks and regulatory agencies.

5. Work directly with the Mortgage Loan Officer to ensure the utmost in customer service.

6. Refer customers to other bank personnel as needed.

7. Perform research on Bankway, Fortis, Image Center and Dimension.

8. Perform daily duties on all bank systems and Mortgage operating systems such as DO, DU, LP, Encompass and Doc magic.

9. Identify Cross Selling opportunities.

10. Review fields for completeness, qualification and Compliance.

11. Communicate deficiencies to the loan officer and customer.

12. Advise loan officer of any changes needed in the file to obtain loan approval. .

13. Communicate with realtor and customer of status as they change.

14. Communicate with Underwriter once file is submitted for approval process.

15. Clear underwriting conditions.

16. Complete required BSA/AML training and other compliance training as assigned.

17. The ability to work in a constant state of alertness and in a safe manner.

18. Perform any other related duties as required or assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

COMMUNICATION SKILLS

Ability to read and understand documents such as policy manuals, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

CRITICAL THINKING SKILLS

Ability to utilize common sense understanding in order to carry out written, oral or diagrammed instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving several known variables in situations of a routine nature.

REQUIRED CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Not indicated.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Not indicated.

SOFTWARE SKILLS REQUIRED

Intermediate: 10-Key, Accounting, Alphanumeric Data Entry, Word Processing/Typing

Basic: Contact Management, Database, Spreadsheet

WORKING CONDITIONS

Somewhat disagreeable working conditions. Continuously exposed to one or two elements such as noise, intermittent standing, walking; and occasional pushing, carrying, or lifting.

ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

The following work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES

The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations.

Semi-repetitive, low physical. Semi-repetitive type work which requires periods of concentration for varied time cycles as prescribed by the tasks.

While performing the functions of this job, the employee is continuously required to talk or hear; regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms; frequently required to stand, walk; and occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- High school diploma or its equivalent

    - 3+ years hands on experience processing Conventional, FHA, VA, RD, and Bond loans preferred
    - 1 year experience with Encompass Anywhere preferred
    - 5+ years experience using personal computers

Director, Strategic Finance  

College Board - Finance  

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).  

Type: This is a full-time position 

About the Team  

The Strategic Finance team is a highly collaborative team, working with senior leaders across the organization to drive key decisions that strengthen the outcomes of our programs and services. As the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) arm of the Finance division, we leverage a strong understanding of College Board’s economics, a broad range of financial models, and deep relationships with program leaders to manage and analyze a billion-dollar budget. Our work ensures that the College Board’s resources are strategically and sustainably allocated in support of our mission to clear a path for all students to own their future.   

About the Opportunity   

As a Director of Strategic Finance, you are an adept translator between program priorities and the organization's financial strategy. You help teams craft and refine their budgets, accurately forecast changes throughout the year, and keep leadership apprised of the financial health and needs of your portfolio of programs. You are your portfolio’s budget expert – masterfully tracking and telling the stories behind the investments, regularly adjusting projections to reflect new trends and inputs, and consistently using your financial modeling and analytical superpowers to provide actionable insights and recommendations to drive executive decision-making. Our ideal candidate is passionate about finance, has a strong understanding of FP&A best practices, and is driven by a desire to make a positive impact on students’ lives. 

In this role, you will:

Budgeting & forecasting (40%) 

  • Run annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes for programs in your portfolio 

  • ead monthly variance reviews with budget managers and ensure your programs stay on track to meet annual finance targets 

  • Maintain expense projections, regularly updating assumptions to reflect the latest vendor agreements, program decisions, and market trends  

  • Build and streamline financial models to improve budgeting and forecasting accuracy  

  • Proactively identify and size risks, opportunities, and other watch items 

 Financial analysis (25%) 

  • Support key analytical work streams, which may include unit cost analyses, ROI assessments, targeted cost reduction exercises, or other strategic finance projects 

  • Distill complex analyses into key insights and recommendations that drive sound business and strategy decisions  

 Reporting (15%) 

  • Develop and deliver monthly and quarterly financial performance reports  

  • Proactively design custom strategic financial reports, outlining actionable insights for senior leadership  

Partnership management (10%) 

  • Build and maintain relationships with program and supporting cross-functional teams to ensure understanding of priority work and resourcing needs  

  • Serve as a finance expert and business partner for portfolio programs 

About You

You have:  

  • Expertise in financial planning and analysis, with 5-7 years experience with budgeting and forecasting work 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related technical field preferred 

  • Strong organization and prioritization skills and the proven ability to move forward multiple projects in concert, both independently and as a member of the team 

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including extensive experience in financial modeling  

  • Strong communication and customer service skills, including experience summarizing complex financial analyses and presenting key findings to senior management  

  • Solid understanding of corporate finance   

  • Advanced MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word skills  

  • Experience with financial planning systems preferred, e.g. Workday Adaptive Planning     

  • A passion for supporting educational and career opportunities for millions of students    

  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business 

  • Authorization to work in the United States 

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receivingtimely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • Whilethehiring processmay vary, it generallyincludes:resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

AtCollegeBoard, we offer more than a paycheck:we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive.We’rea self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

The hiring range for this role is $80,000-$135,000. We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live. Below, we've offered an estimated range for a variety of metro areas throughout the United States.

  • New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, WashingtonDCand Los Angeles: $105,000-$135,000
  • Austin, Boston, Chicago,Philadelphiaand Denver: $90,000-$120,000
  • Atlanta, Miami, IowaCityand most other locations throughout the Southeast and Midwest: $80,000-$108,000

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

Parallels is seeking an experienced Product and Compliance Counsel to serve as a trusted legal partner to our Product and Engineering teams for a portfolio of Parallels software products. This role will provide practical, risk-calibrated guidance across product development, AI governance, privacy, security, intellectual property, and regulatory compliance, helping the business innovate responsibly while supporting its product and commercial objectives.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about the Sr. Corporate Counsel role and see if we’re destined to be together.

As a Senior Corporate Counsel, you will:

  • Serve as embedded compliance and product counsel partnering with Product and Engineering teams early in development —during roadmap, design, and testing—to identify legal, regulatory, privacy, IP, and customer trust considerations before they become launch blockers. In addition, you will provide practical, risk-calibrated recommendations that give Product and Engineering clear paths forward.
  • Create and operate legal and compliance review processes for software products and AI features, ensuring that privacy, security, regulatory, intellectual property, and customer trust considerations are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Translate evolving AI, privacy, consumer protection, IP, and regulatory requirements into product criteria, required third-party certifications, and monitoring obligations.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders on global trade and export control compliance requirements, including sanctions and export classification, translating legal requirements into practical product and operational guidance
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and leadership teams to identify, evaluate, and protect innovations through patents and other intellectual property rights, serving as a liaison to outside counsel and helping shape and scale the company's patent and invention disclosure program.
  • Act as a senior legal advisor on privacy-sensitive product design, data use, retention and deletion, cross-border data flows, data protection agreements, security commitments, and privacy documentation.
  • Advise cross-functional stakeholders during security incidents, audits, customer escalations and compliance reviews, helping the business assess legal and operational risks and align product behavior with contractual and regulatory commitments.
  • Advise Product and Engineering on copyright, trademark, patent, open-source, licensing, data rights, and other IP issues arising from software development and AI systems.
  • Support customer-facing and commercial matters when product, AI, regulatory, privacy, data, IP, or security questions affect a deal, renewal, expansion, or strategic partnership.
  • Participate in selected customer and prospect conversations as a subject matter expert.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate customer, partner and vendor agreements, particularly where product, AI, privacy, security, intellectual property, or compliance issues are involved.
  • Collaborate closely with a small, agile global legal team to provide practical, coordinated support across the business.

What YOU bring to the team:

  • JD from an accredited law school and active bar membership, with substantial legal experience spanning a leading law firm and high-growth technology company. 8+ years of legal experience preferred with at least 5 of those in-house.
  • Deep experience in at least one of the following: software licensing, security, or privacy/data protection.
  • Familiarity with export control, sanctions, and trade compliance considerations relevant to global software products, cloud services, and international product distribution.
  • Experience advising on intellectual property strategy, including patents, invention disclosure programs, open-source software, licensing, trademarks, copyrights, and technology commercialization.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise on complex, ambiguous matters involving product design, data, emerging AI legislation, intellectual property, security, open source software, and practical commercial risk.
  • Experience building or improving scalable legal programs, including governance frameworks, review processes, playbooks, templates, decision tools, training, or knowledge systems.
  • Ability to translate technical, legal, and regulatory complexity into clear practical guidance.
  • Consistently strong judgment with the ability to balance legal risk, customer trust, product usability, delivery timelines, and company goals; identify difficult decisions; and escalate appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Solid technical understanding of software licensing, open source software, AI, a challenger approach to the future of legal work, paired with critical thinking, consideration of business context, and ability to find practical solutions.

US:

  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.

  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Tibetan-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: TibetanInterpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.75 - $0.90 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Tibetan Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Tibetanand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inTibetanand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in Japan. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the country, as well as broader legislation pertaining to topics such as communication technology and artificial intelligence, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory affairs and / or legal experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.

To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.

You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the region, as part of enabling the broader business strategy across Tether’s business verticals.

The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.

You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory affairs initiatives.

Responsibilities

Regulatory Affairs

  • Maintain proactive relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units relevant to the Company’s product and service lines.

  • Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the country.

  • Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

  • Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

  • Identify and successfully realise opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide actionable risk and regulatory insights to internal stakeholders (legal, product, compliance, risk, commercial).

  • Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions into the aforementioned countries, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers.

  • Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory regionally.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 8 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in Japan.

  • Experience engaging with regulators or government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

  • Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

  • English speaking.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

At the same time, you will learn and grow your career by solving large scale and complex problems.

This Principal AI/ML Engineer will have technical ownership of WEX’s AI Engineering implementation, including but not limited to architecture, technical direction, engineering best practice, and quality/compliance. This leader will work closely with team members of the Data Lakehouse Engineering teams.

We are looking for a highly motivated, technically deep, and experienced Software Engineer to join the org and design, architect the AI/ML engineering applications and frameworks for Wex.

This Principal AI/ML Engineer will report to the Vice President of Data Lake and AI Engineering located in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role can also be in Chicago, Portland, Maine (Wex HQ), or Boston. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep technical expertise in building and scaling data lake environments, coupled with strong people leadership and communication skills to drive alignment across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and drive the development of technology and platform for the company's AI/ML engineering needs, ensure the functional richness, reliability, performance, and flexibility of this platform

  • Help design the architecture and lead the implementation of the AI/ML infrastructure, platform and services.

  • Challenge the status quo and hold a high bar to drive for better and better technical solutions to effectively serve all the needs in the broad risk area of Wex.

  • Partner with the security org and SRE org to ensure continuous improvement and meeting of security requirements, SLOs, and error budget.

  • Take strong financial responsibility for your team.

  • Hold yourself and your team accountable for delivering quality results using defined OKRs.

Qualifications & Experience

  • A technically deep and innovative Software Engineer leader able to act and deliver to the business needs.

  • Experience in using LLM models a plus

  • Broad understanding of distributed computing frameworks like Ray and Spark

  • Demonstrable experience in Kubernetes and Terraform

Extensive experience in full software development life cycle E2E including in production monitoring.

Location: We are actively hiring for this role in multiple markets.

Covetrus is a global animal-health technology and services company dedicated to empowering veterinary practice partners to drive improved health and financial outcomes. Our passion for the well-being of animals and those who care for them drives us to advance the world of veterinary medicine.

The Clinic Growth Advisor is fully remote with 75% travel.

The Clinic Growth Advisor serves as a trusted partner to veterinary practices, driving adoption of Covetrus technology solutions, improving operational efficiencies, and enhancing customer satisfaction. This role focuses on proactive customer engagement, platform optimization, growth enablement, and risk mitigation, ensuring practices achieve measurable business outcomes and maintain long-term loyalty. This role will also be responsible for the development of strategies necessary to fully optimize our technology solutions with our veterinary practices and effectively communicating the value of workflow efficiencies within their clinic.

Customer Engagement and Retention

  • Drive measurable outcomes: Increase dollars in same-store growth and reduce the number of deactivations

  • High touch customers: Strong focus on top-tier or strategically significant clinics to drive partnerships with our technology offerings for our clinics’ long-term success.

Platform Adoption and Optimization

  • Drive Utilization: Guide customers to leverage proactive prescribing, marketing, and auto ship capabilities, ensuring full adoption of Covetrus solutions.

  • Upsell Opportunities: Identify and promote additional features and complementary solutions, aligning with customer needs to expand their engagement.

  • Adaptability and strong problem-solving skills.

Key Competencies:

  • Analytical Thinking: Proficient in analyzing customer data to identify insights and improvement opportunities.

75% for high profile in person visits to support account team, trade shows

The International team is growing!

AssessFirst in a few words 👇

We’re a fast-growing HR Tech company on a clear mission: to revolutionize recruitment on a global scale.

Instead of relying on CVs, we help companies predict performance and fulfillment by analyzing people’s personality, motivations, and ability to learn.

Today, we’re 110+ team members, supporting 3,500+ clients in over 40 countries, helping them hire and develop their teams in a more inclusive and effective way.

Our culture? Ambition, impact, and freedom.

Want to help shape the future of work? We’d love to meet you.

Your Mission

Identify and qualify as many TA Director/VP of TA prospects as possible by engaging them effectively: asking the right questions, raising awareness of HR challenges, and convincing them that AssessFirst is the solution for unlocking human potential.

What You’ll Do Each Day

  • Generate leads across the UK and US market through a multi-channel approach: cold calling, email outreach, social selling, inbound marketing, events, and more.

  • Analyse and understand your prospects’ Talent Development and Recruiting needs to propose tailored solutions.

  • Schedule qualified meetings for the Account Executives and support opportunities through to closing.

  • Actively contribute to lead generation through attending TA-focused events (organized independently or with support from the Marketing team).

  • Monitor industry trends and experiment with new prospecting methods to continuously improve your performance.

  • Be happy to adapt your working schedule throughout the week to accommodate speaking with US clients.

Your Objectives

✅ Generate a high volume of qualified sales opportunities and exceed your targets.
✅ Maintain rigorous pipeline management through to conversion.
✅ Increase AssessFirst’s visibility and impact within the UK/US TA market.

✅Help form the AF community in these two regions.

How you’ll do it

  • You thrive on competition: pushing yourself and helping the team improve is part of your DNA.

  • You’re a powerhouse of energy: your enthusiasm is contagious.

  • You work smart, not hard: you automate low-value tasks so you can focus on what truly matters.

  • You’re proactive: you test, adapt, and innovate. You don’t wait for instructions to move forward.

  • You go above and beyond. You’re not satisfied with hitting targets: you look for ways to raise the bar, improve processes, and create opportunities where others see obstacles.

  • You bring solutions, not just problems. When something isn’t working, you think critically, suggest alternatives, and take ownership of finding a better way forward.

  • You know how to upward manage effectively. You communicate with clarity, provide the right level of context, and help your manager and wider team stay focused, informed, and aligned.

  • You make decisions using logic and reasoning. You’re comfortable explaining your thinking, challenging assumptions, and using data, insight, and common sense to guide your actions.

  • You want your voice to be heard. We’re a highly agile team where ideas are welcomed regardless of title, and where your feedback can directly influence our strategy, processes, and growth.

  • You thrive in an environment of change and opportunity. As AssessFirst continues its ambitious international expansion, you’ll play a key role in shaping our success across the UK and US markets.

  • You take ownership. You don’t just generate meetings - you think like a business builder, contributing to the development of our market presence, community, and long-term growth.

  • You’ll be happy to travel across the UK and US to attend events.

Your future team

You’ll be part of the UKUS team, made up of 8 people.

You’ll also work closely with the wider AssessFirst global team.

What we’re looking for

🇬🇧 Fluent English, as our team is international.

💼12 months+ experience in a outbound sales or recruiting role
💻 Highly comfortable with digital tools, especially AI-powered tools.

😎 A true learner:make mistakes, learn from them, move on.
🔥 Sharp, engaging, and able to capture attention with your outreach.
🏆 A true competitive spirit with a strong drive to achieve results.
🌍 Someoneliving in the UK.

What you’ll get

  • £45k starting salary + £15k comms (£5k from team pipeline targets + £10k personal performance bonus)

  • Autonomy & Flexibility: Manage your own schedule with no fixed working hours.

  • Fully Remote:Work from anywhere in the UK.

  • Career Growth: Opportunities for both horizontal and vertical progression.

  • Coworking Access: Up to 6 days per month.

  • Strong Company Culture: 3 company seminars per year to connect with the team.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruitment Process

    1. The role catches your attention.

    2. You complete our assessments after applying (you’ll receive a link by email).

    3. The Talent team contacts you for an introductory call.

    4. Up to 4 interviews:

      • Your future manager (Becca)

      • A practical case study (Becca and Dylan, your mentor)

      • A discussion with Quentin (CSO) and David (CEO)

    5. Welcome aboard! You’re now part of the team. 🚀

  • Join a growing team of software and energy veterans from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle, General Electric and Pacific Gas & Electric

Our Engineering Team develops Software-as-a-Service (Saas) solutions hosted in the cloud using sophisticated development tools and cutting-edge cloud infrastructure. One of the interesting and fun challenge you’ll face here is:

Energy resource workflow automation

You’ll be writing code used by hundreds of thousands of utility employees, utility customers and energy industry professionals that helps these energy technologies get installed and have an impact.

You’ll be part of an agile, empowered and high-performing team. You’ll have exposure to customers and the business, and be an important participant in product, design and technology decisions.

  • Participate in release testing, monitoring of performance and functionality of the service in production
  • Effectively use modern AI-assisted development tools to support software development activities including writing and understanding code, troubleshooting issues, developing tests, and improving developer productivity

Who You Are

  • 1+ years of professional software development experience
  • Someone who has strong aptitude for problem solving and consistently delivers high quality code
  • BA/BS or MS degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
  • Experience in building web applications/services using C#/ASP.NET/SQL and running in a cloud-hosted environment is a plus
  • Some experience with AI-assisted development tools and a strong interest and willingness to learn, adopt, and become proficient with AI tools as part of the software development process
  • Passion for renewables and for advancing the energy transition to clean energy

  • Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 annual depending on experience
  • Benefits: Performance-Based Bonus, Company Equity Plan
  • Benefits: Paid Time Off, Sick Time, Holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision/Life and Disability Insurance, 401(k), Parental Leave, Commuter Benefits

Who is ControlPlane?

ControlPlane is a London headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open source solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence has driven ControlPlane deeper into cybersecurity providing services like threat modelling, penetration testing, and supply chain security to ensure robust protection against cyberattacks in containerised and cloud-native environments.

We are acclaimed for our contributions to securing highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help businesses improve their security posture through services like DevSecOps consulting, zero-trust architectures, and platform engineering. ControlPlane also focuses on advancing best practices in the Kubernetes ecosystem, offering specialised training and community engagement.

Our clients range from multinational banks to tech giants and public clouds, where we assist with both security and operational needs. In addition to consulting, we are active in the open source community, supporting projects like Flux CD and providing security tools for Kubernetes environments.

Over the coming years you’ll see us retain our focus on solving difficult problems for clients with intense security controls using pragmatic, real world solutions. Taking our extensive R&D to help organisations consume next generation and open source projects safely and securely - that might be extending our work with FINOS AI Readiness or the overhaul of open source supply chain security.

What We're Looking For in a Cloud Native Security Consultant

We are looking for Cloud Native Security consultants to represent the technical and cultural values of ControlPlane, leading our customers by example in the complex and fast-changing world of cloud native technology. You will perform a mix of client consulting, working on internal labs projects, and contributing to Open Source projects on ControlPlane’s behalf.

There is no perfect candidate for this role. As we look to extend our cloud native security team we welcome engineers and architects with a diverse range of capabilities, experiences and backgrounds.

We are SANS authors (SEC584) and believe strongly in team learning and collaboration. Candidates with an aptitude to learn are preferred, and we provide full training for the newest cloud technologies that our customers rely on.

This is a unique job role within a successful start-up company where you will have the chance to make a positive impact, learn, grow and work with great colleagues who consistently challenge the status quo.

Roles, Responsibilities and Requirements of Our Cloud Native Security Consultant:

  • Knowledge of Threat Modelling and Cloud Native Security architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Kubernetes and container experience (some of EKS, GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and container runtimes)
  • Knowledge of software supply chain security
  • DevSecOps principles and Engineering practices
  • CI/CD experience, automating security tests, and hardening pipelines
  • Knowledge of security tooling from enterprise tools such as Aqua, Prisma, Sysdig, Lacework, etc to Open Source tools such as falco, kube-hunter, and kube-bench.
  • Knowledge and experience using hardening guides, compliance and risk management standards

A desire to learn, or experience with:

  • CLI tooling in any of the above technologies.
  • Golang or Python
  • Terraform and cloud infrastructure best practices (IaC, regulated systems)

Benefits

ControlPlane is a dynamic, cutting edge and passionate business for which to work. Our employees are the heart of our business, which means we care about our company culture and our employees’ wellbeing and progression. Alongside this, as our colleague you will have the following benefits:

  • Generous and competitive salary

As we grow you will help us to build a company culture of which we can all be proud. If you espouse these values, we want you!

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

You desire impactful work.

You’reRGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

Leads the design and delivery of security data engineering and intelligence capabilities that integrate, correlate, enrich, and operationalize data across security, governance, cloud, application, endpoint, vulnerability, and risk platforms. Builds governed, reusable data products and analytics that improve risk prioritization, remediation effectiveness, control visibility, and measurement of security outcomes. Serves as a hands-on technical lead, leads small and complex cross-functional initiatives, mentors technical staff, and partners with leaders, control owners, remediation teams, Enterprise Data Platform teams, and other stakeholders. Helps define, build, validate, and socialize trusted KPIs, KRIs, control-effectiveness measures, and outcome-based metrics that support clear accountability and measurable risk reduction.


Principle Duties


  • Leads the design and delivery of complex security data engineering initiatives and small cross-functional project teams, providing technical direction from solution design through implementation and operational ownership.
  • Ingests and integrates data from security, governance, cloud, application, endpoint, vulnerability, identity, and risk platforms using scalable data pipelines, applications, APIs, and automation.
  • Deduplicates, correlates, and enriches security findings with asset, ownership, business, control, and risk context to produce actionable intelligence.
  • Designs and delivers governed security data products through RGA’s Enterprise Data Platform, using Snowflake and enterprise data-engineering patterns to make security information reusable, trusted, and accessible.
  • Develops and optimizes Snowflake data models, SQL transformations, queries, and compute patterns while managing data quality, performance, access, traceability, and cost.
  • Partners with Enterprise Data Platform, Data Governance, and security teams to establish sustainable ingestion, transformation, role-based access, lineage, metadata, data-quality, and lifecycle practices.
  • Co-develops KPIs, KRIs, control-effectiveness measures, thresholds, targets, and supporting calculation methodologies aligned with security strategy, risk objectives, and technical standards.
  • Establishes metric governance through documented definitions, authoritative data sources, ownership, data-quality checks, refresh cadence, version control, and traceability to underlying risks, controls, and remediation workflows.
  • Socializes metrics with leaders, control owners, and remediation teams by translating technical results into clear risk narratives, validating definitions and assumptions, and connecting executive indicators to accountable teams and actions.
  • Develops tool-agnostic dashboards, scorecards, reporting capabilities, and reusable services with drill-through from leadership indicators to supporting assets, controls, findings, and remediation work.
  • Identifies trends, systemic risks, concentrations of exposure, control gaps, and remediation opportunities, and provides clear recommendations to technical teams and leadership.
  • Builds strong data foundations for security automation and future AI-enabled and Model Context Protocol-based capabilities.
  • Technically mentors associates, establishes engineering standards, guides design and peer reviews, and provides training and knowledge sharing as required.
  • Evaluates new security, data, and analytics technologies and recommends solutions that maximize business value while reducing manual effort and unnecessary vendor dependency.
  • Communicates architecture, tradeoffs, delivery status, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical teams, leaders, and business stakeholders.

Success Measures


  • Security data from multiple platforms is consistently integrated, normalized, enriched, governed, and available for decision-making.
  • Leaders, control owners, and remediation teams share trusted definitions for KPIs, KRIs, controls, thresholds, targets, and ownership, with clear links to prioritized actions.
  • Executive indicators provide concise risk and performance narratives with drill-through to the teams, assets, controls, and remediation work driving the result.
  • Security data is delivered through reusable Enterprise Data Platform and Snowflake data products rather than isolated pipelines, manual extracts, or tool-specific reporting.
  • Manual integration and reporting effort is reduced through scalable automation, reusable engineering patterns, and documented ownership.
  • RGA can better quantify material exposure, control coverage, remediation effectiveness, security debt, and the business value of security initiatives.
  • Small team projects are delivered with strong technical direction, stakeholder alignment, sustainable ownership, and measurable outcomes.

Education

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) or relevant professional industry certification
  • CISSP, CISA, CCSP, CGRC, Comptia CASP+, OSCP, CEH Certifications

Work Experience

Required

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or small project teams, guiding solution design, mentoring others, and driving work through delivery.

Preferred

  • Experience managing and developing security data products, analytics, reporting, or metrics within a governed enterprise data environment.

Preferred Technical Experience

  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Atlan, Power BI, Git-based development workflows, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, or serverless application patterns.
  • Experience with security platforms such as Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security, GitGuardian, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Nucleus, LogicGate, or comparable technologies.
  • Knowledge of exposure management, vulnerability prioritization, risk-based remediation, security program measurement, and control-effectiveness reporting.
  • Experience with AI-enabled integrations, automation, or Model Context Protocol.
  • Relevant cloud, security, data engineering, analytics, or architecture certifications.

Skills and Abilities


Required

  • Strong information security knowledge and the ability to work with vulnerability, exposure, cloud, application, endpoint, identity, governance, and control data.
  • Experience defining and operationalizing KPIs, KRIs, control measures, and outcome-based metrics, including calculation logic, thresholds, targets, ownership, and validation.
  • Working knowledge of governed data-product practices, including role-based access, lineage, metadata, data quality, ownership, and secure data sharing.
  • Experience with security analytics, business intelligence, dashboard development, data visualization, and executive or operational reporting.
  • Advanced hands-on skill with Python, SQL, APIs, data modeling, databases, and automated data pipelines.
  • Experience building analytical models, pipelines, or data products on Snowflake, an enterprise data platform, or a comparable cloud data ecosystem.
  • Experience designing, developing, deploying, and operating applications or data services in AWS or another major cloud platform.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and risk concepts to leaders, control owners, engineers, and remediation teams.
  • Advanced ability to translate business and security needs into maintainable technical solutions, measurable outcomes, and actionable recommendations.

  • Ability to balance strategic architecture with hands-on engineering, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively with limited direction.
  • Ability to work effectively across technical, operational, risk, governance, and business functions.


What you can expect from RGA:
